20 篇主题文章402 句逐句拆解1612 / 1612 词条覆盖

依据上传《英语四级高频词总榜》制作，原表1612个词条。每个词条至少在正文出现一次，含义按原表所列义项使用，不要求穷尽该词的全部义项。英文与中文译文中的对应词义均标黄；短语按实际语境对应，中文不必逐词拆开。英文标出原表词条的原形或原表本身所列词形。部分原表释义有省略号，弹窗照录，不伪装成完整词典。anumeric 等少见词仅作语境学习，不表示它是常见四级写作词。示例均为教学编写；健康、法规和技术情节用于语言学习。

先看这8步：怎样从中文意思写出英文

1. 先说清这一句要表达什么

不要先查一串英文词。先用中文回答：谁或什么，做了什么，涉及谁或什么，为什么、什么时候。一个复杂意思可以先拆成两句。

2. 找主语，再选一个核心谓语

例如“我最近学得很吃力”，先定 I，再选 struggle，得到 I struggle。名词作主语并不一定是人：压力也可以“影响学习”。英文完整陈述通常要有主谓；祈使句常省略 you。

3. 动作和状态用不同骨架

“我学英语”是 I study English（主谓宾）；“我很累”是 I am tired（主系表）。中文“我很累”可以直接用形容词说状态，英文这里用 am 连接。不是每句话都要加 be：I am study 不成立。

4. 补上动作需要的对象和搭配

“专注学习”选 concentrate on learning；“鼓励我学习”选 encourage me to study。介词和 to 不能从中文猜，要和动词一起记。介词后若接动作常用 ing；不定式标记 to 后用原形，但不是所有 to 都是不定式。

5. 再加时间、原因、条件和修饰

短修饰常放前面；长的从句常放被修饰名词后：“帮助我的老师”→the teacher who helps me。“因为……”→because + 完整句；“由于……”→because of/due to + 名词短语。

6. 最后检查形式，不只检查单词

一般现在时：he works；否定：he does not work。情态动词后用原形：he can work。可数单数通常要限定词：a student/the student。检查每个完整分句的主语和谓语，以及各层动词由谁决定。

7. 中文和英文为什么常有不同

两种语言组织语法信息的方式不同。中文常靠语境、语序和“了、正在”等说明时间与关系；英文常需要在动词、限定词、连接词上显式标记。中文也有主谓宾，英文也能把时间放前面，不能机械理解成两种语言处处相反。

8. 从句先抓主干，再看它填什么位置

that 宾语从句：I know [that he works]，填“知道什么”。who 定语从句：the teacher [who helps me]，补“哪位老师”。when 状语从句：[When I am tired], I rest，补“什么时候”。同一个 that 要按所在位置判断功能。

建议一次学一段，约4句。先自己读和翻译，再展开“这句怎么写”；隔天遮住英文，用中文提示还原主干。20篇是文章总数，每篇含若干自然段。

01 · 从重新开始到学会学习

约393个英文词 · 20句 · 含122个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖122个词条

An average undergraduate may struggle with academic pressure, but a realistic schedule can make learning less stressful. At the beginning of each semester, I set a modest target and divide every assignment into several manageable tasks. When distraction interrupts my reading, I remove my smartphone and concentrate on one textbook chapter. This routine does not guarantee perfection, but it helps me accumulate knowledge through persistent effort rather than willpower alone.

My tutor believes that vocabulary becomes more memorable when a learner meets each phrase in a meaningful context. We analyze the structure of an original sentence, identify its subject and verb, and then imitate its pattern. A clear explanation can distinguish a formal expression from an informal one and prevent a common misunderstanding. If an instructor asks us to hyphenate a compound, we check a reliable reference instead of making a random guess.

I would gain more from a short, effective review than from a long session in which I am completely unaware of my mistakes. Students generally tend to forget a rare word unless they actively recall its meaning and repeatedly use it in various contexts. To enhance the quality of learning, I adopt a practical strategy and regularly adjust the pace instead of trying to absorb everything immediately. This adjustment helps me cope with a heavy load, prioritize the hardest task, and fully understand at least one key idea each day.

A student who receives an award may feel grateful, but external recognition is not the sole source of lasting motivation. I am keen to improve, yet I do not want the pursuit of excellence to turn into a nightmare of constant comparison. A realistic mindset allows me to honor a small accomplishment and acknowledge that progress is normally uneven. I can strive for a higher standard without demanding that every attempt be outstanding or every day feel super productive.

At kindergarten, children commonly learn to share stuff, follow a simple rule, and interact with a mixed group of classmates. A child may naturally associate a teacher's tone with approval, so adults should be aware of how their words affect confidence. An interested teen can engage in a series of creative activities that motivate learning and cultivate a unique style. Although innovation is important, a school should not ban dreaming or treat a quiet nerd as someone who does not belong.

第1自然段
01—01

An average undergraduate may struggle with academic pressure, but a realistic schedule can make learning less stressful.

一个普通本科生可能艰难应对学业压力，但切合实际的时间表能让学习不那么令人紧张。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句①主语 An average undergraduate；谓语 may struggle；with...说明应对什么。分句②主语 a realistic schedule；谓语 can make；宾语 learning；宾补 less stressful。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“学生可能吃力”，再用 but 接“计划能改善”。may/can 后接原形；make 后用形容词说明宾语变成怎样，不能写成 make learning is less stressful。

01—02

At the beginning of each semester, I set a modest target and divide every assignment into several manageable tasks.

每学期开始时，我设定一个不大的目标，并把每项作业分成几个可以应付的任务。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
时间状语 At the beginning of each semester；主语 I；并列谓语 set、divide；宾语分别为 a modest target、every assignment。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文可以只说“学期初定目标”；英文独立陈述通常要明确谁做，所以补 I。两个动作同一主语，用 and 连接，第二个 I 可省。

01—03

When distraction interrupts my reading, I remove my smartphone and concentrate on one textbook chapter.

当干扰打断我的阅读时，我把智能手机拿开，专心读教科书的一章。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 时间从句：distraction（主语）+ interrupts（谓语）+ my reading（宾语）。主句：I + remove... and concentrate on...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先分出“什么时候”和“我做什么”。when 把前者变成时间背景；不能再添加一个连接主句的 then 充当连词。concentrate on 中 on 不能漏。

01—04

This routine does not guarantee perfection, but it helps me accumulate knowledge through persistent effort rather than willpower alone.

这种日常安排不能保证完美，但能帮助我通过持续努力积累知识，而不是仅凭意志力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① This routine + does not guarantee + perfection；分句② it + helps + me + accumulate knowledge；through...表方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
一般现在时否定用 does not，guarantee 恢复原形；help sb do 中 accumulate 不加 s。中文“靠努力”在这里用 through 短语表达手段。

第2自然段
01—05

My tutor believes that vocabulary becomes more memorable when a learner meets each phrase in a meaningful context.

我的辅导老师认为，当学习者在有意义的语境中接触每个短语时，词汇会更容易记住。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 My tutor + believes + that 宾语从句；宾从主干 vocabulary + becomes + more memorable（表语）；when 从句说明条件性的时间背景。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“认为”的内容可以是一整句话，用 that 接入；中文“词汇更好记”可直接用形容词，英文这里需要 becomes 把主语和状态连接起来。

01—06

We analyze the structure of an original sentence, identify its subject and verb, and then imitate its pattern.

我们分析一个原创句子的结构，找出主语和动词，再模仿它的句式。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主语 We；三个并列谓语 analyze、identify、imitate；各有宾语；then 是副词，表示先后。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
把中文连续动作整理成共用主语的并列结构，最后一个动作前用 and。its 指这个句子的；不要把 then 当成能独立连接两个完整句子的连词。

01—07

A clear explanation can distinguish a formal expression from an informal one and prevent a common misunderstanding.

清楚的解释可以区分正式表达和非正式表达，并避免一种常见误解。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A clear explanation（主语）+ can distinguish... and prevent...（并列谓语）；distinguish A from B；one 代替 expression。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“把两者区分开”，英文选固定结构 distinguish A from B。can 同时管两个动词，因此 prevent 不加 s，也不用重复 can。

01—08

If an instructor asks us to hyphenate a compound, we check a reliable reference instead of making a random guess.

如果老师让我们给一个复合词加连字符，我们会查可靠的参考资料，而不是胡乱猜测。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 条件从句：an instructor + asks + us + to hyphenate...；主句 we + check + a reliable reference；instead of 后接 making。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“我们查资料”，再加 if 条件。ask sb to do 表示让某人做；of 是介词，后面的动作要用 making，不能直接用 make。

第3自然段
01—09

I would gain more from a short, effective review than from a long session in which I am completely unaware of my mistakes.

比起长时间学习却完全没意识到错误，我会从简短而有效的复习中获益更多。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + would gain + more；than...比较；in which...定从修饰 session；从句 I + am + completely unaware...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
would 表假设下会怎样，不是简单过去时；gain from 表从中获得。unaware 为形容词，需 am；of 引出未意识到的对象。

01—10

Students generally tend to forget a rare word unless they actively recall its meaning and repeatedly use it in various contexts.

学生通常容易忘记罕见词，除非主动回想其含义，并在不同语境中反复使用。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Students + generally tend + to forget...；unless 从句 they + recall... and use...；actively、repeatedly 修饰动作。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tend to do 表往往会；unless 表除非，后面放完整主谓。中文“一般容易忘”在这里整理成副词 generally 加 tend to 的结构。

01—11

To enhance the quality of learning, I adopt a practical strategy and regularly adjust the pace instead of trying to absorb everything immediately.

为提高学习质量，我采用实际策略并定期调整节奏，而不是试图立刻吸收全部内容。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
To enhance...目的；I + adopt... and adjust...；instead of trying + to absorb...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
adopt 在这里是采用，不是收养；absorb 是吸收知识的比喻义。instead of 后 trying，再由 try to 决定 absorb 的原形。

01—12

This adjustment helps me cope with a heavy load, prioritize the hardest task, and fully understand at least one key idea each day.

这种调整帮助我应付繁重任务、优先处理最难的任务，并每天充分理解至少一个关键观点。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
This adjustment + helps + me + cope... prioritize... and understand...；cope with...；at least 修饰数量。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
help 后并列三个原形；at least 是至少，不能只写 least one。fully 修饰 understand；中文“每天”可放句末作时间状语。

第4自然段
01—13

A student who receives an award may feel grateful, but external recognition is not the sole source of lasting motivation.

获奖学生可能感激，但外界认可不是持久动力的唯一来源。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A student + may feel + grateful；who receives an award 定从；but 后 external recognition + is not + the sole source...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
grateful 为感激的，gratitude 为感激名词；feel 后用形容词。who 指学生作从句主语，receives 加 s。

01—14

I am keen to improve, yet I do not want the pursuit of excellence to turn into a nightmare of constant comparison.

我渴望进步，却不愿追求优秀变成不断比较的噩梦。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + am + keen + to improve；yet 后 I + do not want + the pursuit of excellence + to turn into...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
be keen to do 表渴望；want sth to do 让某事发生的愿望。pursuit 是追求的名词，不是主句第二个谓语。

01—15

A realistic mindset allows me to honor a small accomplishment and acknowledge that progress is normally uneven.

务实心态使我能珍视小成就，并承认进步通常并不均匀。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A realistic mindset + allows + me + to honor... and acknowledge...；that progress is normally uneven 为宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
honor 在这里为动词尊重/给予荣誉，按表中荣誉相关义理解；normally 为副词。progress 不可数，在从句用 is。

01—16

I can strive for a higher standard without demanding that every attempt be outstanding or every day feel super productive.

我可以追求更高标准，而不要求每次尝试都杰出、每天都特别有成效。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + can strive + for...；without demanding...；that 后 every attempt + be...，every day + feel...为要求型虚拟语气。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
demand 表要求时，正式英语 that 从句可用动词原形 be/feel；super 在此是非正式副词非常，写正式作文时宜换 very/highly。

第5自然段
01—17

At kindergarten, children commonly learn to share stuff, follow a simple rule, and interact with a mixed group of classmates.

幼儿园里，孩子通常学习分享东西、遵守简单规则，并与不同成员组成的同学群体互动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
children + commonly learn + to share... follow... and interact...；At kindergarten 表阶段和场所。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
stuff 是非正式不可数名词东西；interact with 表与谁互动。mixed 在此为混合组成的，不是主句过去时。

01—18

A child may naturally associate a teacher's tone with approval, so adults should be aware of how their words affect confidence.

孩子可能自然地把老师语气与认可相联系，因此成年人应意识到话语怎样影响信心。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A child + may associate + tone + with approval；so 后 adults + should be aware + of how 宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
associate A with B 表联想；be aware of 后可以接 how 从句。aware 不是动词，必须保留 be。

01—19

An interested teen can engage in a series of creative activities that motivate learning and cultivate a unique style.

感兴趣的青少年可以参与一系列创意活动，活动能激发学习动力并培养独特风格。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An interested teen + can engage + in a series...；that motivate... and cultivate...定从修饰 activities。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
engage in 表参与；interested 描述人感兴趣，interesting 描述事物有趣。that 在这里指复数 activities，所以 motivate/cultivate 不加 s。

01—20

Although innovation is important, a school should not ban dreaming or treat a quiet nerd as someone who does not belong.

尽管创新重要，学校也不应禁止想象，或把安静的技术迷当成没有归属的人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Although 从句 innovation + is + important；主句 school + should not ban... or treat...；who does not belong 定从修饰 someone。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
ban 后可接 dreaming 名词性活动；nerd 带口语色彩，情境中不用于贬低。belong 此处为有归属感，不需要再硬接宾语。

ARTICLE 02 / 20

02 · 在学校里寻找适合自己的路

约294个英文词 · 16句 · 含99个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖91个词条

The campus library provides accessible educational material for students who cannot afford private tuition. Our study group includes a freshman, a graduate student, and an international peer whose academic background is different from mine. We exchange notes, discuss an abstract concept, and give constructive feedback without judging anyone's intelligence. This combination of independent preparation and collaboration strengthens our understanding and gives us a sense of belonging.

A coeducational academy hopes to educate every child fairly, including those from disadvantaged families and minority communities. Its curriculum combines literacy, mathematics, art, and practical craft so that each third grader can explore a broad range of interests. An educator may use gamification to stimulate curiosity, while a faculty member checks whether the content meets each child's needs. The principal seeks a grant to expand the library and equip each classroom with a tablet and visual teaching aids.

A secondary school student may apply to an overseas institution after considering the tuition fee, schooling system, and admission requirement. An ambitious candidate might seek a scholarship because even a small saving on tuition could make overseas study more affordable. Before we recommend a profession, an adviser should discuss the student's talent, ambition, and preferred lifestyle. A degree can broaden a person's perspective, but fame and a superior rank do not necessarily guarantee a fulfilling lifetime.

A senior instructor notices that an eager learner is unable to solve a puzzle despite spending extra time on it. Instead of calling the student lazy, the teacher tries to identify the root of the confusion and offer appropriate guidance. A useful tip is to draw a simple diagram, highlight the relevant information, and explain the reasoning aloud. With sufficient practice, the student can acquire confidence, work independently, and eventually accomplish a challenging assignment.

第1自然段
02—01

The campus library provides accessible educational material for students who cannot afford private tuition.

校园图书馆为付不起私人辅导费用的学生提供容易获取的教育资料。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The campus library + provides + accessible educational material；for students 为受益对象；who...定语从句修饰 students。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“图书馆提供资料”，再补“给哪些学生”。中文把“付不起费用的”放学生前，英文用 who 从句放 students 后，便于展开完整动作。

02—02

Our study group includes a freshman, a graduate student, and an international peer whose academic background is different from mine.

我们的小组包括一名大一学生、一名研究生和一名学术背景与我不同的国际学生同伴。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Our study group + includes + 三个并列宾语；whose academic background is different from mine 为定语从句，修饰最后的 peer。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
whose 表“这个同伴的”，在从句中限定 background；mine 代替 my academic background，不能只写 me，因为比较的是背景而非人。

02—03

We exchange notes, discuss an abstract concept, and give constructive feedback without judging anyone's intelligence.

我们交换笔记，讨论一个抽象概念，并给予建设性反馈，不评判任何人的智力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We 为共同主语；exchange、discuss、give 为并列谓语；without judging...为方式状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
discuss 是及物动词，直接接 concept，不写 discuss about。without 是介词，后接 judging；中文连续动作在这里通过并列动词组织。

02—04

This combination of independent preparation and collaboration strengthens our understanding and gives us a sense of belonging.

独立准备与合作相结合，加深了我们的理解，也给了我们归属感。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主语 This combination of...；并列谓语 strengthens、gives；gives 后 us 为间接宾语，a sense of belonging 为直接宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
真正主语中心词是单数 combination，后面虽有 and 连接的两个成分，谓语仍用 strengthens/gives。belonging 是名词化形式，这里表示归属感，不是句中的独立谓语。

第2自然段
02—05

A coeducational academy hopes to educate every child fairly, including those from disadvantaged families and minority communities.

一所男女同校的学校希望公平教育每个孩子，包括弱势家庭和少数群体社区的孩子。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A coeducational academy + hopes + to educate...；including those...补充范围；those 代替 children。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
those 指人群，不是指家庭；from...说明来源。fairly 修饰 educate 用副词，而 fair 若放此处就不能准确修饰动作。

02—06

Its curriculum combines literacy, mathematics, art, and practical craft so that each third grader can explore a broad range of interests.

课程结合读写、数学、艺术和实用手工，让每名三年级学生都能探索广泛兴趣。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Its curriculum + combines + 并列宾语；so that 从句 each third grader + can explore + a broad range of interests。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
grader 通常与年级数连用，third grader 表三年级学生；range of...表达一系列。目的从句明确学生是 explore 的执行者。

02—07

An educator may use gamification to stimulate curiosity, while a faculty member checks whether the content meets each child's needs.

教育工作者可以用游戏化激发好奇心，同时一名教员检查内容是否满足每个孩子的需要。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 An educator + may use + gamification；to stimulate...表目的；while 分句中含 whether 宾语从句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
use A to do 表使用方法达到目标；whether 从句 content meets...用陈述语序。faculty member 指教员，不是把 faculty 单独误译为个人。

02—08

The principal seeks a grant to expand the library and equip each classroom with a tablet and visual teaching aids.

校长寻求拨款，以扩建图书馆并为每间教室配备平板电脑和视觉教具。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The principal + seeks + a grant；to expand... and equip...为目的；equip A with B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
principal 在这里为名词校长；equip 后先放被装备的教室，再用 with 引出设备。aids 此处是教具，不是动词帮助。

第3自然段
02—09

A secondary school student may apply to an overseas institution after considering the tuition fee, schooling system, and admission requirement.

中学生在考虑学费、学校教育体系和录取要求后，可能申请海外院校。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A secondary school student + may apply + to an overseas institution；after considering...为时间状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
apply to 指申请某机构，与 apply for 申请某职位/项目区分。considering 的逻辑主语是学生，后面三个名词都是考虑对象。

02—10

An ambitious candidate might seek a scholarship because even a small saving on tuition could make overseas study more affordable.

有抱负的申请人可能寻求奖学金，因为即使在学费上省下一点钱，也能让海外学习更负担得起。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 An ambitious candidate + might seek + a scholarship；because 从句 a small saving on tuition + could make + overseas study + more affordable（宾补）。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
saving 在此是节省下来的金额；on tuition 说明省在哪方面。make A more affordable 表让某事更能负担，不写 make A is more affordable。

02—11

Before we recommend a profession, an adviser should discuss the student's talent, ambition, and preferred lifestyle.

在推荐职业之前，顾问应讨论学生的天赋、抱负和偏好的生活方式。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Before 从句 we + recommend + a profession；主句 an adviser + should discuss + 三个宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
recommend 在这里接职业，discuss 直接接讨论内容。we 与 adviser 不完全相同，因此保留完整 before 从句，没有压缩成 before recommending。

02—12

A degree can broaden a person's perspective, but fame and a superior rank do not necessarily guarantee a fulfilling lifetime.

学位能拓宽人的视角，但名气和更高排名不一定保证充实的一生。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A degree + can broaden + a person's perspective；分句② fame and a superior rank + do not necessarily guarantee...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
not necessarily 表不一定，不能译成一定不。并列主语 fame and rank 用 do；guarantee 在助动词后用原形。

第4自然段
02—13

A senior instructor notices that an eager learner is unable to solve a puzzle despite spending extra time on it.

资深教师注意到，一名渴望学习的学生尽管多花时间，仍无法解开难题。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 A senior instructor + notices + that 宾从；宾从 learner + is + unable；to solve...补充 unable；despite spending...让步状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
unable 是形容词，必须有 is；despite 是介词，后用 spending，而不是直接接完整的 he spends。中文“尽管花了……”英文要选择对应结构。

02—14

Instead of calling the student lazy, the teacher tries to identify the root of the confusion and offer appropriate guidance.

老师不称学生懒惰，而是尝试找出困惑根源并给出适当指导。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the teacher + tries + to identify... and offer...；Instead of calling + the student + lazy 中 lazy 为宾补。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
call sb lazy 表称某人为懒惰的；lazy 是形容词宾补。tries to 后面并列两个原形动作，不能把 offer 再写成 offers。

02—15

A useful tip is to draw a simple diagram, highlight the relevant information, and explain the reasoning aloud.

一项实用建议是画简单图示、突出相关信息，并大声解释推理过程。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A useful tip + is + 三个并列不定式内容；to draw... highlight... and explain...作表语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“建议是做……”英文可用 be + to do；后两个 to 可省。这里 draw 不是命令句谓语，而是说明建议内容的不定式组成部分。

02—16

With sufficient practice, the student can acquire confidence, work independently, and eventually accomplish a challenging assignment.

经过充分练习，学生可以建立信心、独立学习，并最终完成有挑战性的作业。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
With sufficient practice 为条件背景；the student + can acquire... work... and accomplish...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
independently 修饰 work，eventually 修饰 accomplish；中文副词常在动词前，英文也可放动词后，取决于修饰关系和自然表达。

本篇用到哪些词表词

system, academic, material, apply, solve, seek, identify, extra, intelligence, educational, curiosity, range, despite, explore, talent, concept, teaching, expand, graduate, recommend, saving, assignment, eventually, lifestyle, understanding, necessarily, unable, content, craft, curriculum, educator, senior, tip, acquire, confidence, gamification, institution, relevant, affordable, academy, ambitious, campus, fee, grant, peer, feedback, requirement, challenging, abstract, combination, eager, learner, perspective, puzzle, spending, sufficient, accomplish, candidate, guarantee, rank, schooling, stimulate, superior, tablet, tuition, accessible, adviser, ambition, broad, lifetime, overseas, preparation, reasoning, root, secondary, appropriate, confusion, freshman, highlight, independently, instructor, exchange, fairly, fame, grader, practical, profession, cannot, coeducational, collaboration, educate, equip, literacy, principal, scholarship, visual, disadvantaged, faculty, minority

ARTICLE 03 / 20

03 · 从问题、数据到一篇有逻辑的文章

约374个英文词 · 20句 · 含109个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖100个词条

An author needs a central theme, a logical argument, and concrete evidence before writing a persuasive essay. The introduction should define the issue, whereas the following paragraph should illustrate the main point with a specific instance. When we cite a scholar, we must convey the exact meaning and acknowledge the source rather than merely copy a statement. Finally, a reader should be able to trace the reasoning from the initial assumption to the conclusion.

A researcher and a professor plan to conduct a scientific study on the relationship between sleep and cognitive performance. Each participant will complete a questionnaire, and every respondent will receive a small reward for their time. The team will analyze a representative sample and assess whether the observed pattern is statistically significant. Before publishing a finding, the author must explain the method, acknowledge each limitation, and avoid claiming a universal truth.

A statistic may summarize a general trend, but one datum cannot represent the diversity of an entire population. An economist compares the annual growth rate with the previous decade and calculates the percentage change in household income. A quantitative analysis should report the exact amount, the average value, and the proportion of missing records. Although the figure looks impressive, a careful reader should question the assumption on which the estimate is based.

A teacher draws a chart and uses a numerical index to show the frequency with which an event can occur. An anumeric category describes something non-numerical, so the class should not confuse a label with a measurable quantity. The instructor asks us to use the same formula consistently and to state precisely what each symbol represents. A mistake in the calculation does not imply a complete inability to reason, but it does indicate a need for careful checking.

A theory is not merely a guess; it should offer an explanation that can be tested against an observable pattern. An ideal experiment can isolate a factor, compare multiple conditions, and reveal an implication that was previously unclear. A major discovery may emerge gradually, and a negative result can be beneficial if it helps us reject a wrong explanation. We should remain optimistic without assuming that every result is positive or that scientific progress follows a perfectly regular cycle.

第1自然段
03—01

An author needs a central theme, a logical argument, and concrete evidence before writing a persuasive essay.

作者在写一篇有说服力的文章之前，需要中心主题、合乎逻辑的论证和具体证据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An author + needs + 三个并列宾语；before writing...是时间状语，writing 的逻辑主语与 author 一致。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先列“作者需要什么”，统一放 needs 后。中文名词常不标数量；英文 author、theme、argument、essay 都是可数单数，这里各要有 a/an 等限定词。

03—02

The introduction should define the issue, whereas the following paragraph should illustrate the main point with a specific instance.

引言应界定问题，而接下来的段落应以具体实例说明主要观点。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
两个分句主语分别是 The introduction、the following paragraph；谓语 should define、should illustrate；whereas 连接对照。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“而”在此表示两部分的分工，用 whereas。should 后接原形；with a specific instance 表示用什么说明，放在核心观点后补充。

03—03

When we cite a scholar, we must convey the exact meaning and acknowledge the source rather than merely copy a statement.

引用学者的话时，我们必须传达确切含义并注明来源，而不能只是抄一项陈述。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 we + cite + a scholar；主句 we + must convey... and acknowledge...；rather than 引出对比动作 copy。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
三个动作围绕同一个 we；must 后用原形。中文常省“我们”，这里保留以明确责任主体；exact 修饰名词 meaning，merely 修饰动词 copy。

03—04

Finally, a reader should be able to trace the reasoning from the initial assumption to the conclusion.

最后，读者应能沿着推理过程，从最初的假设追溯到结论。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a reader + should be able to trace + the reasoning；from...to...说明推理的起点和终点；Finally 是篇章副词。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
英文把“能够”写成 be able to，前面已有 should，所以 be 保持原形。中文“从……到……”在这里保留为 from...to...，围绕 trace 展开。

第2自然段
03—05

A researcher and a professor plan to conduct a scientific study on the relationship between sleep and cognitive performance.

一名研究人员和一位教授计划开展一项关于睡眠与认知表现关系的科学研究。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主语 A researcher and a professor；谓语 plan；宾语为 to conduct...；on...修饰 study；between A and B 说明关系双方。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两个不同的人用 and 组成复数主语，因此 plan 不加 s。中文“研究……关系”可直接说，英文在 study 后用 on 明确研究主题。

03—06

Each participant will complete a questionnaire, and every respondent will receive a small reward for their time.

每位参与者都会填写问卷，每位答卷者也会因付出的时间得到一份小奖励。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
两个并列分句：Each participant + will complete...；every respondent + will receive...；for their time 表奖励缘由。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
each/every 后用单数名词；their 可指性别未明确的单个参与者。will 后不因主语单数而加 s，因为变化由助动词承担。

03—07

The team will analyze a representative sample and assess whether the observed pattern is statistically significant.

团队会分析具有代表性的样本，并评估观察到的模式是否在统计上显著。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The team + will analyze... and assess...；whether...为 assess 的宾语从句，主语 the observed pattern，系表 is statistically significant。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“是否……”用 whether 引出；宾语从句保持陈述顺序 pattern is，不能改成疑问句 is the pattern。observed 为过去分词作定语。

03—08

Before publishing a finding, the author must explain the method, acknowledge each limitation, and avoid claiming a universal truth.

发表研究发现之前，作者必须解释方法、承认各项局限，并避免声称得出了普遍真理。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Before publishing...时间状语；the author + must explain... acknowledge... and avoid...；claiming...为 avoid 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
avoid 后接动名词 claiming，而非 to claim；publishing 与 claiming 都不是独立谓语。中文动作可连续出现，英文要逐一确认受哪个结构管辖。

第3自然段
03—09

A statistic may summarize a general trend, but one datum cannot represent the diversity of an entire population.

一项统计数值可能概括总体趋势，但一个数据点不能代表整个人群的多样性。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A statistic + may summarize + a general trend；分句② one datum + cannot represent + the diversity...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
datum 是 data 的单数形式，这里特意指单个数据点；不要把一个点与总体趋势等同。of an entire population 限定多样性属于谁。

03—10

An economist compares the annual growth rate with the previous decade and calculates the percentage change in household income.

经济学家把年度增长率与前一个十年的增长率作比较，并计算家庭收入的百分比变化。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An economist + compares... and calculates...；with the previous decade 为对前一时期的省略表达；in household income 修饰 change。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
比较的实际对象是两个时期的增长率，中文翻译把被省略的内容补足。复数动作共用单数主语，两个一般现在时谓语都加 s。

03—11

A quantitative analysis should report the exact amount, the average value, and the proportion of missing records.

定量分析应报告确切数量、平均值以及缺失记录的比例。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A quantitative analysis + should report + 三个并列宾语；of missing records 修饰 proportion。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
英文将三个“报告内容”都作为 report 的宾语，最后用 and。missing 在这里是形容词性质的修饰语，不是现在进行时。

03—12

Although the figure looks impressive, a careful reader should question the assumption on which the estimate is based.

尽管数字看起来很惊人，细心的读者仍应质疑这个估计所依据的假设。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Although 从句 the figure + looks + impressive；主句 a careful reader + should question + the assumption；on which...定语从句修饰 assumption。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
based on 表依据；定语从句把介词 on 提到 which 前。中文“所依据的假设”前置，英文先写 assumption，再补依据关系；although 不与 but 重复使用。

第4自然段
03—13

A teacher draws a chart and uses a numerical index to show the frequency with which an event can occur.

老师画图，并用数值指数展示某事件可能发生的频率。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A teacher + draws... and uses...；to show...表目的；with which an event can occur 定从修饰 frequency。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
frequency with which...较书面，意思是事件发生所具有的频率；occur 为不及物动词，不接宾语。“事件发生”不能写 is occur。

03—14

An anumeric category describes something non-numerical, so the class should not confuse a label with a measurable quantity.

anumeric 这一非数字类别描述非数值事物，因此全班不应把标签与可测数量混淆。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An anumeric category + describes...；so 后 the class + should not confuse + a label + with a measurable quantity。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
anumeric 是原表中的罕见形容词，按“非数字的”使用；常见说法是 non-numerical。本句为释义情境，避免把罕见词硬当常用四级表达。

03—15

The instructor asks us to use the same formula consistently and to state precisely what each symbol represents.

教师要求我们一致地使用同一公式，并准确说明每个符号代表什么。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The instructor + asks + us + to use... and to state...；what each symbol represents 为 state 的宾从，what 作 represents 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
what 在从句里兼有“什么”的内容和宾语作用，不能再补 it。consistently、precisely 都是修饰操作的副词。

03—16

A mistake in the calculation does not imply a complete inability to reason, but it does indicate a need for careful checking.

计算出错不意味着完全没有推理能力，但确实表明需要认真检查。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A mistake... + does not imply...；分句② it + does indicate...；for careful checking 修饰 need。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
后句 does 用于强调，所以 indicate 保持原形。imply 表意味着，indicate 表表明；a need for...比逐字翻“需要去检查的”更自然。

第5自然段
03—17

A theory is not merely a guess; it should offer an explanation that can be tested against an observable pattern.

理论不只是猜测；它应提供能与可观察模式对照检验的解释。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A theory + is not + merely a guess；分号后 it + should offer + an explanation；that can be tested...定从修饰 explanation。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
分号连接相关独立句；tested 为被动，因为解释接受检验。against 在这里表对照基准，不是空间上的反对方向。

03—18

An ideal experiment can isolate a factor, compare multiple conditions, and reveal an implication that was previously unclear.

理想实验能分离某个因素、比较多种条件，并揭示此前不清楚的含义。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An ideal experiment + can isolate... compare... and reveal...；that was previously unclear 定从修饰 implication。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
unclear 是 was 后的表语；previously 修饰过去状态。multiple 后用复数 conditions，中文“多种条件”英文需标复数。

03—19

A major discovery may emerge gradually, and a negative result can be beneficial if it helps us reject a wrong explanation.

重大发现可能逐渐浮现，负面结果若有助于排除错误解释，也可能有益。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A major discovery + may emerge；分句② a negative result + can be + beneficial；if 从句 it + helps + us + reject...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
beneficial 为形容词，需要 be；emerge 为动词不加 be。reject 原形受 help us 结构管辖，与 result 的单数无关。

03—20

We should remain optimistic without assuming that every result is positive or that scientific progress follows a perfectly regular cycle.

我们应保持乐观，但不假定每项结果都是积极的，也不假定科学进步遵循完全规律的周期。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + should remain + optimistic；without assuming...；assuming 后并列 that 宾从 result is positive、progress follows...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
remain 后接 optimistic 形容词；without 的否定作用覆盖假设内容。or 连接两个并列假设，中文可译为“也不”。

本篇用到哪些词表词

author, researcher, participant, relationship, professor, decade, finding, average, amount, issue, rate, factor, growth, major, event, performance, positive, negative, reward, wrong, evidence, source, scientific, conduct, figure, trend, reveal, specific, writing, income, regular, pattern, previous, finally, occur, significant, essay, indicate, household, instance, diversity, theory, argument, represent, estimate, formula, analysis, central, cognitive, define, economist, cycle, reader, gradually, multiple, quantity, ideal, annual, entire, datum, emerge, implication, imply, acknowledge, following, missing, respondent, analyze, beneficial, percentage, previously, statement, assess, label, sample, statistic, theme, assumption, optimistic, reasoning, scholar, trace, whereas, cite, concrete, convey, exact, initial, instructor, explanation, category, consistently, illustrate, proportion, reject, universal, anumeric, cannot, frequency, index, logical, representative, unclear, confuse, inability, merely, precisely, quantitative, symbol

ARTICLE 04 / 20

04 · 从第一份实习到做出真实产品

约298个英文词 · 16句 · 含108个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖97个词条

A prospective employer may value practical capability more than an impressive certificate, especially when an applicant has no prior employment experience. My advisor encouraged me to develop a software project that could demonstrate engineering skills and analytical thinking. Before graduation, I intend to submit an application for a paid internship and attach a brief description of my contribution. Even if a recruiter rejects me, I can assess the gap, improve my performance, and seek another opportunity.

Our startup wants to design a digital product that enables a local customer to manage a small business more efficiently. The founder asked a developer to write clear code, test every function, and remove any error before the launch. We install the latest version on a laptop, update the user manual, and record each technical limitation in a file. A reliable system should process data accurately, protect privacy, and remain stable when the internet connection fails.

Artificial intelligence can automate a routine task, but it cannot replace every aspect of human creativity and professional judgment. An innovative firm may employ fewer workers in production while creating new positions in research, marketing, and security. The transition requires technological training because a skilled workforce is essential to long-term productivity. Rather than assume that every algorithm is neutral, an analyst should investigate bias and evaluate its potential impact.

A small tech venture uses crowdfunding to finance an innovative device that converts sunlight into electricity. An investor wants to know whether the idea is profitable, whether the design is feasible, and how the team will compete. The chief executive must explain the firm's asset base, negotiate with a sponsor, and describe the financial risk honestly. If the initial funding runs out, the team may need to redesign the product or split the project into smaller phases.

第1自然段
04—01

A prospective employer may value practical capability more than an impressive certificate, especially when an applicant has no prior employment experience.

未来可能雇用你的雇主可能更看重实际能力，而不是亮眼的证书，尤其当申请人没有先前工作经历时。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 A prospective employer + may value + practical capability；more than...比较；when 从句 an applicant + has + no prior employment experience。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先说“雇主看重能力”，再补比较和条件。中文“没有”可直接作谓语；英文用 has no，把 no 放在名词短语前，不写 has not experience。

04—02

My advisor encouraged me to develop a software project that could demonstrate engineering skills and analytical thinking.

我的指导老师鼓励我开发一个能展示工程技能和分析思维的软件项目。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
My advisor + encouraged + me + to develop...；that could demonstrate...为定语从句，that 作从句主语，修饰 project。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
把“项目能展示技能”放到 project 后，用 that 接起来；encourage sb to do 是动词搭配。中文前置长定语在英文里通常拆到名词后面。

04—03

Before graduation, I intend to submit an application for a paid internship and attach a brief description of my contribution.

毕业之前，我打算提交一份带薪实习申请，并附上我所作贡献的简要说明。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
时间状语 Before graduation；I + intend + to submit... and attach...；my contribution 是 of 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
intend to do 表打算；submit 和 attach 共用前面的 to。paid 在这里是形容词“有报酬的”，不是句中第二个过去时谓语。

04—04

Even if a recruiter rejects me, I can assess the gap, improve my performance, and seek another opportunity.

即使招聘人员拒绝我，我也能评估差距、改进表现并寻找另一个机会。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Even if 让步从句 a recruiter + rejects + me；主句 I + can assess... improve... and seek...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“即使”表达让步，用 even if；从句说一种可能情形，采用一般现在时。can 管后面三个原形，不能因 I 后已有动词就把后面都改成 ing。

第2自然段
04—05

Our startup wants to design a digital product that enables a local customer to manage a small business more efficiently.

我们的初创公司想设计一款数字产品，使本地客户能更高效地管理小生意。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Our startup + wants + to design...；that enables...定语从句修饰 product；enables + a local customer + to manage...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先确定产品“让客户能够管理”，选择 enable sb to do；that 是从句主语，指单数 product，所以用 enables。efficiently 修饰管理动作。

04—06

The founder asked a developer to write clear code, test every function, and remove any error before the launch.

创始人让一名开发者编写清晰的代码、测试每项功能，并在发布前排除任何错误。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The founder + asked + a developer + to write... test... and remove...；before the launch 是时间状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
ask sb to do 的 to 后可并列多个动作。code 在此为不可数名词，不写 a code 来表示整段程序；any error 强调任何一个错误。

04—07

We install the latest version on a laptop, update the user manual, and record each technical limitation in a file.

我们在笔记本电脑上安装最新版本，更新用户手册，并把每项技术限制记录在文件中。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + install... update... and record...；on a laptop 表设备；in a file 表存放位置。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“装到电脑上”“记在文件里”都像结果，英文分别选 on 和 in 表位置关系。latest 是最高级性质的修饰语，前面通常加 the。

04—08

A reliable system should process data accurately, protect privacy, and remain stable when the internet connection fails.

可靠的系统应准确处理数据、保护隐私，并在互联网连接出故障时保持稳定。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A reliable system + should process... protect... and remain...；stable 是 remain 后的表语；when 从句 connection + fails。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
remain 表“保持某种状态”，后接形容词 stable，不接 stably。中文可以连说三个要求，英文用同一情态动词 should 统领它们。

第3自然段
04—09

Artificial intelligence can automate a routine task, but it cannot replace every aspect of human creativity and professional judgment.

人工智能能使一项常规任务自动化，但无法替代人类创造力和专业判断的所有方面。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① Artificial intelligence + can automate + a routine task；分句② it + cannot replace + every aspect...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先区分“能做”和“不能全替代”，用 but 连接。cannot 是 can 的否定形式；every aspect 的中心词是单数 aspect，不能写 every aspects。

04—10

An innovative firm may employ fewer workers in production while creating new positions in research, marketing, and security.

创新型公司可能在生产环节雇用更少员工，同时在研究、营销和安全方面创造新岗位。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An innovative firm + may employ + fewer workers；while creating...为省略结构，其动作主体同为 firm。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
workers 可数，用 fewer；与不可数数量比较的 less 区分。while creating 的完整意思是 while it creates，主体相同才能这样简化。

04—11

The transition requires technological training because a skilled workforce is essential to long-term productivity.

这种转变需要技术培训，因为熟练的劳动队伍对长期生产率至关重要。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 The transition + requires + technological training；because 原因从句 a skilled workforce + is + essential；to...补充 essential 的对象。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“需要”选 require 直接接宾语；“对……必不可少”用 be essential to。because 后必须有完整主谓结构，不能只接一个名词当此处的原因从句。

04—12

Rather than assume that every algorithm is neutral, an analyst should investigate bias and evaluate its potential impact.

分析人员应调查偏差并评估其潜在影响，而不是假定每种算法都是中立的。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 an analyst + should investigate... and evaluate...；Rather than assume...为对比状语；that every algorithm is neutral 为 assume 的宾语从句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写核心建议，再把“不要盲目假设”前置。neutral 是形容词，在宾从里需要 is；不能照中文“算法中立”省去系动词。

第4自然段
04—13

A small tech venture uses crowdfunding to finance an innovative device that converts sunlight into electricity.

小型科技企业用众筹为创新设备融资，这种设备把日光转化为电能。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A small tech venture + uses + crowdfunding；to finance...表目的；that converts...定语从句修饰 device。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
finance 在这里是动词资助；convert A into B 表转化。that 指 device，因此 converts 用单数；不是 crowdfunding 在转换阳光。

04—14

An investor wants to know whether the idea is profitable, whether the design is feasible, and how the team will compete.

投资人想知道想法是否盈利、设计是否可行，以及团队将如何竞争。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An investor + wants + to know；know 后三个并列宾语从句：whether...、whether...、how...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
三个问题嵌入句子后都采用陈述语序；profitable、feasible 为形容词，需要 is。最后 compete 没有直接宾语，是竞争动作本身。

04—15

The chief executive must explain the firm's asset base, negotiate with a sponsor, and describe the financial risk honestly.

首席执行官必须解释公司资产基础、与赞助方谈判，并诚实描述财务风险。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The chief executive + must explain... negotiate... and describe...；with a sponsor 为谈判对方；honestly 修饰 describe。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
base 此处为名词基础；risk 为名词风险。negotiate with 接人，negotiate a contract 接事项，不能不分对象机械套同一介词。

04—16

If the initial funding runs out, the team may need to redesign the product or split the project into smaller phases.

如果初始资金用尽，团队可能需要重新设计产品，或把项目分成较小阶段。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 the initial funding + runs out；主句 the team + may need + to redesign... or split...；split A into B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
run out 为用尽，不接直接宾语；phase 的复数为 phases。need to 下两个备选动作保持平行，不把 split 改成 splitting。

本篇用到哪些词表词

system, local, design, product, customer, process, risk, financial, impact, base, project, opportunity, digital, data, professional, performance, potential, security, connection, device, seek, internet, employer, intelligence, replace, function, remove, firm, thinking, code, launch, user, software, assume, creativity, engineering, application, essential, executive, productivity, chief, production, artificial, gap, innovative, technological, update, workforce, install, routine, applicant, aspect, investigate, contribution, funding, analytical, compete, error, graduation, venture, demonstrate, employment, latest, marketing, stable, bias, intend, submit, analyst, assess, sunlight, tech, attach, employ, initial, investor, reliable, skilled, description, finance, negotiate, sponsor, transition, certificate, practical, profitable, version, asset, cannot, capability, crowdfunding, evaluate, file, laptop, paid, prior, privacy, split, startup, accurately, advisor, feasible, founder, honestly, manual, neutral, prospective, redesign

ARTICLE 05 / 20

05 · 工作、收入与公平的团队

约522个英文词 · 28句 · 含164个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖143个词条

An employee may prefer remote working because a flexible arrangement reduces the time spent on transportation. However, an employer must ensure that every colleague has the equipment and access needed to perform their duties effectively. A manager can set clear expectations, offer timely feedback, and judge the outcome rather than constantly monitor each worker. When trust and responsibility grow together, the workplace is more likely to maintain both efficiency and satisfaction.

Equal pay for equal labor is a fundamental principle, regardless of gender, age, or ethnic background. A corporate policy should prohibit discrimination and provide a transparent basis for salary increases, bonuses, and promotion. If an executive denies a worker a fair wage, the union can request an investigation and negotiate a better contract. Such negotiation may involve compromise, but recognition of each person's contribution remains crucial to long-term commitment.

A worker may quit a secure position to pursue a career that offers more freedom and a stronger sense of purpose. However, the prospect of unemployment can trigger anxiety, especially during an economic recession when few firms hire new staff. A job seeker should assess their financial resource, maintain a professional network, and prepare a realistic backup strategy. If a former colleague can introduce a promising opening, the applicant should respond promptly and show genuine interest.

Recently, several states have tried to boost employment in the service sector, where increasing demand can create a competitive market. A factory can earn a profit during a boom yet experience a sharp decline when a speculative bubble bursts. An economics department studies why a labor shortage may exist even while a large number of people remain unemployed. The overall challenge is to balance economic growth with welfare and ensure that a growing nation does not overlook poverty.

A project leader may be willing to highlight an outstanding achievement, but an honest report should also mention a serious setback. The report can attribute a failure to poor planning without blaming a particular coworker for every problem. A capable manager should emphasize the importance of communication and invite criticism from anyone involved in the task. A productive review identifies what went wrong, what improved, and what action could prevent a similar problem from happening again.

Good leadership involves more than assigning orders; it means helping diverse people collaborate toward a shared objective. A team can combine technical expertise with imagination and derive a novel solution from an open discussion. When members disagree, they should negotiate directly instead of allowing a small division to become a permanent obstacle. A clear consensus can ease tension, strengthen engagement, and create an incentive for each person to fulfill their responsibility.

A male applicant and a female applicant should be judged by the same standard rather than by an assumption about their sex. A workplace can advertise a position widely and recruit a diverse team without using age or gender as an unfair restriction. A promotion should reflect a person's ability to deliver results, not whether they fit a conventional image of leadership. Such equality can benefit a corporation and its staff alike by allowing talent to develop without a needless barrier.

第1自然段
05—01

An employee may prefer remote working because a flexible arrangement reduces the time spent on transportation.

员工可能更喜欢远程工作，因为灵活安排减少了花在交通上的时间。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 An employee + may prefer + remote working；because 从句 a flexible arrangement + reduces + the time；spent on...后置修饰 time。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“花在交通上的时间”前置修饰，英文用 spent on...置于 time 后；这里 spent 是过去分词，不是第二个完整谓语。

05—02

However, an employer must ensure that every colleague has the equipment and access needed to perform their duties effectively.

不过，雇主必须确保每位同事都有有效履职所需的设备和使用权限。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
an employer + must ensure + that 宾语从句；从句 every colleague + has + the equipment and access；needed...后置修饰它们。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
ensure that 后放完整陈述；every colleague 单数，所以 has。needed to perform 表“为履职所需要的”，不表示同事被需要。

05—03

A manager can set clear expectations, offer timely feedback, and judge the outcome rather than constantly monitor each worker.

管理者可以设定清楚的预期、及时反馈，并评价结果，而不是不断监控每名员工。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A manager + can set... offer... and judge...；rather than monitor...为对比动作；constantly 修饰 monitor。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
can 后所有并列动作保持原形。中文“评价结果而非监控”在英文仍可平行表达，注意 judge 和 monitor 都是动词，结构保持一致。

05—04

When trust and responsibility grow together, the workplace is more likely to maintain both efficiency and satisfaction.

当信任和责任共同增长时，工作场所更可能同时保持效率和满意度。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 trust and responsibility + grow；主句 the workplace + is + more likely；to maintain...补充 likely 的内容。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“更可能……”用 be more likely to do；likely 是形容词，此处要有 is。both A and B 表两者都，不能只保留 both 而漏掉 and。

第2自然段
05—05

Equal pay for equal labor is a fundamental principle, regardless of gender, age, or ethnic background.

不论性别、年龄或族裔背景如何，同工同酬都是一项基本原则。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Equal pay for equal labor（整体主语）+ is + a fundamental principle（表语）；regardless of...为让步状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“同工同酬是……”可转成名词短语作主语。regardless of 为介词结构，后列名词，不需要再加一个完整动词。

05—06

A corporate policy should prohibit discrimination and provide a transparent basis for salary increases, bonuses, and promotion.

公司政策应禁止歧视，并为加薪、奖金和晋升提供透明依据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A corporate policy + should prohibit... and provide...；a transparent basis 为宾语；for...限定依据适用于哪些事项。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“政策应禁止和提供”，再给 provide 补对象及用途。promotion 此处表示晋升过程，不是商品促销。

05—07

If an executive denies a worker a fair wage, the union can request an investigation and negotiate a better contract.

如果高管拒绝给予员工公平工资，工会可以要求调查，并协商更好的合同。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 an executive + denies + a worker + a fair wage；主句 the union + can request... and negotiate...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
deny sb sth 为双宾语结构，中文“不给某人工资”在这里对应拒绝给予。a better contract 的 better 只修饰合同，不是修饰 negotiate 的副词。

05—08

Such negotiation may involve compromise, but recognition of each person's contribution remains crucial to long-term commitment.

这种谈判可能涉及妥协，但认可每个人的贡献对长期投入仍然至关重要。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① Such negotiation + may involve + compromise；分句② recognition of... + remains + crucial；to...补充对象。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
recognition 是抽象名词，整个 of 短语虽长，中心词仍为单数 recognition，故 remains 加 s；crucial 是表语形容词。

第3自然段
05—09

A worker may quit a secure position to pursue a career that offers more freedom and a stronger sense of purpose.

劳动者可能辞去稳定职位，追求能带来更多自由与更强目标感的事业。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A worker + may quit + a secure position；to pursue...表目的；that offers...定语从句修饰 career。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
quit 直接接职位，不加 from。that 指单数 career，故 offers 加 s；more 与 stronger 分别构成不同形容词或数量词的比较。

05—10

However, the prospect of unemployment can trigger anxiety, especially during an economic recession when few firms hire new staff.

然而，失业前景可能引发焦虑，尤其在很少公司招聘新员工的经济衰退时期。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the prospect of unemployment + can trigger + anxiety；during...为时间；when...定语从句修饰 recession，few firms + hire + new staff。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
主语中心是 prospect，不是 unemployment。when 说明在该时期发生什么；staff 在此是员工集合名词，无需写成 staffs 表多名员工。

05—11

A job seeker should assess their financial resource, maintain a professional network, and prepare a realistic backup strategy.

求职者应评估自己的资金资源、维护专业人脉，并准备务实的后备策略。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A job seeker + should assess... maintain... and prepare...；their 回指求职者；financial resource 为一项可利用的财力。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
三个建议动作共用 should；network 在此是人脉网络而非计算机网络。英文建议句要选明确执行者 job seeker，不用中文式无主语碎片。

05—12

If a former colleague can introduce a promising opening, the applicant should respond promptly and show genuine interest.

如果前同事能介绍有前景的岗位空缺，申请人应及时回应并展现真诚兴趣。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 a former colleague + can introduce...；主句 the applicant + should respond... and show...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
opening 在这里指职位空缺，与球场空当、开口同源但语境不同。respond 无直接宾语；如果写回应某人需用 respond to。

第4自然段
05—13

Recently, several states have tried to boost employment in the service sector, where increasing demand can create a competitive market.

最近，几个州试图促进服务业就业，需求增加能在这一领域创造竞争激烈的市场。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 several states + have tried + to boost...；where 定从修饰 sector；从句 increasing demand + can create...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
states 这里是州的复数，不是“陈述”的动词；have tried 是现在完成时。increasing 修饰 demand，不能与后面 can create 一起误读为进行时。

05—14

A factory can earn a profit during a boom yet experience a sharp decline when a speculative bubble bursts.

工厂在繁荣期可以盈利，却可能在投机泡沫破裂时经历急剧下滑。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A factory + can earn... yet experience...；when 从句 a speculative bubble + bursts。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
yet 连接同主语的对照动作；decline 在这里是名词下滑。boom、bubble 都是经济语境的比喻，翻译需按语境而非字面声音和气泡。

05—15

An economics department studies why a labor shortage may exist even while a large number of people remain unemployed.

经济学系研究，为什么即使大量人口仍失业，劳动力短缺也可能存在。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An economics department + studies + why 宾从；shortage + may exist；even while 从句 people + remain + unemployed。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
economics 是学科名，department 才是单数中心词。exist 为存在的动词，不写 is exist；unemployed 是 remain 后的表语。

05—16

The overall challenge is to balance economic growth with welfare and ensure that a growing nation does not overlook poverty.

总体挑战是平衡经济增长与福利，并确保发展中的国家不忽视贫困。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The overall challenge + is + to balance... and ensure...；that 宾从 a growing nation + does not overlook + poverty。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
balance A with B 表协调两者；is 后 to do 表挑战内容。“国家不忽视”要用 does not + 原形 overlook，不能写 not overlooks。

第5自然段
05—17

A project leader may be willing to highlight an outstanding achievement, but an honest report should also mention a serious setback.

项目负责人可能愿意突出杰出成就，但诚实报告也应提到严重挫折。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A project leader + may be willing + to highlight...；but 后 an honest report + should mention...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
be willing to do 表愿意；willing 为形容词，所以 may 后还要 be。achievement 指成就，不应把所有工作结果都自动称为成就。

05—18

The report can attribute a failure to poor planning without blaming a particular coworker for every problem.

报告可以把失败归因于规划不善，而不把所有问题都归咎于某位同事。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The report + can attribute + a failure + to poor planning；without blaming...；blame sb for sth。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
attribute A to B 与 blame sb for sth 的介词不同；coworker 为同事。without 后用 blaming，不用 blame 原形。

05—19

A capable manager should emphasize the importance of communication and invite criticism from anyone involved in the task.

有能力的管理者应强调沟通的重要性，并邀请任务相关人员提出批评。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A capable manager + should emphasize... and invite...；from anyone involved in the task 修饰批评来源；involved...后置修饰 anyone。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
emphasize 是动词，不要写成名词 emphasis；involved 为过去分词修饰人，不能当作另一完整谓语。

05—20

A productive review identifies what went wrong, what improved, and what action could prevent a similar problem from happening again.

有成效的复盘找出哪里出了错、什么有了改善，以及什么行动能防止类似问题再发生。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A productive review + identifies + 三个 what 宾从；①what went wrong；②what improved；③what action could prevent...；prevent...from happening。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
前两个 what 自身作从句主语，第三个 what 限定 action。improved 在此作 improve 的过去式不及物谓语，符合原表改善义。

第6自然段
05—21

Good leadership involves more than assigning orders; it means helping diverse people collaborate toward a shared objective.

良好领导不只是分派命令，还意味着帮助不同的人朝共同目标合作。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Good leadership + involves...；分号后 it + means + helping...；helping + diverse people + collaborate...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
means 后用动名词 helping 表意味着做；help 后 collaborate 原形。objective 在这里是名词目标，而非“客观的”形容词。

05—22

A team can combine technical expertise with imagination and derive a novel solution from an open discussion.

团队能把技术专长与想象力结合，并从开放讨论中得出新颖方案。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A team + can combine... and derive...；combine A with B；derive A from B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两种动作各有介词：结合用 with，得出来源用 from；novel 在这里是形容词新颖的，不是小说名词。

05—23

When members disagree, they should negotiate directly instead of allowing a small division to become a permanent obstacle.

成员意见不同时，应直接协商，而不让小分歧变成永久障碍。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 members + disagree；主句 they + should negotiate；instead of allowing + a small division + to become...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
allow A to do 后带 to；become 后 permanent obstacle 为身份或性质表语。division 在此指分歧，不是除法或部门。

05—24

A clear consensus can ease tension, strengthen engagement, and create an incentive for each person to fulfill their responsibility.

明确共识能缓和紧张、增强参与，并给每人履责的动力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A clear consensus + can ease... strengthen... and create...；for each person to fulfill...说明 incentive 的内容。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
ease 为动词缓解；engagement 是参与投入，不是订婚。for 引出不定式的逻辑主语 each person，使“谁履责”明确。

第7自然段
05—25

A male applicant and a female applicant should be judged by the same standard rather than by an assumption about their sex.

男性申请人与女性申请人应按同一标准评判，而不是按对其性别的假设评判。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + should be judged；by the same standard 表依据；rather than by...对照另一依据。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
male、female 在这里都作形容词；sex 按词表为性别。被动明确申请人是接受评判者，并非他们主动评判别人。

05—26

A workplace can advertise a position widely and recruit a diverse team without using age or gender as an unfair restriction.

工作场所可以广泛发布岗位并招募多元团队，不把年龄或性别作为不公平限制。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A workplace + can advertise... and recruit...；without using + age or gender + as an unfair restriction。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
advertise 为发布招聘宣传，widely 为副词；recruit 接招募对象。using A as B 表把 A 当作 B，as 不能省。

05—27

A promotion should reflect a person's ability to deliver results, not whether they fit a conventional image of leadership.

晋升应反映一个人交付成果的能力，而不是其是否符合惯常领导形象。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A promotion + should reflect + a person's ability...；not whether...补充对比依据；to deliver 修饰 ability。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
deliver 在此是交付/产生结果；fit 直接接符合的形象，不能机械加 with。whether 从句作名词性内容，与 ability 的判断依据对照。

05—28

Such equality can benefit a corporation and its staff alike by allowing talent to develop without a needless barrier.

这种平等能让公司和员工双方受益，使才能在没有无谓障碍时发展。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Such equality + can benefit + a corporation and its staff；alike 表双方同样；by allowing + talent + to develop...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
alike 作副词修饰受益范围，不同于 like 作介词。allow 后 to develop；by 后 allowing，表示实现好处的方式。

本篇用到哪些词表词

likely, employee, benefit, better, career, financial, project, access, challenge, growth, decline, gender, professional, department, involve, economic, policy, balance, responsibility, ensure, male, resource, wrong, strategy, employer, image, perform, nation, demand, colleague, recently, workplace, boost, exist, maintain, staff, states, anxiety, deliver, failure, importance, overall, reflect, talent, working, solution, female, particular, hire, labor, respond, achievement, equipment, productive, outcome, executive, means, network, remote, growing, earn, satisfaction, competitive, increasing, principle, quit, request, poverty, former, shortage, strengthen, combine, equal, applicant, criticism, crucial, directly, flexible, willing, basis, salary, capable, contribution, efficiency, profit, constantly, feedback, judge, novel, commitment, conventional, corporate, ease, leadership, promotion, recession, transportation, effectively, pursue, regardless, division, employment, involved, prospect, wage, attribute, emphasize, sector, secure, setback, assess, contract, diverse, investigation, unemployed, assumption, economics, freedom, imagination, planning, boom, bubble, compromise, highlight, incentive, overlook, union, arrangement, collaborate, consensus, derive, discrimination, equality, negotiate, negotiation, objective, obstacle, opening, permanent, unemployment, welfare, alike, coworker, ethnic, fulfill, fundamental, recruit, sharp, timely, outstanding, promising, realistic, restriction, trigger, widely, advertise, barrier, corporation, engagement, genuine, improved, recognition, seeker, sex

ARTICLE 06 / 20

06 · 从相识到亲近：怎样与人相处

约475个英文词 · 24句 · 含110个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖84个词条

An acquaintance may become a close friend when both people show genuine curiosity about each other's lives. Instead of trying to display a perfect personality, I ask a specific question and listen carefully to the response. A meaningful interaction requires mutual respect, an appropriate tone, and the ability to recognize an emotional signal. Even a brief chat can strengthen a bond if kindness is followed by consistent contact and shared activity.

During a disagreement, an aggressive manner can arouse anger and turn a minor dispute into a serious conflict. If my comment sounds hurtful, I acknowledge its impact and apologize without denying the other person's feelings. A calm explanation can clarify my intention, but it does not automatically resolve every misunderstanding. We may need patience, a reasonable compromise, and some temporary distance before we can restore harmony.

A romantic attraction can motivate two people to spend time together, but a healthy relationship also needs independence and mutual respect. My girlfriend and I discuss our expectations openly because neither a spouse nor a partner can reliably guess another person's thoughts. If one person feels emotionally dependent, the couple can arrange some time apart rather than treating every absence as rejection. A breakup or divorce may cause deep sadness, yet closure does not always require a final reply or an explanation from the other person.

At a casual gathering in a pub, I ask a fellow student about a hobby instead of trying to impress everyone with a remarkable accomplishment. A sensitive listener notices when someone is reluctant to socialize and avoids pressing them to join a noisy crowd. If the chat begins to flow naturally, I can share a brief story, react warmly, and use a little verbal humor. The aim is not to perform a clever trick but to cultivate a connection in which both people can relax and feel accepted.

At a small wedding, the bride thanks her family while a relative adjusts the seating and another guest prepares a toast. The celebration is modest, yet the atmosphere feels warm because the guests are genuinely pleased to witness the occasion. Someone jokes that a formal suit cannot guarantee a perfect marriage, and the joke helps everyone relax after an intense morning. The memory becomes precious not because the event was expensive, but because a simple deed conveyed genuine care.

“Oh, that is amazing,” says a surprised listener, while another replies, “Yeah, it is certainly impressive, but what does it actually do?” “Hmm, I am not sure,” the presenter admits, “but it is definitely not just a toy, and I will explain exactly why.” “Okay, show us a typical example,” a student says, “because a simple demonstration is often more useful than an impressive claim.” “Thanks, that helps,” the speaker replies, adding, “OK, let us start with a modest case and judge the result fairly.”

第1自然段
06—01

An acquaintance may become a close friend when both people show genuine curiosity about each other's lives.

当两个人都真心对彼此的生活感到好奇时，熟人可能成为亲密朋友。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An acquaintance + may become + a close friend（表语）；when 从句 both people + show + genuine curiosity。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
become 后是成为的身份，不是动作宾语。中文“熟人变朋友”常不标数量；英文这两个可数单数身份前都需要 a/an。

06—02

Instead of trying to display a perfect personality, I ask a specific question and listen carefully to the response.

我不再试图展示完美性格，而是问一个具体问题，认真听回答。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 I + ask... and listen...；Instead of trying...为方式对比；to display...为 trying 的补足部分。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
listen 是不及物动词，接回答要加 to。instead of 后用 trying；中文“认真听”前置方式，英文 carefully 可放动词后。

06—03

A meaningful interaction requires mutual respect, an appropriate tone, and the ability to recognize an emotional signal.

有意义的互动需要互相尊重、合适的语气，以及识别情绪信号的能力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A meaningful interaction + requires + 三个并列宾语；to recognize...修饰 ability；an emotional signal 是 recognize 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“识别……的能力”写 ability to recognize，而非把整串动作放 ability 前。英文用不定式后置明确能力的内容。

06—04

Even a brief chat can strengthen a bond if kindness is followed by consistent contact and shared activity.

如果善意之后还有持续联系和共同活动，哪怕简短交谈也能加深联结。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 Even a brief chat + can strengthen + a bond；if 从句 kindness + is followed + by...为被动语态。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“之后还有”在这里转成 be followed by：后面接着发生什么。被动结构 is + 过去分词，by 后不是 kindness 的动作对象。

第2自然段
06—05

During a disagreement, an aggressive manner can arouse anger and turn a minor dispute into a serious conflict.

发生分歧时，咄咄逼人的态度会激起愤怒，把小争执变成严重冲突。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
an aggressive manner + can arouse... and turn...；turn A into B；During a disagreement 为时间背景。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“把 A 变成 B”，英文选 turn A into B。arouse 和 turn 共用 can；不能写 turn a dispute to a conflict 来替代这个变化结构。

06—06

If my comment sounds hurtful, I acknowledge its impact and apologize without denying the other person's feelings.

如果我的评论听起来伤人，我会承认它的影响并道歉，不否认对方的感受。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 my comment + sounds + hurtful；主句 I + acknowledge... and apologize；without denying...表方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
sounds 后用形容词 hurtful，因为是在描述评论的性质。中文“听着伤人”不需额外连接词，英文靠系动词 sound 构成系表结构。

06—07

A calm explanation can clarify my intention, but it does not automatically resolve every misunderstanding.

平静的解释能澄清我的意图，但不会自动消除所有误会。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A calm explanation + can clarify + my intention；分句② it + does not automatically resolve + every misunderstanding。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
does 已承担一般现在时变化，resolve 不再加 s。automatically 修饰解决过程，表示不会一解释就自动解决。

06—08

We may need patience, a reasonable compromise, and some temporary distance before we can restore harmony.

在恢复和睦之前，我们可能需要耐心、合理妥协和暂时拉开一点距离。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + may need + 三个并列宾语；before 时间从句 we + can restore + harmony。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文可把“恢复前”放前面，英文也可后置 before 从句。patience、harmony 此处不可数，不照着中文“一份耐心”随意加 a。

第3自然段
06—09

A romantic attraction can motivate two people to spend time together, but a healthy relationship also needs independence and mutual respect.

浪漫吸引能促使两人共度时光，但健康关系还需要独立和互相尊重。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A romantic attraction + can motivate + two people + to spend...；but 后 a healthy relationship + needs...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
motivate sb to do 表激励；attraction 是吸引力或吸引关系。needs 跟 relationship 单数，不因前面出现 two people 就变复数。

06—10

My girlfriend and I discuss our expectations openly because neither a spouse nor a partner can reliably guess another person's thoughts.

女友和我公开讨论期待，因为配偶或伴侣都不能可靠猜中另一个人的想法。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 My girlfriend and I + discuss...；because 从句 neither a spouse nor a partner + can guess...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
neither A nor B 表两者都不；can 前后不需再加 not。中文“我和女友”，英文礼貌顺序常把 I 放后，这是习惯而非语法硬性要求。

06—11

If one person feels emotionally dependent, the couple can arrange some time apart rather than treating every absence as rejection.

如果一方感到情感依赖，两人可以安排分开的时间，而不把每次缺席都当拒绝。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 one person + feels + emotionally dependent；主句 couple + can arrange...；rather than treating + every absence + as rejection。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
dependent 为形容词，emotionally 修饰它；treat A as B 表视为。absence 是不在场，不应一律按关系破裂翻译。

06—12

A breakup or divorce may cause deep sadness, yet closure does not always require a final reply or an explanation from the other person.

分手或离婚可能带来深切悲伤，但心理上的终结感并不总需要对方最后回复或解释。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A breakup or divorce + may cause...；yet 后 closure + does not always require + 两个宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
not always 表并非总是，不能译为总不。closure 按原表情感解脱/终结感使用，不是关闭商店。

第4自然段
06—13

At a casual gathering in a pub, I ask a fellow student about a hobby instead of trying to impress everyone with a remarkable accomplishment.

酒吧里的随意聚会中，我询问同学的爱好，而不试图用非凡成就打动所有人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + ask + a fellow student + about a hobby；instead of trying + to impress...；with...说明凭借什么。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
fellow 作定语指同类身份；casual 指随意非正式。ask sb about sth，中文“问某人爱好”英文常需 about 标明话题。

06—14

A sensitive listener notices when someone is reluctant to socialize and avoids pressing them to join a noisy crowd.

体贴的倾听者会察觉对方何时不愿社交，并避免催促其加入吵闹人群。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A sensitive listener + notices + when 宾从；and avoids + pressing + them + to join...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
sensitive 在此是体察他人的，不是易受刺激的唯一义；reluctant 是形容词，需 is。avoid 与 press 分别决定 pressing 和 to join 两层形式。

06—15

If the chat begins to flow naturally, I can share a brief story, react warmly, and use a little verbal humor.

聊天开始自然流动时，我可以讲简短故事、热情回应，并用一点口头幽默。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 the chat + begins + to flow；主句 I + can share... react... and use...；naturally 修饰 flow。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
flow 用于交流流畅的比喻义；verbal 是形容词口头的。react 此处不带对象，若加“对故事回应”需 react to the story。

06—16

The aim is not to perform a clever trick but to cultivate a connection in which both people can relax and feel accepted.

目标不是表演机巧，而是培养让双方都能放松、感到被接纳的联系。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The aim + is + not to perform... but to cultivate...；in which 定从修饰 connection；both people + can relax and feel accepted。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
not...but...连接两个不定式表语；feel accepted 中 accepted 表被接纳的状态。中文“让双方……”这里以 in which 描述关系中的感受。

第5自然段
06—17

At a small wedding, the bride thanks her family while a relative adjusts the seating and another guest prepares a toast.

小婚礼上，新娘感谢家人，亲属调整座位安排，另一客人准备祝酒词。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The bride + thanks + her family；while 后两个分句：a relative adjusts... and another guest prepares...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
bride 为新娘；thanks 在这里是动词 thank 的第三人称单数形式，不是独立的“谢谢”感叹语。seating 指座位安排。

06—18

The celebration is modest, yet the atmosphere feels warm because the guests are genuinely pleased to witness the occasion.

庆祝不奢华，但气氛温暖，因为宾客真心高兴见证这一时刻。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
celebration + is + modest；yet 后 atmosphere + feels + warm；because 从句 guests + are pleased + to witness...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
feel 在这里是系动词，后用 warm；pleased 形容状态，不是宾客在主动使别人高兴。occasion 在此为重要场合/时刻。

06—19

Someone jokes that a formal suit cannot guarantee a perfect marriage, and the joke helps everyone relax after an intense morning.

有人打趣说，正式西装不能保证完美婚姻，这笑话使大家在紧张早晨后放松下来。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Someone + jokes + that 宾从；a formal suit + cannot guarantee...；and 后 the joke + helps + everyone + relax。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
suit 这里是西装名词，不是适合的动词；intense 修饰 morning 表紧张强烈。help 后 relax 原形。

06—20

The memory becomes precious not because the event was expensive, but because a simple deed conveyed genuine care.

记忆变珍贵不是因为活动昂贵，而是因为简单行动传达了真心关怀。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The memory + becomes + precious；not because...but because...两个原因从句；a simple deed + conveyed + genuine care。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
deed 为行为而非房契；becomes 叙事现在时，was/conveyed 指活动已发生的细节。两个 because 后都用完整主谓。

第6自然段
06—21

“Oh, that is amazing,” says a surprised listener, while another replies, “Yeah, it is certainly impressive, but what does it actually do?”

一位惊讶听众说：“哦，太惊人了。”另一位答：“对，确实厉害，但它实际上做什么？”

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
对话①that + is + amazing；引述 says a surprised listener 为倒装式叙述；对话②it + is...；what does it do 为直接疑问句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
直接问句需 does 前置；amazing 描述事物令人惊讶，surprised 描述人感到惊讶。oh、yeah 按原表为口语感叹/回应。

06—22

“Hmm, I am not sure,” the presenter admits, “but it is definitely not just a toy, and I will explain exactly why.”

展示者承认：“嗯，我不确定，但它肯定不只是玩具，我会解释确切原因。”

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
对话主干 I + am not sure；it + is not just a toy；I + will explain + exactly why；the presenter admits 为插入的引述语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
hmm 表思考；definitely 和 exactly 都为副词，分别修饰判断确信程度和解释内容。why 后省略已知内容，不是缺失主语的病句。

06—23

“Okay, show us a typical example,” a student says, “because a simple demonstration is often more useful than an impressive claim.”

学生说：“好，给我们看典型例子吧，因为简单演示常比惊人声明更有用。”

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
祈使句 show + us + a typical example；because 从句 demonstration + is + more useful than...；a student says 为引述语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
show 双宾语中 us 是接受者；Okay 为回应语。典型用 typical 修饰 example，不用副词 typically。

06—24

“Thanks, that helps,” the speaker replies, adding, “OK, let us start with a modest case and judge the result fairly.”

讲者答：“谢谢，这有帮助。好，我们从小案例开始，公平评价结果。”

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
that + helps 为陈述；let + us + start... and judge...为建议；adding...为伴随叙述。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
Thanks 这里是感谢用语，补足原表义项；OK 与 okay 都是口语回应“好”的形式。let 后 start/judge 都不用 to。

本篇用到哪些词表词
