ARTICLE 07 / 20

07 · 照顾情绪，也给未来留一点空间

约501个英文词 · 24句 · 含129个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖91个词条

Loneliness can feel overwhelming when I compare my quiet evening with everyone else's seemingly exciting social life. A psychologist might remind me that my current mood does not define my entire self or determine my future. I can take a walk in the sunshine, enjoy classical music, or attend a community event without expecting instant happiness. Such modest actions do not eliminate every negative emotion, but they give an ordinary day some comfort and possibility.

During childhood, a child may learn to hide frustration, while in adulthood the same habit can hinder honest interpersonal communication. A psychological journal asks whether a persistent fear is related to an earlier experience or to a current source of stress. A counselor may use a theory from psychology to explore an inner conflict without reducing the person to a diagnostic category. Such reflection can bring insight and emotional relief, although a painful memory may not fade as quickly as one might wish.

When I feel depressed or anxious, I try to describe my feeling precisely rather than deny its presence or call myself weak. A friend can assist by listening, but serious depression or another disorder may require professional assessment and appropriate therapy. I do not have to disclose every private affair, yet I can readily ask for support when a problem begins to overwhelm me. Kindness cannot reverse every loss, but its presence may reduce shame and help a person feel less alone.

An adviser tells me that midlife is not the end of advancement and that a new phase can begin at any age. A person aged sixty may enroll in a course, learn to knit, or develop a passion for a field that once seemed dull. The lifespan of a career can extend beyond a conventional retirement date, although personal circumstances and health vary widely. I cannot anticipate every obstacle, but I can prepare for a transition and remain open to a potentially valuable new direction.

I am not a superhero or a genius; I am a fairly ordinary person who can learn, adapt, and gradually become more capable. An unhealthy comparison may leave me feeling inadequate, but I do not have to let it characterize my whole life anymore. I can devote an hour to study, join a membership group, and make room for a hobby without waiting for a perfect life. For me, the objective is to reap the benefit of small actions and live with gratitude, even when the outcome remains uncertain.

When people are deeply concerned, they may seek immediate certainty, but a passive reaction is not always the only alternative to panic. I can pause, review the facts, and postpone a decision until I am less likely to react negatively to a minor inconvenience. The proverb about patience is not a magic formula; its point is that a brief delay can sometimes prevent a poor decision. Contrary to my instinct, taking time does not necessarily mean giving up; sometimes it allows me to act more effectively later.

第1自然段
07—01

Loneliness can feel overwhelming when I compare my quiet evening with everyone else's seemingly exciting social life.

把自己安静的夜晚与别人似乎精彩的社交生活比较时，孤独感可能让人难以承受。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 Loneliness + can feel + overwhelming；when 从句 I + compare + my quiet evening + with...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先让 loneliness 作主语描述感受，再补何时出现；feel 在这里为系动词，后接形容词 overwhelming，而非 overwhelming 作一个独立动作。

07—02

A psychologist might remind me that my current mood does not define my entire self or determine my future.

心理学家可能会提醒我，当下情绪并不能定义完整的自我，也不能决定未来。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A psychologist + might remind + me + that 宾语从句；从句 my current mood + does not define... or determine...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
remind sb that...接提醒的内容；从句否定里的 or 连接两个都被否定的动作。中文“情绪不能定义我”，这里用 self 精确表达“自我”。

07—03

I can take a walk in the sunshine, enjoy classical music, or attend a community event without expecting instant happiness.

我可以在阳光下散步、欣赏古典音乐或参加社区活动，不要求自己立即快乐起来。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + can take... enjoy... or attend...；without expecting...为伴随方式；instant happiness 为 expecting 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“不要求立刻……”表达为 without expecting，说明做这些事时的态度。attend 直接接 event，不写 attend to an event，因为 attend to 常表示处理或照料。

07—04

Such modest actions do not eliminate every negative emotion, but they give an ordinary day some comfort and possibility.

这些小小的行动不能消除所有负面情绪，但能给平常的一天带来一些安慰和可能。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① Such modest actions + do not eliminate...；分句② they + give + an ordinary day + some comfort and possibility（双宾语）。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
主语 actions 为复数，用 do not；give 后先是接受者 day，再是带来的东西。中文“给一天带来”可简化成英文 give 的双宾结构。

第2自然段
07—05

During childhood, a child may learn to hide frustration, while in adulthood the same habit can hinder honest interpersonal communication.

童年时，孩子可能学会隐藏挫败感，而成年后同一习惯会妨碍坦诚的人际沟通。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a child + may learn + to hide...；while 后 the same habit + can hinder + honest interpersonal communication。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
childhood 与 adulthood 均为人生阶段名词；while 表对照。hinder 直接接被妨碍的事，不用中文“对沟通造成”逐字拼。

07—06

A psychological journal asks whether a persistent fear is related to an earlier experience or to a current source of stress.

心理学期刊提出疑问，持续恐惧是否与较早经历或当前压力来源有关。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A psychological journal + asks + whether 宾从；a persistent fear + is related + to A or to B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
is related to 为与……有关；两个 to 保留使关系清楚。whether 表是否；earlier 为比较意味的更早，不必另加 more。

07—07

A counselor may use a theory from psychology to explore an inner conflict without reducing the person to a diagnostic category.

咨询人员可能用心理学理论探索内心冲突，而不把人简化成诊断类别。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A counselor + may use + a theory；to explore...目的；without reducing + the person + to a diagnostic category。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
reduce A to B 在此为把人简化为类别，非数量减少。psychology 是名词学科，psychological 是形容词，两者位置不同。

07—08

Such reflection can bring insight and emotional relief, although a painful memory may not fade as quickly as one might wish.

这类反思能带来洞见和情绪缓解，尽管痛苦记忆可能不会像希望的那样迅速淡去。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Such reflection + can bring...；although 从句 memory + may not fade；as quickly as one might wish 为比较。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
fade 为动词淡去，不加 be；as...as 中间用副词 quickly 修饰淡去速度。one 为泛指某个人，might 表可能希望的情况。

第3自然段
07—09

When I feel depressed or anxious, I try to describe my feeling precisely rather than deny its presence or call myself weak.

感到低落或焦虑时，我尝试准确描述感受，而不否认其存在或称自己软弱。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 I + feel + depressed or anxious；主句 I + try + to describe...；rather than deny... or call myself weak。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
depressed 在此是情绪低落的形容词，不等同给出抑郁症诊断；call + myself + weak 为宾补结构。

07—10

A friend can assist by listening, but serious depression or another disorder may require professional assessment and appropriate therapy.

朋友能通过倾听帮助，但严重抑郁或其他障碍可能需要专业评估和适当治疗。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A friend + can assist；by listening 表方式；but 后 depression or another disorder + may require...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
by 后动作用 listening；assist 在这里没有直接宾语也成立。depression 为抑郁状态或障碍名词，是否诊断需专业评估，本句不诊断读者。

07—11

I do not have to disclose every private affair, yet I can readily ask for support when a problem begins to overwhelm me.

我不必透露每件私事，但问题开始让我难以承受时，可以坦然寻求支持。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + do not have + to disclose...；yet 后 I + can ask for...；when 从句 problem + begins + to overwhelm me。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
do not have to 表不必，不是禁止；affair 此处为事务，不是婚外情。readily 修饰寻求帮助，表示乐意/不困难地。

07—12

Kindness cannot reverse every loss, but its presence may reduce shame and help a person feel less alone.

善意不能逆转每项损失，但它可能减少羞耻感，并让人不那么孤单。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Kindness + cannot reverse...；but 后 its presence + may reduce... and help + a person + feel less alone。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
reverse 在这里为动词逆转；help 后 feel 原形。less 修饰 alone 的程度，不是形容可数的人数。

第4自然段
07—13

An adviser tells me that midlife is not the end of advancement and that a new phase can begin at any age.

顾问告诉我，中年不是发展的终点，新阶段可以在任何年龄开始。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An adviser + tells + me + 两个 that 宾从；①midlife + is not...；②a new phase + can begin...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
midlife 为中年；advancement 为进步发展。两个完整内容并列，第二个 that 保留可避免读者误以为 new phase 是前一名词的一部分。

07—14

A person aged sixty may enroll in a course, learn to knit, or develop a passion for a field that once seemed dull.

六十岁的人可能注册课程、学编织，或对曾显乏味的领域产生热情。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A person aged sixty + may enroll... learn... or develop...；aged sixty 后置修饰 person；that once seemed dull 修饰 field。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
aged sixty 是年龄说明，不是主句过去式；enroll in 表注册参加。learn to knit 的 knit 是原形，不是过去式 knitted。

07—15

The lifespan of a career can extend beyond a conventional retirement date, although personal circumstances and health vary widely.

职业生涯可以超过惯常退休日期，尽管个人情形和健康状况差别很大。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The lifespan of a career + can extend...；although 从句 personal circumstances and health + vary；widely 修饰 vary。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
lifespan 是延续时长，不仅用于生物寿命；extend 此处不及物延伸。复数 circumstances 与 health 并列，谓语 vary 不加 s。

07—16

I cannot anticipate every obstacle, but I can prepare for a transition and remain open to a potentially valuable new direction.

我无法预见每个障碍，但能为转变作准备，对可能有价值的新方向保持开放。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + cannot anticipate...；but 后 I + can prepare... and remain...；open 为 remain 的表语；to a direction 为对象。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
potentially 为副词修饰 valuable；anticipate 直接接对象。remain open to 中 to 为介词，后接名词，不是 to do 的标记。

第5自然段
07—17

I am not a superhero or a genius; I am a fairly ordinary person who can learn, adapt, and gradually become more capable.

我不是超级英雄或天才，而是能学习、适应并逐渐更有能力的普通人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
两个独立句以分号连接；第二句 I + am + a fairly ordinary person；who can learn... adapt... and become...定从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
fairly 为副词相当，修饰 ordinary；adapt 作适应的不及物动词。become 后 more capable 为表语，不需要再加一个 is。

07—18

An unhealthy comparison may leave me feeling inadequate, but I do not have to let it characterize my whole life anymore.

不健康的比较可能使我感觉不够好，但我不必再任它定义整个人生。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
comparison + may leave + me + feeling inadequate；but 后 I + do not have + to let + it + characterize...；anymore 修饰否定句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
leave sb doing 表留下某状态；let 后 characterize 原形。anymore 常用于否定句表示不再，与“更多数量”的 any more 区别。

07—19

I can devote an hour to study, join a membership group, and make room for a hobby without waiting for a perfect life.

我可以用一小时学习、加入会员团体，并为爱好留空间，不等完美生活才行动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + can devote... join... and make...；devote an hour to study；without waiting...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
devote A to B 中 to 是介词，study 在此为名词学习；若写 studying 也可以。membership 在这里作名词定语，指会员组成的团体。

07—20

For me, the objective is to reap the benefit of small actions and live with gratitude, even when the outcome remains uncertain.

对我来说，目标是收获小行动的益处，并怀着感激生活，即使结果依然不确定。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the objective + is + to reap... and live...；with gratitude 为方式；even when 从句 outcome + remains + uncertain。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
reap 为收获成果；gratitude 为感激名词，与 grateful 形容词区别。even when 是让步时间背景，不表示必须先确定结果才能生活。

第6自然段
07—21

When people are deeply concerned, they may seek immediate certainty, but a passive reaction is not always the only alternative to panic.

深感担忧时，人们可能寻求立即确定，但被动反应并非恐慌的唯一替代选项。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 people + are + deeply concerned；主句 they + may seek...；but 后 reaction + is not always + the only alternative...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
concerned 为担忧的形容词；deeply 修饰它。alternative to 中 to 为介词；not always 是不总是，不是一直没有。

07—22

I can pause, review the facts, and postpone a decision until I am less likely to react negatively to a minor inconvenience.

我可以暂停、复核事实，并延后决定，直到不容易因小小不便作出负面反应。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + can pause... review... and postpone...；until 从句 I + am + less likely；to react...补充 likely。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
be likely to do 表可能；less likely 表可能性更低。negatively 是副词，修饰 react；to a minor inconvenience 为 react 搭配。

07—23

The proverb about patience is not a magic formula; its point is that a brief delay can sometimes prevent a poor decision.

关于耐心的谚语不是魔法公式；其重点是，短暂延迟有时能防止糟糕决定。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
前句 proverb + is not...；后句 its point + is + that 表语从句；delay + can prevent + a poor decision。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
that 在这里跟在 is 后作表语从句，不是宾语从句。英文“重点是……”可用 point is that + 完整陈述。

07—24

Contrary to my instinct, taking time does not necessarily mean giving up; sometimes it allows me to act more effectively later.

与直觉相反，花时间并不一定意味着放弃；有时它让我之后行动更有效。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Contrary to...为立场状语；taking time + does not mean + giving up；后句 it + allows + me + to act...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
taking time 为动名词主语，故 does；mean 后 giving up 为名词性内容。contrary to 是固定结构，不能省 to。

本篇用到哪些词表词

less, likely, benefit, career, reduce, support, stress, community, later, professional, event, current, negative, seek, determine, emotional, source, loss, attend, adapt, explore, conflict, quickly, depression, outcome, theory, vary, childhood, delay, psychologist, retirement, journal, related, self, valuable, formula, necessarily, classical, instinct, psychological, define, possibility, reverse, concerned, happiness, gradually, ordinary, capable, deeply, extend, alternative, entire, hinder, minor, conventional, loneliness, remind, effectively, mood, eliminate, immediate, passion, therapy, comfort, anxious, exciting, adulthood, adviser, appropriate, assessment, depressed, disorder, inner, insight, instant, modest, react, assist, deny, lifespan, membership, negatively, objective, obstacle, presence, proverb, psychology, reaction, reap, seemingly, transition, category, contrary, devote, earlier, fairly, knit, midlife, panic, passive, phase, relief, superhero, unhealthy, cannot, dull, fade, genius, gratitude, kindness, overwhelming, widely, advancement, affair, aged, anticipate, anymore, characterize, enroll, frustration, interpersonal, overwhelm, painful, patience, persistent, potentially, precisely, readily, sunshine

ARTICLE 08 / 20

08 · 运动、睡眠与人生的不同阶段

约383个英文词 · 20句 · 含118个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖89个词条

A teenage player dreams of winning a medal, but a qualified coach puts greater emphasis on discipline and teamwork. During each training session, the athlete practices a basic technique, builds muscle strength, and learns to retain possession. A rival may be physically stronger, yet accurate passing and intelligent movement can still create an opening. If we lose a contest, the setback can inspire further improvement instead of proving that anyone is a loser.

A fitness instructor tells a beginner to stretch gently and choose moderate activity instead of an extreme workout. A vigorous session may leave a person exhausted, especially if they ignore a warning sign or push beyond their capacity. The trainer asks us to focus on steady progress, not to chase a quick transformation or compete with an advanced athlete. A balanced routine can sustain motivation and give the body time to recover before the next trial of physical strength.

Nowadays, irregular working hours and frequent multitasking can make a millennial worker feel stressed even after a short nap. A psychologist may discuss the association between sleep and mental wellbeing without claiming that one formula suits everyone. I keep a written record of my mood and ask how my evening routine might affect the following day's energy. If my inability to rest becomes an ongoing concern, I can seek an assessment rather than simply blame myself.

Aging can bring changes in mobility, hearing, and memory, but each person's experience may vary considerably. An elderly relative may retire from a demanding profession and rely partly on a pension for financial security. A community centre offers walking groups, yoga, and knitting classes to promote social contact and reduce isolation. These activities are not a guarantee of longevity, yet they can provide enjoyment, companionship, and a valued role after retirement.

A coach asks every player in a uniform to commit to fair play and reject cheating, even if victory seems easily obtainable. Unlike a casual game, an official match may impose a penalty for a strike that injures an opponent. A disadvantage does not mean certain defeat; similarly, a strong reputation does not guarantee that a team will successfully defend its title. Surprisingly, a quiet player may thrive under pressure, while an obvious favorite may suddenly lose focus and become a victim of shock.

第1自然段
08—01

A teenage player dreams of winning a medal, but a qualified coach puts greater emphasis on discipline and teamwork.

一名十几岁的球员梦想赢得奖牌，但合格教练更强调纪律和团队合作。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A teenage player + dreams of + winning a medal；but 连接 a qualified coach + puts + greater emphasis + on...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
dream of 中 of 是介词，后用 winning。put emphasis on 表强调；中文“更强调”在英文可转为动词 put + 名词 emphasis 的搭配。

08—02

During each training session, the athlete practices a basic technique, builds muscle strength, and learns to retain possession.

每次训练中，运动员练习基本技术、增强肌肉力量，并学习保持控球。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the athlete + practices... builds... and learns...；to retain possession 是 learns 的补足内容。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
同一个单数主语对应三个一般现在时动作，三个谓语都加 s。learn to do 表学习做；possession 此处指控球，不译成个人财产。

08—03

A rival may be physically stronger, yet accurate passing and intelligent movement can still create an opening.

对手可能身体更强壮，但准确传球和聪明跑位仍能创造空当。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A rival + may be + physically stronger；分句② accurate passing and intelligent movement + can create + an opening。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
physically 是副词，修饰比较级 stronger；passing 和 movement 作名词性的并列主语。“空当”这里用 opening，按词表的开放口义理解为机会空隙。

08—04

If we lose a contest, the setback can inspire further improvement instead of proving that anyone is a loser.

如果输掉比赛，这次挫折可以激励进一步改进，而不是证明谁是失败者。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 we + lose + a contest；主句 the setback + can inspire...；instead of proving...；that anyone is a loser 为 proving 的宾语从句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写挫折“能带来什么”，再对比不能据此推断的身份。proving 跟在介词 of 后；loser 是可数身份名词，要有 a。

第2自然段
08—05

A fitness instructor tells a beginner to stretch gently and choose moderate activity instead of an extreme workout.

健身教练让初学者轻柔拉伸，并选择适度活动，而不是极端强度的训练。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A fitness instructor + tells + a beginner + to stretch... and choose...；instead of 后为名词短语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tell sb to do 表要求做；gently 修饰 stretch。moderate 在这里是形容词，不是主持讨论或减轻的动词义。

08—06

A vigorous session may leave a person exhausted, especially if they ignore a warning sign or push beyond their capacity.

高强度训练可能让人筋疲力尽，尤其在忽略警告信号或超出能力极限时。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A vigorous session + may leave + a person + exhausted（宾补）；if 从句 they + ignore... or push...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
leave sb exhausted 表使人处于疲惫状态；exhausted 描述人，exhausting 通常描述令人疲惫的事。中文“练得很累”英文需明确谁使谁怎样。

08—07

The trainer asks us to focus on steady progress, not to chase a quick transformation or compete with an advanced athlete.

教练要求我们专注稳步进步，不追求快速改变，也不与高水平运动员攀比。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The trainer + asks + us + to focus...；not to chase... or compete...表示不该采取的动作；focus on...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
focus 后接 on；not 放在 to 前明确否定不定式。advanced 修饰 athlete 表水平高，不能把它误读为该句过去时。

08—08

A balanced routine can sustain motivation and give the body time to recover before the next trial of physical strength.

均衡安排能维持动力，并在下一次体力考验前给身体恢复时间。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A balanced routine + can sustain... and give + the body + time；to recover 修饰 time；before...为时间。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
give 为双宾语，身体是接受者，time 是获得物；time to recover 表恢复所需时间。physical 是形容词修饰 strength。

第3自然段
08—09

Nowadays, irregular working hours and frequent multitasking can make a millennial worker feel stressed even after a short nap.

如今，不规律工时和频繁多任务处理，会让千禧一代员工即使小睡后仍感到压力大。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 irregular working hours and frequent multitasking；can make + a millennial worker + feel stressed；even after...为让步背景。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
make sb do 中 feel 不带 to；feel 后 stressed 为表语。两个状态层级不同：make 使某人做/感觉，feel 再连接感受。

08—10

A psychologist may discuss the association between sleep and mental wellbeing without claiming that one formula suits everyone.

心理学家可能讨论睡眠与心理健康的关联，而不声称某个公式适合所有人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A psychologist + may discuss + the association；between A and B；without claiming...；that one formula suits everyone 为 claiming 的宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
wellbeing 此处是健康幸福状态；claiming 由 without 决定；suits 是从句自己的谓语，不能因主句有 may 就取消其单数变化。

08—11

I keep a written record of my mood and ask how my evening routine might affect the following day's energy.

我书面记录情绪，并思考晚间安排可能怎样影响第二天精力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + keep... and ask...；how 宾从 my evening routine + might affect + the following day's energy。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
affect 在这里是动词影响，区别于名词 effect。written 作 record 的定语；how 间接疑问维持陈述顺序，不把 might 提到主语前。

08—12

If my inability to rest becomes an ongoing concern, I can seek an assessment rather than simply blame myself.

如果无法休息成了持续困扰，我可以寻求评估，而不是只责怪自己。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 my inability to rest + becomes + an ongoing concern；主句 I + can seek... rather than blame...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
inability 是名词主语，to rest 说明哪种不能；blame 接反身代词 myself，表示动作回到自身。simply 修饰责怪动作。

第4自然段
08—13

Aging can bring changes in mobility, hearing, and memory, but each person's experience may vary considerably.

衰老可能带来行动能力、听力和记忆方面的变化，但每个人的经历会有相当差异。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Aging + can bring + changes；in...说明变化方面；but 后 each person's experience + may vary；considerably 修饰 vary。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
Aging 是名词化主语；vary 为动词，不写 be vary。中文“大不相同”在此用 vary considerably，把程度交给副词。

08—14

An elderly relative may retire from a demanding profession and rely partly on a pension for financial security.

年长亲属可能从要求很高的职业退休，并部分依靠养老金获得经济保障。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An elderly relative + may retire... and rely...；retire from...；rely on...；for financial security 表目的或用途。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两个动词所配介词不同：retire from、rely on。relative 这里是亲属名词，不是“相对的”形容词。

08—15

A community centre offers walking groups, yoga, and knitting classes to promote social contact and reduce isolation.

社区中心开设步行小组、瑜伽和编织课，以促进社交联系并减少孤立。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A community centre + offers + 三项活动；to promote... and reduce...为目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
walking、knitting 在这里修饰活动类型，并非进行时谓语。to 后两个动词并列；isolation 是抽象名词，不加 a。

08—16

These activities are not a guarantee of longevity, yet they can provide enjoyment, companionship, and a valued role after retirement.

这些活动不能保证长寿，但可以在退休后带来乐趣、陪伴和有价值的角色。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
These activities + are not + a guarantee；yet 后 they + can provide + 三个宾语；after retirement 为时间。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
are not a guarantee 是系表否定，与 do not guarantee 的动词否定不同。中文都可译为“不能保证”，英文需先选名词还是动词表达。

第5自然段
08—17

A coach asks every player in a uniform to commit to fair play and reject cheating, even if victory seems easily obtainable.

教练要求每位穿队服的球员承诺公平竞赛、拒绝作弊，即使胜利看起来轻易可得。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
coach + asks + every player + to commit... and reject...；commit to fair play；even if 从句 victory + seems + easily obtainable。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
commit to 后接 fair play 名词；uniform 为制服/队服名词。easily 修饰 obtainable，表示获得起来容易，不是评价胜利轻浮。

08—18

Unlike a casual game, an official match may impose a penalty for a strike that injures an opponent.

不同于随意游戏，正式比赛可能对伤及对手的击打施加处罚。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Unlike a casual game 为比较状语；match + may impose + a penalty；for a strike...为处罚原因；that injures...修饰 strike。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
unlike 是介词，后接名词；strike 此处为名词击打。that 指击打作 injures 主语，不是受伤对手作主语。

08—19

A disadvantage does not mean certain defeat; similarly, a strong reputation does not guarantee that a team will successfully defend its title.

劣势不意味着必败；同样，强大名声不保证球队能成功卫冕。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
disadvantage + does not mean...；分号后 reputation + does not guarantee + that 宾从；team + will defend...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
similarly 为副词，用分号衔接独立句；successfully 修饰 defend。that 不充当从句主语，主语是 a team。

08—20

Surprisingly, a quiet player may thrive under pressure, while an obvious favorite may suddenly lose focus and become a victim of shock.

出人意料的是，安静球员可能在压力中表现出色，而明显热门可能突然失去专注，被震惊击垮。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
player + may thrive；while 后 favorite + may lose... and become...；surprisingly 修饰全句，suddenly 修饰 lose。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
thrive 是蓬勃发展/表现出色的动词，不能加 be；favorite 是热门人选名词。shock 这里为震惊状态，非电击。

本篇用到哪些词表词

reduce, affect, focus, financial, physical, simply, mental, community, concern, sign, pressure, security, seek, easily, official, promote, contact, further, extreme, working, aging, rely, muscle, vary, psychologist, retirement, improvement, association, movement, formula, ignore, warning, relative, routine, knitting, retire, inspire, strength, elderly, emphasis, motivation, penalty, advanced, capacity, compete, intelligent, nap, technique, commit, mood, nowadays, player, rival, shock, victim, following, frequent, obvious, written, yoga, accurate, medal, mobility, setback, unlike, blame, disadvantage, guarantee, partly, cheating, recover, reputation, session, suddenly, thrive, uniform, wellbeing, assessment, athlete, considerably, discipline, instructor, longevity, multitasking, ongoing, stretch, strike, walking, casual, chase, isolation, loser, opening, opponent, qualified, teamwork, trial, contest, impose, millennial, profession, reject, retain, successfully, surprisingly, sustain, exhausted, physically, stressed, teenage, vigorous, hearing, inability, irregular, moderate, pension, possession, similarly

ARTICLE 09 / 20

09 · 从厨房到餐厅：食物与选择

约307个英文词 · 16句 · 含96个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖76个词条

A local chef offers a cooking session in which every learner can prepare a nutritious meal from ordinary ingredients. First, we wash a carrot, cook some beans and grain, and mix them with a small portion of protein-rich food. The recipe allows us to roast vegetables in an oven or heat a frozen dish in a microwave. We judge the flavor and texture, not merely the calorie content, because eating should also be enjoyable.

At the grocery store, a shopper compares the price per kilogram and checks the nutritional label on a processed snack. An attractive brand image and a considerable discount may persuade a consumer to purchase an unnecessary item. I carry a shopping list in my wallet so that I can distinguish a necessity from a luxury and control my spending. Before making a payment, I check whether the total sum matches the advertised price and ask for a receipt.

A popular diet may claim to cure obesity, but an expert will ask for evidence rather than trust a dramatic promise. According to the article, a dietary pattern should contain a variety of foods, not a mere substitute for a balanced meal. The specialist explains the difference between a nutrient deficiency and excess intake without prescribing a universal remedy. A qualified physician can prescribe treatment when necessary, while a social media influencer may have no clinical training.

At a dining event, a waiter offers each guest a beverage and asks whether they prefer beer, soda, or bottled water. The menu includes a vegetarian burger, a bean salad, and a dish made from corn and fibre-rich grain. A guest asks if the sauce contains a sugary ingredient, while another requests a tasty substitute for a dish they dislike. The staff respond politely, explain the available choices, and avoid making a guest feel uncomfortable about their preference.

第1自然段
09—01

A local chef offers a cooking session in which every learner can prepare a nutritious meal from ordinary ingredients.

本地厨师开了一节烹饪课，让每位学习者都能用普通食材做一顿有营养的饭。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A local chef + offers + a cooking session；in which...定语从句修饰 session；every learner + can prepare + a nutritious meal。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“在这节课中”可写 in the session，合并后变 in which。中文可说“让大家做饭”，英文在这里用定语从句说明课程内容。

09—02

First, we wash a carrot, cook some beans and grain, and mix them with a small portion of protein-rich food.

首先，我们洗一根胡萝卜，煮一些豆子和谷物，再把它们与少量富含蛋白质的食物混合。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + wash... cook... and mix...；them 指前面准备的食材；with...表混合对象。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
a carrot 可数，grain 此处作谷物统称，不加 a。先排列动作再补混合关系，英文 mix A with B 的结构比逐字翻译“混到一起”清楚。

09—03

The recipe allows us to roast vegetables in an oven or heat a frozen dish in a microwave.

这个食谱允许我们用烤箱烤蔬菜，或用微波炉加热一道冷冻菜肴。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The recipe + allows + us + to roast... or heat...；in an oven、in a microwave 表设备内的位置。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
allow sb to do 为固定结构；roast 与 heat 是二选一，用 or。frozen 作定语修饰 dish，不在本句充当独立过去时。

09—04

We judge the flavor and texture, not merely the calorie content, because eating should also be enjoyable.

我们评价味道和口感，而不只看热量，因为吃饭也应该是愉快的。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + judge + the flavor and texture；not merely...补充排除仅看热量的做法；because 从句 eating + should be + enjoyable。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
eating 在原因从句中是动名词主语；“吃饭愉快”要有 should be 连接状态。not merely 的范围是评价对象，不是否定整个 judge 动作。

第2自然段
09—05

At the grocery store, a shopper compares the price per kilogram and checks the nutritional label on a processed snack.

在杂货店里，一名购物者比较每千克的价格，并检查一种加工零食上的营养标签。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
地点状语 At the grocery store；a shopper + compares... and checks...；per kilogram 修饰 price；on...修饰 label。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“购物者比较和检查”，再把“每千克”和“零食上的”贴到对应名词后。processed 表“加工过的”，是修饰 snack 的分词。

09—06

An attractive brand image and a considerable discount may persuade a consumer to purchase an unnecessary item.

吸引人的品牌形象和相当大的折扣，可能说服消费者购买一件不必要的商品。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 An attractive brand image and a considerable discount；谓语 may persuade；宾语 a consumer；宾补 to purchase...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
persuade sb to do 表说服某人做；中文“让人想买”在这里具体化为说服动作。may 后保持原形，不受并列主语的数影响。

09—07

I carry a shopping list in my wallet so that I can distinguish a necessity from a luxury and control my spending.

我在钱包里带着购物清单，以便区分必需品和奢侈品，并控制开支。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + carry + a shopping list；so that 目的从句 I + can distinguish... and control...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“为了能……”用 so that + 完整句；necessity 和 luxury 此处指具体类别中的一件东西，所以用 a；spending 表开支，不是本句正在做的动作。

09—08

Before making a payment, I check whether the total sum matches the advertised price and ask for a receipt.

付款之前，我检查总金额是否与广告价格一致，并索要收据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 I + check... and ask...；whether 从句 the total sum + matches + the advertised price；Before making...为时间状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写“检查什么”再嵌入 whether；matches 为从句谓语，因 sum 单数加 s。ask for a receipt 表索要，不能漏 for。

第3自然段
09—09

A popular diet may claim to cure obesity, but an expert will ask for evidence rather than trust a dramatic promise.

流行饮食方案可能声称能治愈肥胖症，但专家会要求证据，而不会相信夸张承诺。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A popular diet + may claim + to cure obesity；but 后 an expert + will ask for... rather than trust...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
claim to do 是声称能做；diet 在此是饮食方案，obesity 为疾病名词。will 后两个动作都用原形；不能把广告承诺当成本文医学结论。

09—10

According to the article, a dietary pattern should contain a variety of foods, not a mere substitute for a balanced meal.

根据文章，一种饮食模式应包含多种食物，而不只是均衡正餐的某种替代品。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
According to the article 为依据状语；a dietary pattern + should contain + a variety of foods；not...补充对照。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
according 必须与 to 搭配表达根据；mere 是形容词修饰 substitute，不能放在动词前当 merely 使用。本文是在转述文章说法。

09—11

The specialist explains the difference between a nutrient deficiency and excess intake without prescribing a universal remedy.

专科人员解释营养素缺乏与摄入过量的区别，并不据此开出适合所有人的疗法。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The specialist + explains + the difference；between A and B 限定区别；without prescribing...为方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
prescribing 跟在 without 后；between 后用 and 连接比较双方。“所有人的疗法”以 universal 修饰 remedy，不等于此处有具体治疗建议。

09—12

A qualified physician can prescribe treatment when necessary, while a social media influencer may have no clinical training.

合格医生能在必要时开具治疗方案，而社交媒体上的网红可能没有临床训练。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a qualified physician + can prescribe + treatment；when necessary 为 when it is necessary 的省略；while 连接对比分句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
while 表对照；may have no 表可能没有。这里不把医生的动作和网红的资历混成一个主语，两个主体各有自己的谓语。

第4自然段
09—13

At a dining event, a waiter offers each guest a beverage and asks whether they prefer beer, soda, or bottled water.

用餐活动中，服务员给每位客人提供饮料，并问他们喜欢啤酒、汽水还是瓶装水。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A waiter + offers + each guest + a beverage；and asks + whether 宾从 they + prefer + 三项选择。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
offer 为双宾语；they 指性别未明确的每位客人。bottled 为形容词瓶装的，修饰 water，不是本句过去时。

09—14

The menu includes a vegetarian burger, a bean salad, and a dish made from corn and fibre-rich grain.

菜单包括素食汉堡、豆类沙拉和一道用玉米及富含纤维谷物制成的菜。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The menu + includes + 三个宾语；made from...后置修饰 dish。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
vegetarian 为形容词；bean 在名词定语位置通常用单数；made from 表制作原料，不另立完整谓语。

09—15

A guest asks if the sauce contains a sugary ingredient, while another requests a tasty substitute for a dish they dislike.

客人问酱汁是否含糖分高的食材，另一人则为不喜欢的菜请求美味替代品。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A guest + asks + if 宾从；while 后 another + requests...；they dislike 为省略关系代词的定从，修饰 dish。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
if 在这里表示是否，与条件 if 不同。dish 后 they dislike 缺宾语，由 dish 补上；不能再写 they dislike it。

09—16

The staff respond politely, explain the available choices, and avoid making a guest feel uncomfortable about their preference.

员工礼貌回应、解释可选项，避免让客人因偏好而尴尬。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The staff + respond... explain... and avoid...；avoid making + a guest + feel + uncomfortable。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
avoid 后 making；make sb feel 中 feel 不带 to，feel 后形容词 uncomfortable。三层动作由结构依次决定形式。

本篇用到哪些词表词

local, diet, expert, according, consumer, event, cooking, calorie, obesity, claim, evidence, image, protein, contain, per, available, variety, media, staff, item, purchase, pattern, snack, respond, grain, payment, brand, content, corn, microwave, soda, eating, carrot, luxury, bean, discount, intake, ordinary, wallet, burger, portion, grocery, judge, ingredient, physician, waiter, bottled, chef, attractive, distinguish, flavor, learner, persuade, spending, beer, label, enjoyable, fibre, frozen, mix, nutrient, preference, session, vegetarian, cure, dietary, dramatic, recipe, beverage, making, processed, qualified, clinical, deficiency, dining, mere, necessity, nutritional, sum, uncomfortable, universal, considerable, dislike, excess, oven, shopper, specialist, sugary, tasty, kilogram, merely, nutritious, prescribe, remedy, roast, substitute

ARTICLE 10 / 20

10 · 家、日常分工与自己的生活

约308个英文词 · 16句 · 含81个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖59个词条

In our household, my mom and dad share every domestic chore so that neither partner carries the entire burden. A married couple may differ in their preference for cooking or cleaning, but a fair arrangement can prevent resentment. Parental support is particularly valuable when an infant arrives and both adults suffer from a lack of sleep. Paid paternity leave enables a father to participate in early care and develop a close relationship with his child.

A young immigrant may rent a narrow apartment because urban housing is costly and a spacious villa is beyond their budget. The actual expense includes the monthly rent, an electricity charge, and a deposit that the agent must explain clearly. Before signing a legal document, a resident should inspect the property and record any damaged furniture or hidden defect. If the landlord plans to renovate the building, the tenant can ask whether temporary accommodation will be available.

My mum often recalls how an ancestor crossed a continent and built a new life with barely any money. The story describes a difficult journey, a precious family bond, and the wisdom that can arise from hardship. Although the original account is somewhat incomplete, its human element helps us relate to people from another era. I want to preserve the memory in a blog, not because the family was wealthy, but because ordinary lives also deserve recognition.

A person may be highly engaged in a hobby without wanting to turn it into a profession or sacrifice every other interest. It is unfair to approve a choice only when it brings a fortune or improves a public reputation. A hobby can suit someone's temperament, provide inspiration, and help them overcome a tough period even if it earns no income. The distinction between enjoyment and achievement matters because a life measured only by output can become unnecessarily narrow.

第1自然段
10—01

In our household, my mom and dad share every domestic chore so that neither partner carries the entire burden.

在我们家，妈妈和爸爸分担每项家务，让任何一方都不必承担全部负担。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 my mom and dad + share + every domestic chore；so that 从句 neither partner + carries + the entire burden。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
neither partner 表两人中任何一方都不，是单数，所以 carries 加 s。中文“让谁都不……”在此用目的从句，不必逐字翻成 make。

10—02

A married couple may differ in their preference for cooking or cleaning, but a fair arrangement can prevent resentment.

已婚夫妻可能在做饭或打扫的偏好上有所不同，但公平安排能防止怨怼。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A married couple + may differ；in...说明不同的方面；but 连接 a fair arrangement + can prevent + resentment。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
differ 为动词，不能写 may different；different 是形容词，需 may be different。中文“偏好不同”可以从“夫妻有所不同”切入重新组织。

10—03

Parental support is particularly valuable when an infant arrives and both adults suffer from a lack of sleep.

婴儿到来、两位成年人都缺觉时，来自父母的支持尤其珍贵。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 Parental support + is + particularly valuable；when 从句内有两个并列分句：an infant arrives、both adults suffer...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
lack 在这里作名词，a lack of sleep 表睡眠不足；suffer from 为搭配。particularly 修饰 valuable，不能用形容词 particular 替代。

10—04

Paid paternity leave enables a father to participate in early care and develop a close relationship with his child.

带薪陪产假让父亲能参与早期照护，并与孩子建立亲密关系。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Paid paternity leave + enables + a father + to participate... and develop...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“让父亲能……”选 enable sb to do；participate 后用 in。paid 是 leave 前的定语，“带薪”，不是说假期执行了付款动作。

第2自然段
10—05

A young immigrant may rent a narrow apartment because urban housing is costly and a spacious villa is beyond their budget.

年轻移民可能租一间狭小公寓，因为城市住房昂贵，宽敞别墅超出其预算。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 A young immigrant + may rent + a narrow apartment；because 后两个并列原因：housing is costly、a villa is beyond...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先确定租房动作，再给两个原因。beyond 是介词，可与 is 组成位置或范围意义的表语；their 指性别未明确的 immigrant。

10—06

The actual expense includes the monthly rent, an electricity charge, and a deposit that the agent must explain clearly.

实际费用包括月租、电费，以及中介必须解释清楚的一笔押金。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The actual expense + includes + 三个宾语；that...定语从句修饰 deposit，其中 that 作 explain 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“中介必须解释的押金”用 deposit that the agent must explain；that 在从句中代替押金，不能再写 explain it，造成重复宾语。

10—07

Before signing a legal document, a resident should inspect the property and record any damaged furniture or hidden defect.

签法律文件前，住户应检查房屋，并记录损坏的家具或隐藏的缺陷。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a resident + should inspect... and record...；Before signing...时间状语；damaged、hidden 分别修饰名词。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
signing 的主体与 resident 相同；两个过去分词都作修饰语，不是谓语。furniture 不可数，不写 furnitures 来表示多件家具。

10—08

If the landlord plans to renovate the building, the tenant can ask whether temporary accommodation will be available.

如果房东打算翻新大楼，租户可以询问是否会有临时住所可用。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 landlord + plans + to renovate...；主句 tenant + can ask + whether 宾从；宾从 accommodation + will be + available。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
whether 引出间接疑问，保持 accommodation will be 的陈述顺序。available 是形容词，需要 be；中文“有没有住所”不宜逐词拼接。

第3自然段
10—09

My mum often recalls how an ancestor crossed a continent and built a new life with barely any money.

妈妈常回忆，一位先辈如何几乎身无分文地穿越大陆，建立新生活。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
My mum + often recalls + how 宾从；an ancestor + crossed... and built...；with barely any money 为伴随条件。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
recalls 用现在时表示常讲，crossed/built 用过去时表故事事件。中文时间可由语境体现，英文在不同分句分别标出时间关系。

10—10

The story describes a difficult journey, a precious family bond, and the wisdom that can arise from hardship.

故事描述艰难旅程、珍贵家庭联结，以及可能从磨难中产生的智慧。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The story + describes + 三个宾语；that can arise from hardship 定语从句修饰 wisdom。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
arise from 表产生于，arise 不直接带宾语。wisdom 为抽象不可数；that 在定语从句里就是智慧这个主语。

10—11

Although the original account is somewhat incomplete, its human element helps us relate to people from another era.

尽管原始记述有点不完整，其中的人性成分仍帮助我们理解另一个时代的人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Although 从句 the original account + is + somewhat incomplete；主句 its human element + helps + us + relate to...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
relate to 在这里是理解和产生共鸣，不是简单讲述。somewhat 修饰形容词 incomplete；help 后 relate 可不用 to，但 relate 自己搭配的 to 必须保留。

10—12

I want to preserve the memory in a blog, not because the family was wealthy, but because ordinary lives also deserve recognition.

我想把记忆保存在博客中，不是因为家里富有，而是因为普通人生也值得被认可。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + want + to preserve...；not because...but because...为两个对照原因从句；ordinary lives + deserve + recognition。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两个 because 后各有完整主谓，不能只把原因词组接在 because 后。lives 为 life 的复数，是词形变化，不是动词 live 的单数。

第4自然段
10—13

A person may be highly engaged in a hobby without wanting to turn it into a profession or sacrifice every other interest.

人可以高度投入爱好，而不想把它变成职业，或牺牲其余所有兴趣。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A person + may be + highly engaged；in a hobby 补充投入对象；without wanting + to turn... or sacrifice...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
engaged 在这里是投入的，不是订婚；highly 修饰它。without 后 wanting，再由 want to 引出两个动作。

10—14

It is unfair to approve a choice only when it brings a fortune or improves a public reputation.

只有选择带来财富或改善公众名声时才赞同它，这样并不公平。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
It 为形式主语；is unfair 为谓语系表；to approve a choice...为真正主语；when 从句 it + brings... or improves...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
句首 It 代后面的长动作内容，后一个 it 指 choice；fortune 为财富。only when 限定赞同条件，不是否定财富本身。

10—15

A hobby can suit someone's temperament, provide inspiration, and help them overcome a tough period even if it earns no income.

爱好能适合一个人的性情、带来灵感，并帮助熬过艰难时期，即使它不赚钱。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A hobby + can suit... provide... and help...；help + them + overcome...；even if 从句 it + earns + no income。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
suit 在此为动词适合，非西装名词；overcome 直接接困难时期。even if 让步从句有自己的单数谓语 earns。

10—16

The distinction between enjoyment and achievement matters because a life measured only by output can become unnecessarily narrow.

乐趣与成就的区别很重要，因为只按产出来衡量的人生会变得不必要地狭窄。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The distinction... + matters；because 从句 a life measured only by output + can become + narrow；measured...后置定语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
distinction between A and B 为区别；measured 为被动修饰人生，不是主句另一个过去时。中文“只按产出衡量的人生”在英文拆到 life 后。

本篇用到哪些词表词

support, lack, relationship, suffer, account, resident, cooking, available, budget, partner, charge, income, particularly, achievement, household, immigrant, agent, differ, housing, expense, highly, valuable, participate, rent, legal, ordinary, parental, document, journey, preserve, tough, clearly, entire, narrow, property, urban, villa, wisdom, actual, burden, suit, era, married, mom, deserve, inspiration, apartment, barely, chore, costly, domestic, preference, reputation, approve, bond, overcome, arrangement, continent, fortune, infant, precious, wealthy, ancestor, arise, blog, element, monthly, profession, damaged, distinction, engaged, mum, original, paid, paternity, relate, somewhat, temporary, hidden, recognition, renovate

ARTICLE 11 / 20

11 · 出门以后：交通、旅行与意外

约631个英文词 · 32句 · 含146个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖105个词条

Every morning, a commuter takes the subway and uses a mobile app to track the arrival of a shuttle. The route crosses a crowded district where parking is limited and a bicycle lane provides an alternative means of transport. An ebike rider must obey the same regulation as a cyclist and slow down before a sharp bend. If a vehicle blocks the highway, an official may impose a penalty and urge the driver to remove it immediately.

A manufacturer is testing a driverless vehicle whose sophisticated sensor can detect an obstacle in poor light. An automatic control system must calculate distance, interpret a warning signal, and react to an unexpected movement. A technical failure could cause a crash, so the designer must consider the consequence of even a minor error. Before giving approval, the authority should require an independent assessment and publish its safety guideline.

A traveler and a holidaymaker arrive at the airport only to discover that their flight has suffered a long delay. The crew announce that the aircraft cannot depart until a severe storm has passed the coastal region. At the service desk, a worried passenger asks for assistance, while a calm assistant checks the booking detail. Eventually, the airline offers an alternative destination or a refund, and we opt for the latter option.

A tourism agency recommends a quiet coastal site where visitors can enjoy the landscape and observe marine wildlife. We book a cruise, pack sunscreen and suitable clothing, and check whether outdoor activities are included in the fare. A dolphin emerges beside the boat, and its graceful movement attracts a crowd of curious passengers. The guide reminds us to keep our distance because even a familiar creature deserves respect in its native habitat.

A driver may panic when lightning strikes nearby, but a sudden reaction can pose a greater danger than the storm itself. The safety instructor asks us to anticipate a risk, slow down early, and avoid an abrupt maneuver that could injure a passenger. After an accident, the report should identify the victim, describe the event, and distinguish a cause from a mere coincidence. A careful review can help prevent a repeat, while careless blame may discourage witnesses from reporting what they actually saw.

Our camping plan changes when a weather warning tells us that the river could rise and the muddy ground might become a trap. We decide to halt the journey, seek shade, and wait under a shelter instead of crossing the stream in a risky way. One member tries to grab a loose bag, but another warns that they could slip, fall, and badly hurt a knee. The interruption is frustrating, yet everyone agrees that a delayed adventure is preferable to a disaster that could permanently alter a life.

A traffic jam can make driving extremely slow, especially during the rush hour when numerous commuters cross a busy border. I leave earlier to stay ahead of the crowd, yet an unexpected delay can still cause a mess and make me arrive later. A driver should not race to catch up, because racing through a crowded street can threaten everyone nearby. Instead, I choose a safe pace, check the forecast routinely, and remember that arriving safely matters more than a minute saved.

Around a campfire, adults discuss whether rum and other drinks should be served; in addition, they check that everyone has a safe way home. One guest likes to wander away from the noise, while another has a tendency to talk until everyone else is tired. The host can gently inform a talkative person about the time; otherwise, a friendly gathering may turn into an exhausting duty. The point is to enjoy company rather than get rid of every awkward pause, because silence does not always bother a close friend.

第1自然段
11—01

Every morning, a commuter takes the subway and uses a mobile app to track the arrival of a shuttle.

每天早上，一名通勤者乘地铁，并用手机应用追踪接驳车到站情况。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a commuter + takes... and uses...；to track...为目的状语，说明使用 app 做什么。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“用应用来追踪”用 use A to do B。takes 与 uses 都跟单数主语变化；to track 不随主语变成 tracks，因为它是不定式。

11—02

The route crosses a crowded district where parking is limited and a bicycle lane provides an alternative means of transport.

路线穿过一个拥挤城区，那里停车位有限，自行车道提供了另一种交通方式。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The route + crosses + a crowded district；where 定语从句修饰 district；从句里 parking is limited 与 a lane provides...并列。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
where 在从句中表“在那里”，不是作主语；真正主语分别是 parking 和 a bicycle lane。means 在此表示方式，单复数形式相同。

11—03

An ebike rider must obey the same regulation as a cyclist and slow down before a sharp bend.

电动自行车骑手必须像骑自行车的人一样遵守同一规定，并在急弯前减速。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An ebike rider + must obey... and slow down...；as a cyclist 为比较省略；before a sharp bend 为地点性时间背景。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
must 管 obey 和 slow 两个动作。中文“在急弯前”在这里指抵达弯道之前，所以用 before；sharp 修饰 bend 表弯急。

11—04

If a vehicle blocks the highway, an official may impose a penalty and urge the driver to remove it immediately.

如果车辆堵住公路，官员可能施加处罚，并敦促司机立即把车移走。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 a vehicle + blocks + the highway；主句 an official + may impose... and urge + the driver + to remove it。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
urge sb to do 表敦促；it 指 vehicle。blocks 为从句自己的谓语，单数加 s；主句的 may 不影响条件从句的动词形式。

第2自然段
11—05

A manufacturer is testing a driverless vehicle whose sophisticated sensor can detect an obstacle in poor light.

制造商正在测试一辆无人驾驶汽车，它的精密传感器能在弱光下发现障碍物。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A manufacturer + is testing + a driverless vehicle；whose sensor + can detect + an obstacle 为定语从句。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
正在进行的测试用 is testing；whose 表车的传感器。中文“它的”另起表达，英文可用 whose 合并，避免拆成两个松散句子。

11—06

An automatic control system must calculate distance, interpret a warning signal, and react to an unexpected movement.

自动控制系统必须计算距离、解读警告信号，并对意外移动作出反应。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An automatic control system + must calculate... interpret... and react...；to an unexpected movement 为 react 的介词补足语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
calculate、interpret 直接接宾语；react 要用 to。中文三个动作都可直接带对象，英文需分别检查各动词的搭配。

11—07

A technical failure could cause a crash, so the designer must consider the consequence of even a minor error.

技术故障可能导致碰撞，因此设计者必须考虑哪怕微小错误带来的后果。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A technical failure + could cause + a crash；so 连接结果分句 the designer + must consider + the consequence...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
could 在这里表示可能性，不一定指过去。so 作为连词连接因果结果；of even a minor error 限定后果属于什么错误。

11—08

Before giving approval, the authority should require an independent assessment and publish its safety guideline.

批准之前，主管部门应要求独立评估，并公布其安全指导准则。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the authority + should require... and publish...；Before giving approval 为时间状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“给予批准”用 give approval，approval 此处不可数。require 后接 assessment 名词；publish 与 require 同为 should 管辖的原形。

第3自然段
11—09

A traveler and a holidaymaker arrive at the airport only to discover that their flight has suffered a long delay.

一名旅行者和一名度假者到机场后，却发现他们的航班已经长时间延误。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + arrive；only to discover...表出乎意料的结果；that 宾从 their flight + has suffered + a long delay。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
only to do 常表示意外结果，不是“为了发现”。has suffered 为现在完成时，强调到发现时延误已发生；不能只凭中文词序拼接。

11—10

The crew announce that the aircraft cannot depart until a severe storm has passed the coastal region.

机组人员宣布，飞机要等强风暴经过沿海地区后才能起飞。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The crew + announce + that 宾语从句；从句 the aircraft + cannot depart；until 时间从句 a severe storm + has passed...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
crew 此处强调机组成员整体中的人，使用复数一致是可接受的英式用法；cannot...until 表直到……才，不要把 until 误解为起飞截止时间。

11—11

At the service desk, a worried passenger asks for assistance, while a calm assistant checks the booking detail.

服务台前，焦虑的乘客请求帮助，而冷静的助理核查预订详情。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a worried passenger + asks for + assistance；while 连接 a calm assistant + checks + the booking detail。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
while 在这里是对照，不一定强调“在……期间”。assistance 不可数；detail 此处指一项具体预订信息，前有 the 限定。

11—12

Eventually, the airline offers an alternative destination or a refund, and we opt for the latter option.

最终，航空公司提供改去另一目的地或退款的选择，我们选择后者。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① the airline + offers + 两个选择；分句② we + opt for + the latter option。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
opt for 表选择，不能漏 for；latter 指前述两项中的后者。中文可直接说“选后一个”，英文用 the latter option 指回退款。

第4自然段
11—13

A tourism agency recommends a quiet coastal site where visitors can enjoy the landscape and observe marine wildlife.

旅游机构推荐一个安静的海边地点，游客可以在那里欣赏风景、观察海洋野生动物。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A tourism agency + recommends + a quiet coastal site；where 从句 visitors + can enjoy... and observe...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
where 表地点关系；不能同时再加 there。recommend 这里接地点名词，不是 recommend sb to do 的句型。

11—14

We book a cruise, pack sunscreen and suitable clothing, and check whether outdoor activities are included in the fare.

我们预订游船旅行，装上防晒霜和合适衣物，并确认票价是否包含户外活动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + book... pack... and check...；whether 宾从 outdoor activities + are included + in the fare。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“活动被包含在票价中”用被动 are included。clothing 为衣物统称，不加 s；fare 指交通或旅程票价，不是一般商品价格。

11—15

A dolphin emerges beside the boat, and its graceful movement attracts a crowd of curious passengers.

一只海豚在船边浮现，优美的动作吸引了一群好奇乘客。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① A dolphin + emerges；beside the boat 为地点；分句② its graceful movement + attracts + a crowd...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“浮现”直接用 emerge，无需加 be；beside 表在旁边，不是 besides“此外”。its 指海豚，不能写成 it's，后者是 it is。

11—16

The guide reminds us to keep our distance because even a familiar creature deserves respect in its native habitat.

导游提醒我们保持距离，因为即便是熟悉的动物，在原生栖息地也应得到尊重。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The guide + reminds + us + to keep...；because 从句 a familiar creature + deserves + respect；in...为地点状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
remind sb to do 提醒行动，与 remind sb that 提醒事实不同。deserve 在这里直接接名词 respect；中文“应得到”可以通过 deserve 本身表达。

第5自然段
11—17

A driver may panic when lightning strikes nearby, but a sudden reaction can pose a greater danger than the storm itself.

附近出现雷击时，司机可能惊慌，但突然反应可能比暴风雨本身造成更大危险。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A driver + may panic；when 从句 lightning + strikes；but 后 a sudden reaction + can pose + a greater danger；than...比较。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
panic 在这里是动词；pose danger 为构成危险。lightning 不可数，不写 a lightning；其谓语 strikes 为单数形式。

11—18

The safety instructor asks us to anticipate a risk, slow down early, and avoid an abrupt maneuver that could injure a passenger.

安全教师要求预判风险、提前减速，并避免可能伤到乘客的突然操作。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The safety instructor + asks + us + to anticipate... slow down... and avoid...；that could injure...修饰 maneuver。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
injure 为动词伤害，injury 为名词；anticipate 直接接风险。that 作从句主语，指突然操作，不是乘客。

11—19

After an accident, the report should identify the victim, describe the event, and distinguish a cause from a mere coincidence.

事故后，报告应确认受害者、描述事件，并区分原因和单纯巧合。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
the report + should identify... describe... and distinguish...；distinguish A from B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
victim 为受害者，不表示其必有过错；mere 修饰 coincidence 为仅仅的。三个谓语都受 should 管辖，保持原形。

11—20

A careful review can help prevent a repeat, while careless blame may discourage witnesses from reporting what they actually saw.

细致复盘能帮助预防重演，而草率责备可能使目击者不愿报告实际所见。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A careful review + can help prevent...；while 后 careless blame + may discourage + witnesses + from reporting...；what they saw 为 reporting 的宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
discourage sb from doing 表阻止/打消做某事念头；actually 修饰 saw。what 同时表达“所见之事”并作 saw 的宾语，不再添 it。

第6自然段
11—21

Our camping plan changes when a weather warning tells us that the river could rise and the muddy ground might become a trap.

天气警报称河水可能上涨、泥地可能成为陷阱，我们的露营计划因此改变。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 Our camping plan + changes；when 从句 warning + tells + us + that 宾从；宾从里两个并列可能结果。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
camping 作名词定语；trap 为陷阱名词。could/might 表预测可能性；整句先写计划变化，再通过 when 交代触发背景。

11—22

We decide to halt the journey, seek shade, and wait under a shelter instead of crossing the stream in a risky way.

我们决定中止行程、找阴凉，并在遮蔽物下等候，不冒险过溪。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + decide + to halt... seek... and wait...；instead of crossing...为对比；in a risky way 表方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
halt 作及物动词中止；risky 为形容词修饰 way，也可用 riskily，但这里保留词表原形。decide to 管三个动作。

11—23

One member tries to grab a loose bag, but another warns that they could slip, fall, and badly hurt a knee.

一名成员试图抓住松脱的包，另一人警告说，可能滑倒、摔下并严重伤到膝盖。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
One member + tries + to grab...；but 后 another + warns + that 宾从；they + could slip... fall... and hurt...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
slip 为滑倒，badly 修饰 hurt 程度；they 回指性别未明确的 member。could 统领三个原形，不把 fall 写成 fell。

11—24

The interruption is frustrating, yet everyone agrees that a delayed adventure is preferable to a disaster that could permanently alter a life.

中断令人沮丧，但大家同意，延后的冒险比可能永久改变人生的灾难更可取。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The interruption + is + frustrating；yet 后 everyone + agrees + that 宾从；adventure + is preferable to...；that could alter...修饰 disaster。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
preferable to 用 to 比较，不用 than；alter 为改变。两个 that 职责不同：前者引宾语内容，后者作修饰灾难的定语从句主语。

第7自然段
11—25

A traffic jam can make driving extremely slow, especially during the rush hour when numerous commuters cross a busy border.

交通堵塞会让开车极慢，尤其在大量通勤者跨越繁忙边界的高峰时段。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A traffic jam + can make + driving + extremely slow；when...定从修饰 rush hour；commuters + cross...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
driving 为动名词宾语，slow 是宾补形容词；extremely 修饰 slow。border 按边界义使用，不特指某个真实口岸。

11—26

I leave earlier to stay ahead of the crowd, yet an unexpected delay can still cause a mess and make me arrive later.

我提前离开以走在人群前，但意外耽搁仍会造成混乱，让我晚到。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + leave；to stay ahead...表目的；yet 后 delay + can cause... and make + me + arrive later。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
make sb do 后 arrive 原形；earlier 与 later 分别修饰出发和到达，不是名词。ahead of 表在……前面。

11—27

A driver should not race to catch up, because racing through a crowded street can threaten everyone nearby.

司机不应为赶上而飙车，因为在拥挤街道竞速会威胁附近所有人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 A driver + should not race；to catch up 为目的；because 从句 racing through... + can threaten...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
race 是原形谓语，racing 为原因从句的动名词主语；两种形式来自句法位置，不是随意变换。threaten 为及物动词。

11—28

Instead, I choose a safe pace, check the forecast routinely, and remember that arriving safely matters more than a minute saved.

我改选安全节奏、例行查看预报，并记住安全到达比省一分钟更重要。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + choose... check... and remember...；that 宾从 arriving safely + matters + more than a minute saved。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
arriving safely 是名词性主语，用 matters 单数；saved 过去分词后置修饰 minute。routinely 修饰检查动作。

第8自然段
11—29

Around a campfire, adults discuss whether rum and other drinks should be served; in addition, they check that everyone has a safe way home.

篝火旁，成年人讨论是否提供朗姆酒等饮品；另外，他们确认每人都有安全回家方式。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
adults + discuss + whether 宾从；rum and other drinks + should be served；后句 they + check + that 宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
rum 为朗姆酒；in addition 为此外的副词短语，两独立句间用分号。should be served 被动表示饮品被提供，不是饮品主动招待别人。

11—30

One guest likes to wander away from the noise, while another has a tendency to talk until everyone else is tired.

一位客人喜欢离开喧闹随处走走，另一位则倾向于一直说到别人都累了。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
One guest + likes + to wander...；while 后 another + has + a tendency + to talk...；until 从句 everyone else + is + tired。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tendency to do 表做某事的倾向；wander 不及物，away from 指离开的方向。everyone 为单数，虽中文指大家，英文仍用 is。

11—31

The host can gently inform a talkative person about the time; otherwise, a friendly gathering may turn into an exhausting duty.

主人可温和告知健谈者时间；否则，友好聚会可能变成令人疲惫的任务。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
host + can inform + a talkative person + about the time；otherwise 连接结果判断；gathering + may turn into...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
otherwise 为否则，前用分号；inform sb about sth 搭配。exhausting 描述使人疲惫的事，区别 exhausted 描述疲惫的人。

11—32

The point is to enjoy company rather than get rid of every awkward pause, because silence does not always bother a close friend.

重点是享受陪伴，而非消灭每个尴尬停顿，因为沉默不总会打扰亲近朋友。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The point + is + to enjoy... rather than get rid of...；because 从句 silence + does not always bother...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
get rid of 为摆脱固定短语；bother 为动词打扰。not always 表不一定每次，不是说沉默从来不会影响人。

本篇用到哪些词表词

system, actually, risk, later, event, option, seek, identify, jam, publish, official, remove, detail, region, failure, vehicle, consequence, district, site, flight, extremely, lane, manufacturer, track, ahead, authority, assistant, delay, means, agency, driving, eventually, familiar, mobile, movement, app, distance, addition, warning, announce, designer, driverless, trap, disaster, dolphin, guide, highway, limited, crowd, curious, native, habitat, observe, journey, pose, signal, sunscreen, transport, alternative, minor, parking, penalty, ebike, error, numerous, severe, worried, aircraft, border, clothing, crash, host, victim, guideline, regulation, rid, rum, tendency, tourism, wander, wildlife, distinguish, pace, approval, assistance, blame, calm, creature, destination, detect, urge, crew, racing, route, traveler, assessment, automatic, badly, instructor, react, threaten, alter, calculate, discourage, interpret, lightning, mess, obstacle, opt, otherwise, outdoor, reaction, shade, shelter, shuttle, unexpected, earlier, halt, impose, inform, injure, marine, mere, panic, rider, sharp, sophisticated, testing, adventure, camping, cannot, crowded, fare, permanently, slip, anticipate, bother, cruise, cyclist, grab, holidaymaker, landscape, risky, routinely, safely, subway

ARTICLE 12 / 20

12 · 在自然中观察和保护生命

约228个英文词 · 12句 · 含63个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖51个词条

An endangered species may disappear when human activity destroys its habitat or reduces the supply of freshwater. A conservation organization works with a research institute to preserve genetic diversity and protect a vulnerable mammal. On the savannah, a ranger may encounter a giant herbivore, a small wild bird, or a poisonous snake. The campaign asks residents to abandon illegal hunting and support the protection of every living being.

A child watches a raccoon climb a branch while a slug moves slowly across the damp soil beneath it. In the nearby field, a donkey stands beside a mule, and a farmer explains how the two animals differ. The child asks why some birds hunt insects and how a cage can restrict a creature's natural movement. The farmer says that patient observation can reveal a characteristic trait and spark an interest in agriculture.

At the edge of a quiet zone, we watch fish breed, birds settle on a fence, and a hungry animal bite a fallen fruit. A guide explains that a bone can survive long after soft tissue begins to deteriorate, but preservation depends on the environment. The length of a river and the depth of a lake may shrink during a drought, causing widespread concern about nutrition and water supply. Unfortunately, pollution can hinder recovery, so the group plans to donate funds and inform residents about the threat.

第1自然段
12—01

An endangered species may disappear when human activity destroys its habitat or reduces the supply of freshwater.

人类活动破坏栖息地或减少淡水供应时，濒危物种可能消失。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句 An endangered species + may disappear；when 从句 human activity + destroys... or reduces...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
species 单复数同形，这里前有 An，指一个物种。when 从句两个动作同一单数主语，destroys 和 reduces 都加 s。

12—02

A conservation organization works with a research institute to preserve genetic diversity and protect a vulnerable mammal.

保护组织与研究所合作，以保存遗传多样性并保护一种脆弱的哺乳动物。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A conservation organization + works with + a research institute；to preserve... and protect...表目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
主干是 organization works，不因 with 后又有机构而变复数。两个目的动作共用 to；中文“和……一起”不能直接当 and 并列主语。

12—03

On the savannah, a ranger may encounter a giant herbivore, a small wild bird, or a poisonous snake.

在热带稀树草原上，护林员可能遇到巨型食草动物、小型野鸟或毒蛇。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
地点 On the savannah；a ranger + may encounter + 三个并列宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
encounter 是及物动词，直接接遇到的对象，不写 encounter with。每类单数可数动物前都给出 a，表达可能遇到其中一个个体。

12—04

The campaign asks residents to abandon illegal hunting and support the protection of every living being.

这场宣传活动要求居民放弃非法狩猎，并支持对每个生命的保护。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The campaign + asks + residents + to abandon... and support...；of every living being 修饰 protection。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
being 在这里是名词“生命个体”，不是进行时中的 be。ask sb to do 把两个要求连接起来；hunting 是名词性活动。

第2自然段
12—05

A child watches a raccoon climb a branch while a slug moves slowly across the damp soil beneath it.

孩子看着浣熊爬上树枝，同时一只蛞蝓在下方湿土上缓慢移动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A child + watches + a raccoon + climb...；while 从句 a slug + moves；slowly 为方式副词。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
watch sb do 表观察完整动作，climb 不带 to；slug 为蛞蝓，不是网址简称。beneath it 的 it 在此指树枝下方，依据位置理解。

12—06

In the nearby field, a donkey stands beside a mule, and a farmer explains how the two animals differ.

附近田里，一头驴站在骡旁，农民解释两种动物有何不同。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句① a donkey + stands；分句② a farmer + explains + how 宾从；the two animals + differ。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
donkey 与 mule 是不同动物名词；how 从句不能倒装。旁边关系用 beside；中文“有何不同”在英文由 differ 动词表达。

12—07

The child asks why some birds hunt insects and how a cage can restrict a creature's natural movement.

孩子问为什么有些鸟捕食昆虫，以及笼子会怎样限制动物自然活动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The child + asks + 两个并列宾从；why some birds hunt insects；how a cage can restrict...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
hunt 在这里指捕食动作，直接接 insects；两个疑问从句都采用陈述顺序。and 连接的是完整的提问内容，不仅两个动词。

12—08

The farmer says that patient observation can reveal a characteristic trait and spark an interest in agriculture.

农民说，耐心观察能揭示一种典型特征，并激发对农业的兴趣。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The farmer + says + that 宾从；patient observation + can reveal... and spark...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
observation 为主语，patient 在此是形容词有耐心的，不是病人。spark 作动词激发；characteristic 修饰 trait。

第3自然段
12—09

At the edge of a quiet zone, we watch fish breed, birds settle on a fence, and a hungry animal bite a fallen fruit.

安静区域边缘，我们观察鱼繁殖、鸟落在篱笆上，以及饥饿动物咬落果。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + watch + 三组宾语加原形动作：fish breed、birds settle、an animal bite；地点状语在前。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
watch 后每组动作都用原形，故 an animal 后仍为 bite 而非 bites。breed 在此为繁殖动词，settle 指落下停驻。

12—10

A guide explains that a bone can survive long after soft tissue begins to deteriorate, but preservation depends on the environment.

导游解释，骨骼能在软组织开始腐坏后存留很久，但保存情况取决于环境。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
guide + explains + that 宾从；bone + can survive；after 从句 soft tissue + begins + to deteriorate；but 后 preservation + depends...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
deteriorate 为变坏的动词，不写 be deteriorate；long after 表在……之后很久。depends on 为依赖搭配。

12—11

The length of a river and the depth of a lake may shrink during a drought, causing widespread concern about nutrition and water supply.

干旱中，河流长度和湖泊深度可能缩减，引发对营养与供水的广泛担忧。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 The length...and the depth...；may shrink；causing...为结果状语，主语逻辑上是前面整个变化。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
shrink 为缩减；causing 非新谓语，用 ing 承接前句结果。widespread 修饰 concern 表担忧分布广泛。

12—12

Unfortunately, pollution can hinder recovery, so the group plans to donate funds and inform residents about the threat.

不幸的是，污染会妨碍恢复，因此小组计划捐款，并告知居民相关威胁。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
pollution + can hinder...；so 后 group + plans + to donate... and inform...；inform + residents + about the threat。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
inform sb about sth 为告知，不能写 inform sth to sb 来照搬中文。Unfortunately 修饰整个负面判断，首字母和逗号标明句首副词。

本篇用到哪些词表词

support, concern, organization, species, reveal, wild, pollution, diversity, genetic, protection, characteristic, differ, being, campaign, movement, threat, survive, guide, vulnerable, trait, disappear, habitat, institute, nutrition, bone, preserve, unfortunately, widespread, hinder, poisonous, settle, abandon, mule, creature, donate, encounter, hunt, shrink, endangered, slowly, bite, cage, depth, drought, raccoon, slug, zone, agriculture, giant, hunting, breed, conservation, inform, length, spark, tissue, mammal, recovery, savannah, branch, deteriorate, donkey, freshwater
