ARTICLE 13 / 20

13 · 从农田到工厂：环境怎样改变

约459个英文词 · 24句 · 含139个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖94个词条

A community campaigner wants to raise awareness of global warming and explain its environmental impact in plain language. The campaign explains that fossil fuel consumption can release carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. A renewable energy project can use solar power to reduce emission levels and lower dependence on imported gas. Although no single measure can solve the entire crisis, united local action can contribute to a more sustainable economy.

The city council plans to establish a recycling facility that can handle a massive quantity of household garbage. Residents must classify each container, separate a recyclable bottle from other trash, and follow the collection schedule. A factory can recycle raw material and manufacture a new product from recycled plastic instead of burying it. This process may generate revenue, but its primary aim is to limit waste and prevent harmful substances from entering the soil.

A rural farmer joins an agricultural initiative that promotes environmentally responsible farming and supports the region's food security. The initiative provides funding for a greenhouse, a water pump, and equipment that can improve the annual crop yield. Farmers observe the weather, adjust irrigation, and harvest grain before excessive rain can damage the roots. If a drought threatens the harvest, a cooperative can offer financial aid and distribute an adequate supply of seed.

A developed region may depend heavily on manufacturing, yet industrial pollution can threaten the health of nearby communities. A miner and a factory worker may face different risks, so an effective safety plan must account for each type of hazard. An engineer proposes a cleaner method to decrease waste, improve ventilation, and prevent a machine from injuring a worker. The improvement may require a considerable investment, but it can greatly reduce harm and eventually lower the rate of injury.

A continuous flow of industrial waste may emit an unpleasant smell and negatively affect the climate of a nearby residential area. At a manufacturing plant, workers must not bury toxic material or let it sink into soil from a damaged storage tank. A federal inspector may impose a reduction target and require the producer to tackle a problem before it becomes deadly. The aim is to improve conditions to the extent possible without pretending that one rule will solve an enormous problem overnight.

A military aircraft crosses a vast area of ice while researchers estimate the mass of snow that could melt during a warm season. Due to increased temperatures, the team is increasingly concerned about changes that may evolve over a long period. Cold winds surround the station, which is used primarily for observation rather than for commercial activity. The data are still limited; thus, the report gives a rough estimate of roughly two years rather than a precise prediction.

第1自然段
13—01

A community campaigner wants to raise awareness of global warming and explain its environmental impact in plain language.

一名社区活动人士想提高大家对全球变暖的认识，并用朴素语言解释其环境影响。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A community campaigner + wants + to raise... and explain...；of global warming 修饰 awareness；in plain language 表方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
raise awareness of 为搭配，不能逐字拼成 improve people know。its 指全球变暖；两个目标动作共用 wants to。

13—02

The campaign explains that fossil fuel consumption can release carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.

活动说明，化石燃料消耗可能向大气释放二氧化碳和其他温室气体。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The campaign + explains + that 宾从；从句 fossil fuel consumption + can release + carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases；into...表方向。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“释放到……”用 release A into B；consumption 是主语中心词，前面 fossil fuel 是修饰。that 不作从句主语，真正主语是整个名词短语。

13—03

A renewable energy project can use solar power to reduce emission levels and lower dependence on imported gas.

可再生能源项目能利用太阳能降低排放水平，并减少对进口天然气的依赖。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A renewable energy project + can use + solar power；to reduce... and lower...为目的；on imported gas 修饰 dependence。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
use A to do 表用什么做什么；reduce 与 lower 都是目的动词。imported 是 import 的过去分词，作定语修饰 gas，不是独立谓语。

13—04

Although no single measure can solve the entire crisis, united local action can contribute to a more sustainable economy.

尽管没有任何单项措施能解决整个危机，团结的地方行动仍能促进更可持续的经济。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Although 从句 no single measure + can solve...；主句 united local action + can contribute to...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
contribute to 表促成，to 在这里是介词，后接名词 economy。although 已表示转折关系，主句不再加 but。

第2自然段
13—05

The city council plans to establish a recycling facility that can handle a massive quantity of household garbage.

市议会计划建立一座回收设施，以处理大量家庭垃圾。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The city council + plans + to establish...；that can handle...定语从句修饰 facility；a massive quantity of...为宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“能处理垃圾的设施”用 that 后置；quantity 为数量单位，garbage 不可数。handle 直接接需要处理的东西，不加 with。

13—06

Residents must classify each container, separate a recyclable bottle from other trash, and follow the collection schedule.

居民必须给各个容器分类，把可回收瓶与其他垃圾分开，并遵守收集时间表。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Residents + must classify... separate... and follow...；separate A from B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“把 A 和 B 分开”在此用 separate A from B。must 后三个动词都不变形；each container 用单数。

13—07

A factory can recycle raw material and manufacture a new product from recycled plastic instead of burying it.

工厂可以回收原材料，并用再生塑料制造新产品，而不是把塑料掩埋。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A factory + can recycle... and manufacture...；from recycled plastic 表原料；instead of burying it 表对比方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
manufacture A from B 表用原料制造，from 强调材料来源。burying 跟在 of 后；it 指塑料，不是新产品。

13—08

This process may generate revenue, but its primary aim is to limit waste and prevent harmful substances from entering the soil.

这个过程可能产生收入，但首要目标是限制浪费，并防止有害物质进入土壤。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
分句② its primary aim + is + to limit... and prevent...；prevent + substances + from entering...；前句 process + may generate + revenue。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
is 后的不定式说明目标内容；prevent A from doing 表阻止某事发生，entering 由介词 from 决定。substances 用复数泛指物质种类。

第3自然段
13—09

A rural farmer joins an agricultural initiative that promotes environmentally responsible farming and supports the region's food security.

一位乡村农民加入一项农业倡议，倡议推广对环境负责的耕作，并支持地区粮食安全。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A rural farmer + joins + an agricultural initiative；that promotes... and supports...为定语从句，that 指 initiative。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
从句两个动词跟单数 initiative，用 promotes/supports。environmentally 是副词，修饰 responsible；不是直接拿它作名词 farming 的形容词。

13—10

The initiative provides funding for a greenhouse, a water pump, and equipment that can improve the annual crop yield.

倡议为温室、水泵及能够提高年度作物产量的设备提供资金。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The initiative + provides + funding；for 三个资助对象；that can improve...修饰 equipment。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
funding 为不可数名词；equipment 也是不可数，不写 equipments。yield 在这里是名词“产量”，不是动词“产生”。

13—11

Farmers observe the weather, adjust irrigation, and harvest grain before excessive rain can damage the roots.

农民观察天气、调整灌溉，并在过量降雨损害根部之前收割谷物。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Farmers + observe... adjust... and harvest...；before 从句 excessive rain + can damage + the roots。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“雨水损害根部之前”是一完整时间从句，用 before 接入。excessive 修饰雨量；damage 在此是动词，不能另外加一个 is。

13—12

If a drought threatens the harvest, a cooperative can offer financial aid and distribute an adequate supply of seed.

如果干旱威胁收成，合作社可以提供资金援助，并分发足量种子。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 a drought + threatens + the harvest；主句 a cooperative + can offer... and distribute...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
harvest 此处转为名词收成，与上句动词收割不同；一词多义由位置和句意判断。supply of seed 为供应量，seed 可作种子总称。

第4自然段
13—13

A developed region may depend heavily on manufacturing, yet industrial pollution can threaten the health of nearby communities.

发达地区可能高度依赖制造业，但工业污染可能威胁附近社区健康。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A developed region + may depend + heavily + on manufacturing；yet 后 industrial pollution + can threaten...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
developed 在此为发达的形容词，manufacturing 为制造业名词。depend on 为搭配；threaten 是动词，不把名词 threat 放在 can 后。

13—14

A miner and a factory worker may face different risks, so an effective safety plan must account for each type of hazard.

矿工与工厂工人可能面临不同风险，因此有效安全计划必须考虑每类危险。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + may face...；so 后 an effective safety plan + must account for + each type of hazard。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
account for 在此表示考虑/纳入解释范围；type 在 each 后用单数。risk 的复数表示多种危险，和泛指风险的不可数用法区分。

13—15

An engineer proposes a cleaner method to decrease waste, improve ventilation, and prevent a machine from injuring a worker.

工程师提出更清洁的方法，以减少废物、改善通风，并防止机器伤到工人。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An engineer + proposes + a cleaner method；to decrease... improve... and prevent...说明目的；prevent + a machine + from injuring...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
decrease 可作及物动词减少；injuring 是 injure 的动名词。machine 虽不是人，也可作伤害动作的执行主体。

13—16

The improvement may require a considerable investment, but it can greatly reduce harm and eventually lower the rate of injury.

改进可能需要相当投资，但能大幅减少危害，并最终降低受伤率。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The improvement + may require...；but 后 it + can reduce... and lower...；greatly、eventually 分别修饰动作。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
harm 在这里为不可数损害；injury 为受伤概念。rate of injury 指发生率，不是费用；词义需结合安全场景确定。

第5自然段
13—17

A continuous flow of industrial waste may emit an unpleasant smell and negatively affect the climate of a nearby residential area.

持续工业废物流可能散发难闻气味，并负面影响附近住宅区的环境氛围。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A continuous flow... + may emit... and affect...；negatively 修饰 affect；of a nearby residential area 限定 climate。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
climate 在此按原表“环境/氛围”义，而非断言局地气味改变全球气候；continuous 为持续不断。emit 是散发的动词。

13—18

At a manufacturing plant, workers must not bury toxic material or let it sink into soil from a damaged storage tank.

制造厂里，工人不得掩埋有毒材料，也不得任其从受损储罐渗入土壤。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
workers + must not bury... or let...；let + it + sink...；into soil 表方向；from...表来源。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
sink 在这里为下沉进入的动作；let 后不加 to。must not 表禁止，不是“不需要”；or 连接两个都被否定的行为。

13—19

A federal inspector may impose a reduction target and require the producer to tackle a problem before it becomes deadly.

联邦检查员可以设定减排目标，并要求生产者在问题变致命前着手处理。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
inspector + may impose... and require + producer + to tackle...；before 从句 it + becomes + deadly。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tackle 为着手处理，直接接 problem；federal 为联邦的形容词。deadly 是表语，become 后不写 deadlyly。

13—20

The aim is to improve conditions to the extent possible without pretending that one rule will solve an enormous problem overnight.

目标是尽可能改善条件，而不假装一项规则能一夜解决巨大问题。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The aim + is + to improve...；to the extent possible 为程度状语；without pretending + that 宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
extent 为程度；possible 后省略的意思是 that is possible。一个句子里多个 to 可分别属于不定式与固定程度短语，需按功能区分。

第6自然段
13—21

A military aircraft crosses a vast area of ice while researchers estimate the mass of snow that could melt during a warm season.

军用飞机飞越大片冰原，研究人员估算暖季可能融化的积雪质量。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
aircraft + crosses + a vast area；while 后 researchers + estimate + the mass...；that could melt 定从修饰 snow。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
military 为军用形容词；mass 是质量。melt 不及物表示融化，that 指 snow 作从句主语，不是估算动作的对象重复出现。

13—22

Due to increased temperatures, the team is increasingly concerned about changes that may evolve over a long period.

由于气温升高，团队越来越担忧可能长期演变的变化。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Due to increased temperatures 为原因短语；the team + is + increasingly concerned；that may evolve...修饰 changes。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
due to 后接名词短语，不接完整句；increased 是定语升高的，increasingly 为副词越来越。evolve 为演变的动词，不加 be。

13—23

Cold winds surround the station, which is used primarily for observation rather than for commercial activity.

冷风包围站点，该站主要用于观测而非商业活动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Cold winds + surround + the station；which is used...为非限制性定从；primarily 修饰 used。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
逗号加 which 补充说明已有站点；which 作被动主语。surround 直接接被包围对象，不加 around 造成重复含义。

13—24

The data are still limited; thus, the report gives a rough estimate of roughly two years rather than a precise prediction.

数据仍有限，因此报告给出大约两年的粗略估计，而非精确预测。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
前句 The data + are + limited；后句 the report + gives + a rough estimate；thus 为结果副词；of roughly two years 限定估计。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
thus 为连接副词，前面用分号而不是只用逗号。rough 修饰 estimate 用形容词，roughly 修饰 two years 用副词。

本篇用到哪些词表词

local, product, reduce, affect, process, financial, impact, type, project, community, global, rate, contribute, data, material, measure, effective, due, security, account, climate, united, power, economy, solve, damage, increasingly, limit, region, consumption, harm, facility, aim, pollution, environmental, crop, household, crisis, equipment, solar, harmful, release, campaign, eventually, grain, improvement, decrease, fuel, gas, handle, council, estimate, aid, thus, establish, lower, responsible, container, federal, fossil, target, awareness, commercial, concerned, limited, massive, yield, collection, enormous, observe, quantity, schedule, carbon, greatly, investment, military, sink, vast, warming, annual, entire, funding, generate, initiative, roughly, adjust, injury, trash, aircraft, emission, evolve, mass, increased, producer, pump, recycled, sustainable, recycling, reduction, atmosphere, farming, primarily, recycle, adequate, drought, flow, garbage, raw, revenue, tackle, threaten, environmentally, heavily, melt, negatively, surround, deadly, dioxide, distribute, emit, impose, industrial, manufacturing, renewable, campaigner, classify, considerable, damaged, extent, miner, agricultural, bury, continuous, developed, excessive, greenhouse, harvest, manufacture, rural

ARTICLE 14 / 20

14 · 困难中的社区：救援与重建

约299个英文词 · 16句 · 含100个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖60个词条

After a hurricane, a flood may damage infrastructure and leave an entire county without power or clean water. A firefighter and a rescue crew search for a missing resident while a helicopter delivers emergency supplies to a shelter. The mayor issues an urgent alert and asks every citizen to remain calm until the warning is lifted. A charity gathers donations and helps a homeless family obtain food, clothing, and temporary housing.

An earthquake can cause a building to collapse, crack a road, and disrupt the distribution of essential supplies. An architect must inspect each brick wall, evaluate structural damage, and propose a feasible plan for reconstruction. The local administration can compensate victims and commission an independent institution to oversee the rebuilding process. Meanwhile, volunteers cooperate with residents to restore a damaged school and preserve the area's historical heritage.

A local organisation wants to combat hunger and reduce inequality through a fund for families whose income is below a fixed threshold. The majority of volunteers argue that aid should reach people directly rather than depend entirely on a complicated administrative chain. A refugee, a resident, and a newly unemployed worker may all qualify for assistance if they meet the published criterion. The initiative will not solve poverty overnight, yet it may relieve immediate strain and restore a measure of independence.

A villager invites our group to undertake a volunteering project and help rebuild a small classroom near a remote valley. Before the visit, we register each member, organize the donation, and check whether we can safely transport the equipment. A committed supporter offers a small bonus to the team, while a local teacher agrees to assist with the construction. We hope to implement the plan properly and leave a useful foundation rather than merely take a photo for personal honor.

第1自然段
14—01

After a hurricane, a flood may damage infrastructure and leave an entire county without power or clean water.

飓风之后，洪水可能破坏基础设施，导致整个县停电、缺乏干净用水。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a flood + may damage... and leave...；leave + an entire county + without...为宾语加宾补。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
leave 此处是“使处于某种状态”，不是离开。without power...补充县被留下的状态，中文“导致……”可通过这个结构表达。

14—02

A firefighter and a rescue crew search for a missing resident while a helicopter delivers emergency supplies to a shelter.

消防员和救援队寻找失踪居民，同时直升机把应急物资送往避难所。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + search for...；while 从句 a helicopter + delivers + emergency supplies + to a shelter。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
search for 表寻找，search 后直接跟地点时意义不同。主句主语复数，用 search；从句 helicopter 单数，用 delivers。

14—03

The mayor issues an urgent alert and asks every citizen to remain calm until the warning is lifted.

市长发布紧急警报，并要求每位市民保持冷静，直到警报解除。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The mayor + issues... and asks...；asks + every citizen + to remain calm；until 从句 the warning + is lifted。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
remain 后接 calm 形容词；is lifted 为被动，表示警报被解除。英文在主句之外仍用完整 until 从句说明冷静持续到何时。

14—04

A charity gathers donations and helps a homeless family obtain food, clothing, and temporary housing.

慈善机构募集捐款，帮助无家可归的家庭获得食物、衣物和临时住所。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A charity + gathers... and helps + a homeless family + obtain...；obtain 后三个并列宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
help sb do 中 obtain 可不带 to；中文“帮助获得”要明确被帮助的人，即 family。food/clothing/housing 这里均作不可数概念。

第2自然段
14—05

An earthquake can cause a building to collapse, crack a road, and disrupt the distribution of essential supplies.

地震能使建筑倒塌、使道路开裂，并扰乱必需物资分发。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An earthquake + can cause... crack... and disrupt...；cause + a building + to collapse。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
cause sb/sth to do 表造成某对象做出或发生某事；crack 在这里作及物动词。can 下并列的是 cause、crack、disrupt，而非 collapse。

14—06

An architect must inspect each brick wall, evaluate structural damage, and propose a feasible plan for reconstruction.

建筑师必须检查每面砖墙、评估结构损坏，并提出可行的重建计划。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An architect + must inspect... evaluate... and propose...；for reconstruction 修饰 plan。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
brick 作名词定语修饰 wall，一般用单数，不写 bricks wall。feasible 是形容词“可行的”，不在这里当谓语动词。

14—07

The local administration can compensate victims and commission an independent institution to oversee the rebuilding process.

地方行政部门可以补偿受灾者，并委托独立机构监督重建过程。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The local administration + can compensate... and commission...；commission + an independent institution + to oversee...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
commission 在此为动词“委托”，与名词委员会/佣金不同。compensate 直接接人，不能照中文再加一个 to 介绍受偿人。

14—08

Meanwhile, volunteers cooperate with residents to restore a damaged school and preserve the area's historical heritage.

与此同时，志愿者与居民合作修复受损学校，并保护该地历史遗产。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
volunteers + cooperate with + residents；to restore... and preserve...为目的；Meanwhile 为衔接副词。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
cooperate with sb 表与谁合作；后接 to do 说明合作目的。Meanwhile 不是连词，不能单靠它把本句与上一独立句用逗号串联。

第3自然段
14—09

A local organisation wants to combat hunger and reduce inequality through a fund for families whose income is below a fixed threshold.

当地组织希望通过为收入低于固定门槛的家庭设立基金，对抗饥饿并减少不平等。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A local organisation + wants + to combat... and reduce...；through a fund...方式；whose income is...定从修饰 families。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
organisation 与 organization 为英美拼写变体，原表分列所以都实际使用；whose 表家庭的收入，income 为单数。

14—10

The majority of volunteers argue that aid should reach people directly rather than depend entirely on a complicated administrative chain.

多数志愿者主张，援助应直接到达人们手中，而不完全依赖复杂行政链条。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The majority of volunteers + argue + that 宾从；aid + should reach... rather than depend...；on...为 depend 搭配。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
majority 后 of volunteers，此处强调多人，谓语用 argue；directly 修饰 reach。chain 在此为流程链条，而非物理铁链。

14—11

A refugee, a resident, and a newly unemployed worker may all qualify for assistance if they meet the published criterion.

难民、居民和新近失业者，只要符合公布标准，都可能有资格获得援助。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + may all qualify + for assistance；if 从句 they + meet + the published criterion。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
qualify for 表具备某项资格；newly 修饰 unemployed。all 放情态动词后、实义动词前；published 为 criterion 的定语。

14—12

The initiative will not solve poverty overnight, yet it may relieve immediate strain and restore a measure of independence.

倡议无法一夜解决贫困，但可能缓解眼前压力，并恢复一定独立性。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The initiative + will not solve...；yet 后 it + may relieve... and restore...；a measure of independence 为宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
a measure of 在这里是一种程度，不是政策措施；relieve 直接接 strain，不能把名词 relief 当成动词用。

第4自然段
14—13

A villager invites our group to undertake a volunteering project and help rebuild a small classroom near a remote valley.

村民邀请小组承担志愿服务项目，帮助重建偏远山谷附近的小教室。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A villager + invites + our group + to undertake... and help rebuild...；near...修饰地点。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
undertake 是承担任务，不是简单拿东西；help 后 rebuild 原形。volunteering 为名词性修饰，按原表志愿活动义使用。

14—14

Before the visit, we register each member, organize the donation, and check whether we can safely transport the equipment.

出发前，我们登记每位成员、组织捐赠，并检查能否安全运输设备。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + register... organize... and check...；whether 从句 we + can transport + the equipment；safely 修饰 transport。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
register 与 organize 均为原形，因为主语 we；donation 此处是一项组织起来的捐赠活动。whether 不触发问句倒装。

14—15

A committed supporter offers a small bonus to the team, while a local teacher agrees to assist with the construction.

坚定支持者向团队提供小额额外奖励，当地老师也同意协助施工。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A committed supporter + offers + a small bonus + to the team；while 后 teacher + agrees + to assist...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
committed 修饰 supporter 表投入的；assist with 接协助事项。offer sth to sb 与 offer sb sth 同义但顺序不同。

14—16

We hope to implement the plan properly and leave a useful foundation rather than merely take a photo for personal honor.

我们希望妥善实施计划，留下有用基础，而不只是为个人荣誉拍照。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + hope + to implement... and leave...；rather than take...为对照动作；for personal honor 表目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
implement 为实施，properly 为方式副词。rather than 后与前面的 implement/leave 保持动词原形平行，不需要再起主语。

本篇用到哪些词表词

local, reduce, process, project, measure, resident, power, argue, solve, damage, fund, majority, income, equipment, essential, housing, remote, aid, poverty, warning, chain, foundation, rescue, collapse, directly, entirely, institution, construction, county, fixed, refugee, complicated, organisation, preserve, propose, transport, citizen, entire, hunger, inequality, initiative, mayor, meanwhile, combat, honor, alert, clothing, emergency, helicopter, valley, donation, homeless, immediate, missing, organize, properly, register, charity, assistance, calm, implement, newly, unemployed, urgent, crew, firefighter, flood, heritage, infrastructure, administration, architect, assist, bonus, relieve, shelter, strain, undertake, commission, committed, hurricane, damaged, distribution, evaluate, historical, independence, obtain, supporter, temporary, administrative, brick, compensate, cooperate, crack, earthquake, feasible, merely, qualify, safely, villager, volunteering

ARTICLE 15 / 20

15 · 走进实验室与医院：理解健康语言

约398个英文词 · 20句 · 含93个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖51个词条

In a fictional health lecture, a physician explains how diabetes, cholesterol, and blood pressure appear in a clinical report. The speaker says that a symptom is a sign of a possible problem, whereas a diagnosis requires more than one indicator. Students learn to distinguish a stroke from other conditions and to avoid making a conclusion from one isolated number. The instructor emphasizes that every individual case deserves careful consideration and that uncertainty should be stated honestly.

A bacterium is a single organism, whereas bacteria are a group of organisms that may behave differently under different conditions. A student uses a microscope to observe a cell and asks whether a virus can survive outside a living host. The teacher demonstrates how a chemical may alter tissue and explains why no one should touch an unknown liquid. Before leaving, we follow the procedure precisely, label each sample, and ensure that no substance can contaminate the work surface.

A nursing student follows a pediatrician through the children's ward and watches how the doctor interacts with a frightened child. Before a patient can undergo surgery, the staff must confirm their identity and explain the planned intervention in understandable terms. A patient who feels pain or soreness should be able to describe the location, intensity, and timing of the discomfort. The team records the recovery process and checks whether an infection or another complication could worsen the patient's condition.

In a classroom example, prolonged exposure to strong sunlight becomes a topic for discussing skin protection and melanoma awareness. The lecturer explains that the outer layer of the skin has a protective function and that different people vary in sensitivity. A listener asks whether a scar, a changing spot, or an unusual mark should be examined by a specialist. The speaker avoids giving a remote diagnosis and urges anyone with a concern to seek professional advice.

A health report should not reduce an obese or overweight person to a number, nor imply that body size alone determines character. The article discusses a gene, a hormone, and a vitamin as separate concepts rather than presenting them as interchangeable explanations. A nutrition section compares cereal with other breakfast choices and asks how different habits may affect a person's life expectancy. A later paragraph explains that the lung is not immune to harm and that an unhealthy habit can remain risky even when no symptom is obvious.

第1自然段
15—01

In a fictional health lecture, a physician explains how diabetes, cholesterol, and blood pressure appear in a clinical report.

在一场虚构的健康讲座里，医生解释临床报告怎样呈现糖尿病、胆固醇和血压信息。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a physician + explains + how 宾语从句；从句并列主语 diabetes, cholesterol, and blood pressure + appear。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
how 后保持陈述语序，不能写 how do...appear。这里是学习报告词汇，虚构情节不提供真实个体的诊断。

15—02

The speaker says that a symptom is a sign of a possible problem, whereas a diagnosis requires more than one indicator.

讲者说，症状是潜在问题的迹象，而诊断需要不止一个指标。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The speaker + says + that 宾从；宾从内部由 whereas 连接 a symptom is...与 a diagnosis requires...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
sign、indicator 在此均指迹象或指标；more than one 后仍用单数 indicator。一个 that 从句内部也可以包含并列关系。

15—03

Students learn to distinguish a stroke from other conditions and to avoid making a conclusion from one isolated number.

学生学习区分中风与其他状况，也学习避免仅凭一个孤立数字作结论。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Students + learn + to distinguish... and to avoid...；making...为 avoid 的宾语；from one isolated number 表依据。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
distinguish A from B 为区分；avoid 后不能用 to make。英文可连续嵌套不定式和动名词，但每一层由前面的词决定。

15—04

The instructor emphasizes that every individual case deserves careful consideration and that uncertainty should be stated honestly.

教师强调，每个个案都值得仔细考虑，也应诚实说明不确定性。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The instructor + emphasizes + 两个 that 宾语从句；①every individual case + deserves...；②uncertainty + should be stated...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
第二个 that 保留，可清楚表示两个并列强调内容；should be stated 是情态被动，不是主语在主动陈述别的对象。

第2自然段
15—05

A bacterium is a single organism, whereas bacteria are a group of organisms that may behave differently under different conditions.

一个细菌是单个生物，而 bacteria 指多个细菌，它们在不同条件下可能表现不同。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A bacterium + is...；whereas 后 bacteria + are...；that may behave...修饰 organisms。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
bacterium 单数对应 is，bacteria 复数对应 are。中文“细菌”通常不靠词尾标复数，英文这里必须通过词形与谓语配合。

15—06

A student uses a microscope to observe a cell and asks whether a virus can survive outside a living host.

学生用显微镜观察细胞，并询问病毒能否在活体宿主外存活。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A student + uses... and asks...；to observe 表目的；whether 宾从 a virus + can survive；outside...表位置。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
问句嵌入 asks 后用陈述顺序 a virus can，不写 can a virus。host 在这里是宿主，不是主持人。

15—07

The teacher demonstrates how a chemical may alter tissue and explains why no one should touch an unknown liquid.

老师展示化学物质可能怎样改变组织，并解释为什么不应触碰未知液体。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The teacher + demonstrates + how 从句；and explains + why 从句；how 从句 chemical + may alter...；why 从句 no one + should touch...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
demonstrate 和 explain 各接一个疑问词从句；都保持陈述语序。chemical 此处为可数名词一种化学物质，liquid 也指一份未知液体。

15—08

Before leaving, we follow the procedure precisely, label each sample, and ensure that no substance can contaminate the work surface.

离开前，我们严格按程序操作、给每份样本贴标签，并确保没有物质污染工作台面。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + follow... label... and ensure...；that 宾从 no substance + can contaminate + the work surface。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
label 在这里是动词；precisely 修饰 follow。no substance 已带否定意义，不再额外加 cannot 造成与原意冲突的双重否定。

第3自然段
15—09

A nursing student follows a pediatrician through the children's ward and watches how the doctor interacts with a frightened child.

护理学生跟随儿科医生巡视儿童病房，观察医生怎样与害怕的孩子互动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A nursing student + follows... and watches...；how 宾从 the doctor + interacts + with a frightened child。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
nursing 作定语限定学生专业；interact with 表互动。interacts 是 interact 的第三人称单数形式，因为从句主语 the doctor 为单数。

15—10

Before a patient can undergo surgery, the staff must confirm their identity and explain the planned intervention in understandable terms.

病人接受手术之前，工作人员必须确认其身份，并用易懂的话解释计划中的干预措施。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Before 从句 a patient + can undergo + surgery；主句 the staff + must confirm... and explain...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
undergo 本身含经历/接受，不写 undergo through。their 回指 patient；in understandable terms 表表达方式，不是地点。

15—11

A patient who feels pain or soreness should be able to describe the location, intensity, and timing of the discomfort.

感到疼痛或酸痛的病人，应能描述不适的位置、强度和出现时间。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A patient + should be able to describe...；who feels pain or soreness 定语从句修饰 patient；宾语为三个并列名词。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
who 是从句主语，指单数 patient，故 feels 加 s。“疼的病人”在英文拆到 patient 后面，使主句主干保持清楚。

15—12

The team records the recovery process and checks whether an infection or another complication could worsen the patient's condition.

团队记录康复过程，并检查感染或其他并发症是否可能使病情恶化。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The team + records... and checks...；whether 宾从 an infection or another complication + could worsen + the patient's condition。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
worsen 可作及物动词，使病情变差，不必再加 make。whether 引出需要核查的可能性，不是断言感染已经存在。

第4自然段
15—13

In a classroom example, prolonged exposure to strong sunlight becomes a topic for discussing skin protection and melanoma awareness.

在课堂例子中，长时间接触强烈日光成为讨论皮肤防护和黑色素瘤认知的话题。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
prolonged exposure to strong sunlight + becomes + a topic；for discussing...修饰 topic。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
exposure 是主语中心词，to sunlight 补充接触对象。for 后动作用 discussing；本句作为语言情境，不承担个人医疗建议。

15—14

The lecturer explains that the outer layer of the skin has a protective function and that different people vary in sensitivity.

讲师解释，皮肤外层有保护作用，不同人的敏感程度也有差异。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The lecturer + explains + 两个 that 宾从；①the outer layer + has...；②different people + vary + in sensitivity。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“有差异”可直接选 vary 作谓语，不能写 are vary。第一个从句主语为 layer 而非 skin，故 has 用单数。

15—15

A listener asks whether a scar, a changing spot, or an unusual mark should be examined by a specialist.

听众询问，疤痕、变化中的斑点或不寻常印记是否应该由专科医生检查。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A listener + asks + whether 宾从；并列选择主语 + should be examined；by a specialist 表动作执行者。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
should be examined 为被动，因为印记接受检查。中文“要不要检查”常省动作方向，英文明确谁被检查、谁执行。

15—16

The speaker avoids giving a remote diagnosis and urges anyone with a concern to seek professional advice.

讲者避免远程诊断，并敦促任何有疑虑的人寻求专业意见。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The speaker + avoids + giving...；and urges + anyone with a concern + to seek...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
avoid 后用 giving；urge 后用宾语加 to seek。with a concern 后置修饰 anyone，表示有担忧的人，不能把 with 误当独立谓语。

第5自然段
15—17

A health report should not reduce an obese or overweight person to a number, nor imply that body size alone determines character.

健康报道不应把肥胖或超重者简化成数字，也不应暗示体型单独决定品格。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A health report + should not reduce + a person + to a number；nor imply + that 宾从；body size alone + determines...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
obese 与 overweight 为形容词；nor 在这里连接同一主语的并列动词，不另起倒装。alone 修饰决定因素，不能译为人很孤单。

15—18

The article discusses a gene, a hormone, and a vitamin as separate concepts rather than presenting them as interchangeable explanations.

文章把基因、激素和维生素作为不同概念讨论，而不把它们当可互换解释。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The article + discusses + 三个宾语 + as separate concepts；rather than presenting + them + as...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
gene、hormone、vitamin 均为可数名词，此处每项有 a；as 标明作为哪类概念。them 回指三者，不再重复具体名词。

15—19

A nutrition section compares cereal with other breakfast choices and asks how different habits may affect a person's life expectancy.

营养章节比较谷物早餐与其他选择，并问不同习惯可能怎样影响人的预期寿命。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A nutrition section + compares... and asks...；compare A with B；how 宾从 habits + may affect + expectancy。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
expectancy 是预期的名词；life expectancy 为预期寿命，本句未给出寿命数值。cereal 可作谷物早餐总称，不必加 a。

15—20

A later paragraph explains that the lung is not immune to harm and that an unhealthy habit can remain risky even when no symptom is obvious.

后文解释，肺并非不受损害，不健康习惯即使尚无明显症状也可能仍有风险。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
paragraph + explains + 两个 that 宾从；lung + is not immune...；habit + can remain risky；even when 从句 no symptom + is + obvious。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
immune to 在这里按免受影响义；remain 后 risky 为形容词。no symptom 已否定“存在明显症状”，不再给 is 加 not。

本篇用到哪些词表词

reduce, affect, process, case, concern, individual, sign, later, professional, pressure, seek, ensure, function, harm, staff, spot, protection, vary, remote, unusual, gene, nursing, diabetes, pain, skin, symptom, bacterium, survive, awareness, cell, character, confirm, location, behave, nutrition, observe, identity, imply, physician, differently, host, immune, listener, intervention, obvious, distinguish, consideration, indicator, label, lecture, sample, sunlight, unknown, chemical, infection, whereas, exposure, instructor, obese, procedure, worsen, alter, cholesterol, layer, making, surgery, vitamin, cereal, clinical, lung, melanoma, outer, overweight, pediatrician, scar, tissue, undergo, unhealthy, expectancy, hormone, recovery, specialist, timing, virus, bacteria, contaminate, honestly, liquid, precisely, risky, soreness, stroke, substance

ARTICLE 16 / 20

16 · 艺术、历史与故事中的人生

约321个英文词 · 16句 · 含101个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖65个词条

Our neighborhood studio hosts an annual celebration that combines folk dancing, opera, and an entertaining concert. A passionate dancer and a creative maker decorate the stage while a musician adjusts the volume of a wireless speaker. The audience can appreciate artistic expression without knowing every cultural reference or the origin of each tradition. After the performance, we gather in a cafe and discuss the scene that left the deepest impression on us.

A museum exhibit presents a historical civilization through a collection of cloth, a wooden tool, and a carved pearl ornament. A curator explains how people used manual labor to manufacture fabric and construct a grand castle on the upper slope of a hill. The display asks visitors to distinguish an authentic artifact from a modern copy and consider the ethical question of ownership. Such exploration can deepen our appreciation of humanity without pretending that the past was entirely harmonious or free from violence.

A young producer hopes to transform a dull passage beside a mall into a lively gallery of graffiti and local drawing. The creation of a shared art space can enhance the surrounding beauty and give youth a medium for personal expression. A critic may question the style, but the artist can embrace discussion without treating every criticism as a personal attack. The project does not promise a cultural revolution, yet it may spark a small shift in how residents view their neighborhood.

A philosopher and a literature professor host a discussion about whether a novel can change a reader's philosophy of life. One speaker believes that the depth of a character matters more than fame, while another values a surprising plot and a vivid setting. A powerful narrative can expose a social norm, challenge a traditional belief, and prompt readers to reconsider a familiar saying. Reading is not a substitute for living, but it can extend imagination and offer an insight that ordinary conversation rarely provides.

第1自然段
16—01

Our neighborhood studio hosts an annual celebration that combines folk dancing, opera, and an entertaining concert.

我们街区的工作室举办年度庆祝活动，把民间舞蹈、歌剧和一场有趣的音乐会结合起来。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Our neighborhood studio + hosts + an annual celebration；that combines...为定语从句，that 指 celebration。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“把……结合起来的活动”修饰语在前；英文先写 celebration，再用 that 说明内容。单数 celebration 使从句动词为 combines。

16—02

A passionate dancer and a creative maker decorate the stage while a musician adjusts the volume of a wireless speaker.

热情的舞者和富有创意的制作人员装饰舞台，同时一位音乐人调节无线音箱的音量。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句并列主语 A passionate dancer and a creative maker + decorate...；while 从句 a musician + adjusts...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
while 表同时发生；两个人为复数用 decorate，一个 musician 用 adjusts。不能因为整句前面出现复数，就把从句也按复数变化。

16—03

The audience can appreciate artistic expression without knowing every cultural reference or the origin of each tradition.

观众即使不了解每项文化指涉或每种传统的起源，也能欣赏艺术表达。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The audience + can appreciate + artistic expression；without knowing...表条件性的伴随情况；knowing 后接并列宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“即使不了解”这里用 without + 动名词压缩，主体仍是观众。expression 此处为艺术表达的抽象概念，不必加 a。

16—04

After the performance, we gather in a cafe and discuss the scene that left the deepest impression on us.

演出结束后，我们聚在咖啡馆，讨论给我们留下最深印象的场景。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
We + gather... and discuss + the scene；that left...定语从句修饰 scene；left + the deepest impression + on us。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先选过去动作 left 写在从句中，说明那一场景曾造成的印象；主句可用叙事现在时。leave an impression on 为搭配，不能照中文“留下在我们”。

第2自然段
16—05

A museum exhibit presents a historical civilization through a collection of cloth, a wooden tool, and a carved pearl ornament.

博物馆展览通过布料、木制工具和雕刻珍珠饰品的收藏来呈现一个历史文明。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A museum exhibit + presents + a historical civilization；through...表方式；后列展品。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
exhibit 是展览名词，present 是谓语；historical 表历史的。中文“通过展品呈现”英文把方式放主干后，避免主语过长。

16—06

A curator explains how people used manual labor to manufacture fabric and construct a grand castle on the upper slope of a hill.

策展人解释，人们如何以手工劳动制造布料，并在山丘的较高山坡上修建宏伟城堡。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A curator + explains + how 宾从；people + used + manual labor；to manufacture... and construct...表目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
used 是 use 的过去式，本句不是 used to do“过去常常”；结构是 use A to do。manual 修饰 labor 表手工劳动。

16—07

The display asks visitors to distinguish an authentic artifact from a modern copy and consider the ethical question of ownership.

展陈请参观者区分真文物和现代复制品，并思考所有权的伦理问题。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The display + asks + visitors + to distinguish... and consider...；distinguish A from B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“真的”在此用 authentic，强调真品身份；from 介绍对比对象。ownership 的伦理问题用 of 后置说明，而非把整段中文词序前置。

16—08

Such exploration can deepen our appreciation of humanity without pretending that the past was entirely harmonious or free from violence.

这样的探索可以加深对人类的理解，而不假装过去完全和谐、毫无暴力。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Such exploration + can deepen...；without pretending...；that 宾从 the past + was + entirely harmonious or free from violence。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
without + pretending，再接 that 从句；free from 表不受……影响。否定范围在 pretending 上，不表示主句否定人类探索价值。

第3自然段
16—09

A young producer hopes to transform a dull passage beside a mall into a lively gallery of graffiti and local drawing.

年轻制作人希望把商场旁沉闷的通道变成充满活力的涂鸦与本地绘画展廊。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A young producer + hopes + to transform + a dull passage + into a lively gallery...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
transform A into B 为转变；drawing 在这里是绘画作品/绘画活动名词。beside a mall 修饰 passage，先确定被改造对象再写结果。

16—10

The creation of a shared art space can enhance the surrounding beauty and give youth a medium for personal expression.

共同艺术空间的创造能改善周围美感，并给青年提供个人表达媒介。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The creation of a shared art space + can enhance... and give + youth + a medium...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
creation 是主语中心词；youth 此处为青年群体。medium 为媒介名词，不是尺寸中号；give 后双宾语把接受者和获得物区分。

16—11

A critic may question the style, but the artist can embrace discussion without treating every criticism as a personal attack.

评论者可能质疑风格，但艺术家能接纳讨论，而不把每项批评当成人身攻击。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A critic + may question...；but 后 artist + can embrace...；without treating + every criticism + as a personal attack。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
critic 为评论者，criticism 为批评；attack 是名词攻击。treat A as B 用于看作，中文“当成”要选明确结构。

16—12

The project does not promise a cultural revolution, yet it may spark a small shift in how residents view their neighborhood.

项目不承诺文化革命，却可能稍稍改变居民看待街区的方式。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The project + does not promise...；yet 后 it + may spark + a small shift；in how residents view...说明转变方面。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
view 在 how 从句里为动词看待；shift 为名词变化。in 后可接 how 从句作介词宾语，不能把 how 误当修饰 shift 的单个副词。

第4自然段
16—13

A philosopher and a literature professor host a discussion about whether a novel can change a reader's philosophy of life.

哲学家与文学教授主持讨论，探讨小说能否改变读者的人生观。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 + host + a discussion；about whether...为讨论内容；a novel + can change + a reader's philosophy of life。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
novel 在这里是小说名词，与前文 novel solution 的形容词不同；philosophy of life 表人生观。whether 可放在介词 about 后。

16—14

One speaker believes that the depth of a character matters more than fame, while another values a surprising plot and a vivid setting.

一位讲者认为人物深度比名气重要，另一位则看重意外情节和生动背景。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
One speaker + believes + that 宾从；character's depth 对应 matters...；while 后 another + values...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
character 此处为文学人物，不是品格；setting 是故事背景。another 可独立指另一讲者，不必重复 speaker。

16—15

A powerful narrative can expose a social norm, challenge a traditional belief, and prompt readers to reconsider a familiar saying.

有力量的叙事能揭示社会规范、质疑传统信念，并促使读者重新思考熟悉说法。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A powerful narrative + can expose... challenge... and prompt + readers + to reconsider...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
prompt sb to do 表促使，与名词“提示”不同；saying 在此为说法或谚语名词，不是说话动作的进行时。

16—16

Reading is not a substitute for living, but it can extend imagination and offer an insight that ordinary conversation rarely provides.

阅读不能替代生活，但能扩展想象，并提供日常对话很少带来的洞见。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Reading + is not + a substitute...；but 后 it + can extend... and offer...；that...定从修饰 insight，that 作 provides 的宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
living 为名词性活动，与 reading 平行；that 后不能再重复 provides it。rarely 放实义动词前修饰提供频率。

本篇用到哪些词表词

local, professor, project, view, challenge, traditional, performance, attack, creative, medium, shift, belief, display, enhance, labor, reading, style, tradition, cultural, powerful, stage, familiar, audience, character, grand, reader, beauty, criticism, entirely, gather, maker, collection, ordinary, expose, extend, annual, dancing, novel, critic, dancer, opera, setting, studio, transform, host, producer, distinguish, scene, wireless, wooden, graffiti, neighborhood, norm, pearl, rarely, drawing, expression, imagination, celebration, creation, depth, ethical, impression, insight, prompt, youth, artistic, decorate, embrace, exploration, folk, fame, philosopher, saying, spark, surprising, upper, cafe, civilization, dull, entertaining, exhibit, historical, literature, mall, narrative, passionate, philosophy, revolution, violence, authentic, castle, cloth, fabric, humanity, manual, manufacture, origin, substitute, surrounding, volume

ARTICLE 17 / 20

17 · 屏幕、广告与新闻：怎样判断信息

约523个英文词 · 26句 · 含147个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖76个词条

A teen may open a gaming app to escape boredom, yet repeated viewing can occupy far more leisure time than expected. A platform may use an automatic recommendation system to hold attention and encourage a user to consume endless entertainment. I cannot conclude that every habit is an addiction, but I can observe whether constant checking interferes with my concentration. To regain control, I silence the alarm, set a fixed limit, and leave the device elsewhere during a focused study period.

A tobacco campaign highlights how a cigarette advertisement can create an attractive image while overlooking the reality of smoking. A smoker in the story admits that nicotine dependence can make it difficult to quit, even when the desire for change is strong. The narrator does not portray a smoker as morally evil; instead, the narrative emphasizes support and access to suitable care. The final message asks readers to reject a misleading myth and avoid judging a person's character from a single behavior.

A media outlet may publish a bold headline to attract attention, but the apparent certainty may exceed the available evidence. Before I share a story on the web, I check the source and compare it with a report written by another journalist. An educated reader should distinguish a fact from an opinion and ask whether a quotation has been taken out of context. A responsible editor can correct an error publicly, reveal a conflict of interest, and give proper credit to the original author.

An advertising agency may portray a product as a symbol of status rather than simply a useful object. A commercial can link a fancy car with romance, popularity, and success without proving that the association is valid. A marketing consultant studies consumer perception and uses persuasion to appeal to a particular audience. When we realize this mechanism, we can make a purchase according to our actual needs instead of social expectation.

A headline may promise tremendous progress, yet the change may be largely cosmetic and mostly confined to a small sample. In contrast, a modest result can truly matter if it solves a problem that people frequently encounter in daily life. A cautious writer says that a finding could possibly help, not that it will surely work for absolutely everyone. Ultimately, taking a claim seriously means examining its basis, not accepting every impressive phrase as totally reliable.

Regarding the new policy, a spokesperson should explain specifically who will benefit and whether the plan is essentially different from the old one. The proposal may resemble an earlier version, but the distinction matters; furthermore, a similar name does not imply an identical function. Traditionally, a public notice used formal language, but a clear explanation may convince more readers than an incredibly complex statement. A message is unlikely to help if it tells people only what to do without explaining why the action is useful. A clear explanation can remove the mystery from a technical rule; indeed, a practical example plus a short reason often helps more than jargon. The goal is obviously better understanding; therefore, the writer should revise any sentence that confuses rather than informs the reader.

第1自然段
17—01

A teen may open a gaming app to escape boredom, yet repeated viewing can occupy far more leisure time than expected.

青少年可能打开游戏应用摆脱无聊，但反复观看会占用远超预期的休闲时间。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A teen + may open...；to escape 表目的；yet 后 repeated viewing + can occupy + far more leisure time；than expected 为省略比较。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
viewing 作为名词性主语，不是句中进行时。far 修饰比较级 more，加强程度；“比预期”可压缩成 than expected。

17—02

A platform may use an automatic recommendation system to hold attention and encourage a user to consume endless entertainment.

平台可能利用自动推荐系统留住注意力，并鼓励用户持续消费无穷的娱乐内容。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A platform + may use + a system；to hold... and encourage...为目的；encourage + a user + to consume...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两个目的动作共用 to；encourage 后又带一个 to consume，属于下一层。中文动词可直接连说，英文需靠不定式标清层级。

17—03

I cannot conclude that every habit is an addiction, but I can observe whether constant checking interferes with my concentration.

我不能断定每种习惯都是成瘾，但可以观察不断查看是否妨碍专注。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + cannot conclude + that 宾从；but 后 I + can observe + whether 宾从；后一个从句主语 constant checking，谓语 interferes with。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
that 引陈述内容，whether 引是否；checking 作主语是单数概念，所以 interferes 加 s。不能把所有 ing 都看作正在进行。

17—04

To regain control, I silence the alarm, set a fixed limit, and leave the device elsewhere during a focused study period.

为了重新掌控使用习惯，我关闭提醒、设定固定限额，并在专注学习时把设备放到别处。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
To regain control 为目的；I + silence... set... and leave...；elsewhere 为地点副词；during...表时段。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
elsewhere 本身表示在别处，不加 in。silence 可作动词使静音，不需照中文写成 close alarm；fixed 是 limit 的定语。

第2自然段
17—05

A tobacco campaign highlights how a cigarette advertisement can create an attractive image while overlooking the reality of smoking.

烟草主题宣传活动突出说明，香烟广告如何营造吸引人形象，却忽略吸烟的现实。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A tobacco campaign + highlights + how 宾从；从句 a cigarette advertisement + can create...；while overlooking...的主体仍是 advertisement。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
while overlooking 是同主语省略，说明广告在塑造形象时忽略现实。how 在这里引出广告如何运作，不是直接向读者发问。

17—06

A smoker in the story admits that nicotine dependence can make it difficult to quit, even when the desire for change is strong.

故事中的吸烟者承认，尼古丁依赖会让戒烟变难，即使改变愿望很强烈。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A smoker + admits + that 宾从；dependence + can make + it + difficult + to quit；even when 从句 desire + is + strong。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
it 是形式宾语，真正困难的内容是 to quit；不能把 it 当烟草。中文“让戒烟困难”英文常用 make it difficult to do 展开长动作。

17—07

The narrator does not portray a smoker as morally evil; instead, the narrative emphasizes support and access to suitable care.

叙述者不把吸烟者描绘成道德上邪恶的人；相反，故事强调支持和获得合适照护的机会。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
前分句 narrator + does not portray + a smoker + as morally evil；后分句 narrative + emphasizes + support and access...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
分号可连接相关独立句，instead 为副词衔接。as 引出被描述成的性质；morally 修饰 evil，不应使用名词 moral 直接替代。

17—08

The final message asks readers to reject a misleading myth and avoid judging a person's character from a single behavior.

最后的信息请读者拒绝误导性说法，不凭单一行为判断一个人的品格。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The final message + asks + readers + to reject... and avoid...；judging...为 avoid 的宾语；from...为判断依据。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
reject 与 avoid 共用 to，avoid 再带 judging。character 这里为品格，behavior 为行为；同一句各有不同名词意义。

第3自然段
17—09

A media outlet may publish a bold headline to attract attention, but the apparent certainty may exceed the available evidence.

媒体可能发表醒目标题吸引注意，但表面上的确定性可能超出已有证据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A media outlet + may publish...；to attract 表目的；but 后 the apparent certainty + may exceed + the available evidence。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
outlet 此处指媒体机构；apparent 修饰 certainty 表表面的。两个 may 说明可能性，不把叙事情境写成所有媒体都如此。

17—10

Before I share a story on the web, I check the source and compare it with a report written by another journalist.

在网上分享故事前，我先核实来源，并与另一记者撰写的报道比较。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Before 从句 I + share...；主句 I + check... and compare...；written by another journalist 后置修饰 report。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
written 为过去分词，被动修饰报道；by 标作者。compare A with B 比较两份内容，it 回指前文故事，避免对象不明。

17—11

An educated reader should distinguish a fact from an opinion and ask whether a quotation has been taken out of context.

有阅读素养的读者应区分事实与观点，并询问引文是否被断章取义。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An educated reader + should distinguish... and ask...；whether 宾从 a quotation + has been taken + out of context。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
has been taken 为现在完成时被动，强调引用已受到的处理。educated 为形容词受过教育的，不是主句的过去时谓语。

17—12

A responsible editor can correct an error publicly, reveal a conflict of interest, and give proper credit to the original author.

负责的编辑能公开纠错、披露利益冲突，并给原作者应有署名认可。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A responsible editor + can correct... reveal... and give...；give + proper credit + to the original author。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
credit 这里为认可/功劳，不是信用额度；give sth to sb 与 give sb sth 为两种排列。中文“给作者署名”英文需选与认可相符的名词。

第4自然段
17—13

An advertising agency may portray a product as a symbol of status rather than simply a useful object.

广告机构可能把产品描绘成地位象征，而不只是有用物品。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An advertising agency + may portray + a product + as a symbol...；rather than...连接对照的名词性内容。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
portray A as B 表把 A 描绘为 B；status 是地位名词。simply 修饰被省略的“只是作为”含义，不能拿 simple 替代副词。

17—14

A commercial can link a fancy car with romance, popularity, and success without proving that the association is valid.

商业广告可以把豪华汽车与浪漫、人气和成功联系起来，而不证明这种关联成立。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A commercial + can link + a fancy car + with...；without proving...；that the association is valid 为宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
commercial 在这里是名词广告；link A with B 表关联。that 从句需要 is 连接 association 和 valid，中文“关联成立”不直接对应两个名词。

17—15

A marketing consultant studies consumer perception and uses persuasion to appeal to a particular audience.

营销顾问研究消费者认知，并用说服手段吸引特定受众。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A marketing consultant + studies... and uses...；to appeal to a particular audience 表目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
appeal to 表吸引某人，to 为介词；uses 后的 to appeal 是不定式标记。两种 to 在同一个短语中作用不同。

17—16

When we realize this mechanism, we can make a purchase according to our actual needs instead of social expectation.

认识到这一机制后，我们可以按实际需要购物，而不是依照社会期待。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 we + realize + this mechanism；主句 we + can make + a purchase；according to...与 instead of...说明依据。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
realize 表意识到，不是实现梦想；according to 固定搭配不省 to。expectation 这里是抽象的社会期待，不一定需要复数。

第5自然段
17—17

A headline may promise tremendous progress, yet the change may be largely cosmetic and mostly confined to a small sample.

标题可能承诺巨大进展，变化却可能大半停留在表面，而且主要局限在小样本中。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
headline + may promise...；yet 后 change + may be + largely cosmetic and mostly confined...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tremendous 修饰 progress；largely、mostly 分别修饰两个表语。confined 为受限制状态，不表示变化主动限制其他对象。

17—18

In contrast, a modest result can truly matter if it solves a problem that people frequently encounter in daily life.

相比之下，小成果若解决了人们日常经常遇到的问题，也确有意义。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a modest result + can matter；if 从句 it + solves + a problem；that people frequently encounter 定从修饰 problem。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
in contrast 为篇章衔接；matter 在这里为动词重要，不写 can be matter。that 代 problem 作 encounter 的宾语。

17—19

A cautious writer says that a finding could possibly help, not that it will surely work for absolutely everyone.

谨慎作者会说，研究发现可能有帮助，而不会说它必然对每个人都有效。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
writer + says + 两个对照的 that 宾从；finding + could help；it + will work + for everyone；possibly/surely 修饰确定程度。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
not that...对比否定的是作者所说内容；absolutely 修饰 everyone 强调无一例外。could possibly 较谨慎，避免把可能性写成保证。

17—20

Ultimately, taking a claim seriously means examining its basis, not accepting every impressive phrase as totally reliable.

最终，认真对待声明意味着审查其依据，而不是把每句亮眼措辞都当成完全可靠。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
taking a claim seriously（主语）+ means + examining its basis；not accepting...为对比；accept A as B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
动名词短语作主语，用 means；seriously 修饰 taking，totally 修饰 reliable。中文“认真”与“完全”都像副词，英文仍需标清各自修饰对象。

第6自然段
17—21

Regarding the new policy, a spokesperson should explain specifically who will benefit and whether the plan is essentially different from the old one.

关于新政策，发言人应具体解释谁会受益，以及计划是否与旧方案本质不同。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Regarding...为话题；spokesperson + should explain + 两个宾从；who will benefit；whether plan is different...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
regarding 为介词关于；who 在第一个从句作主语，无需倒装。essentially 修饰 different，specifically 修饰 explain，不能互换修饰对象。

17—22

The proposal may resemble an earlier version, but the distinction matters; furthermore, a similar name does not imply an identical function.

提案可能像早期版本，但差别很重要；此外，名称相似不意味着功能相同。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
proposal + may resemble + an earlier version；but 后 distinction + matters；分号后 name + does not imply...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
resemble 是及物动词，不加 with/to；furthermore 为此外的连接副词。similar 修饰 name，不是另一句的谓语。

17—23

Traditionally, a public notice used formal language, but a clear explanation may convince more readers than an incredibly complex statement.

传统上，公告使用正式语言，但清楚解释可能比极复杂陈述更能说服读者。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a public notice + used + formal language；but 后 explanation + may convince + more readers；than...比较。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
traditionally 为副词传统上；used 是过去时，不是 used to。incredibly 修饰 complex，形容词形式 incredible 应修饰名词或作表语。

17—24

A message is unlikely to help if it tells people only what to do without explaining why the action is useful.

只告诉人们做什么而不解释行动为何有用的信息，不太可能有帮助。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A message + is + unlikely + to help；if 从句 it + tells + people + what to do；without explaining + why 宾从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
be unlikely to do 为不太可能；what to do 是疑问词加不定式作告诉的内容。why the action is useful 用陈述顺序，不写 why is the action useful。

17—25

A clear explanation can remove the mystery from a technical rule; indeed, a practical example plus a short reason often helps more than jargon.

清楚解释能消除技术规则的神秘感；确实，实际例子加简短理由往往比术语更有帮助。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
explanation + can remove + mystery + from a technical rule；分号后 a practical example plus a short reason + helps...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
plus 在此为介词加上，中心主语仍为单数 example，故 helps 加 s；indeed 为强调副词。mystery 为难以理解的事或神秘感。

17—26

The goal is obviously better understanding; therefore, the writer should revise any sentence that confuses rather than informs the reader.

目标显然是更好理解；因此，作者应修改任何使读者困惑而非知情的句子。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
goal + is + better understanding；therefore 后 writer + should revise + any sentence；that confuses rather than informs...定从。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
obviously 修饰判断；therefore 为结果连接副词，前用分号。定从中 that 指单数 sentence，confuses/informs 都加 s。

本篇用到哪些词表词

author, benefit, system, better, product, support, finding, behavior, simply, according, consumer, access, policy, device, claim, consume, desire, evidence, image, link, publish, realize, source, available, function, remove, limit, media, reveal, teen, attract, purchase, status, conflict, reality, boredom, particular, user, conclude, credit, mostly, expectation, appeal, means, recommendation, agency, campaign, opinion, association, understanding, app, audience, complex, quit, indeed, responsible, largely, platform, character, commercial, reader, ultimately, contrast, basis, fixed, formal, frequently, observe, gaming, perception, seriously, truly, actual, error, evil, imply, popularity, tobacco, context, elsewhere, marketing, therefore, written, attractive, distinguish, fancy, focused, myth, nicotine, possibly, regarding, statement, encounter, obviously, persuasion, sample, specifically, escape, mystery, plus, proposal, surely, totally, web, absolutely, automatic, constant, modest, reliable, smoking, spokesperson, alarm, consultant, explanation, concentration, convince, earlier, endless, entertainment, essentially, furthermore, incredibly, leisure, mechanism, outlet, practical, reject, version, addiction, advertising, apparent, cannot, cigarette, distinction, educated, narrative, occupy, original, resemble, traditionally, unlikely, bold, phrase, smoker, symbol, tremendous, viewing

ARTICLE 18 / 20

18 · 从小店经营到跨境合作

约241个英文词 · 12句 · 含79个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖39个词条

An entrepreneur plans to open a small retail outlet and sell an affordable bundle of locally made goods. Before the opening, she must calculate the net profit, secure a loan, and reserve enough stock for the coming season. Her business proposal explains how a modest investment could generate enough revenue to repay the debt and cover operating costs. A customer may complain about poor delivery, so she creates a clear complaint procedure and offers a timely response.

A bilateral accord allows two countries to reduce a trade barrier and cooperate on an urgent regional issue. The agreement can benefit a manufacturer that wants to import a component, export a finished product, and expand overseas. A negotiator must consider the tax burden, the distribution of gains, and the effect on a domestic competitor. If a dispute arises, the minister can propose a rational compromise instead of letting political pressure ruin the partnership.

A new fashion shop is currently running a sale, mainly to clear old stock and attract the next generation of buyers. The manager says that the shop is doing relatively well, although the quality of service is slightly below its usual peak. Customers typically compare prices in the aisle, tap a screen for details, and choose an acceptable price rather than the lowest one. Tipping is unusual in this fictional shop, and a sign explains that staff are paid fairly, so customers need not feel obliged to leave extra cash.

第1自然段
18—01

An entrepreneur plans to open a small retail outlet and sell an affordable bundle of locally made goods.

创业者打算开一家小型零售店，出售价格实惠的本地商品组合包。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An entrepreneur + plans + to open... and sell...；locally made 后置于逻辑上修饰 goods，整体置于 goods 前。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
retail 作名词定语限定 outlet；bundle of goods 表一组商品。plans to 下两个动作都用原形，不另写 sells。

18—02

Before the opening, she must calculate the net profit, secure a loan, and reserve enough stock for the coming season.

开业前，她必须计算净利润、获得贷款，并为即将到来的季节备足库存。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
she + must calculate... secure... and reserve...；for the coming season 表准备对象。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
secure 在这里是动词获得，不是形容词安全的；net 修饰 profit 表净得的。coming 为修饰 season 的分词，不是句中进行时。

18—03

Her business proposal explains how a modest investment could generate enough revenue to repay the debt and cover operating costs.

她的商业方案说明，小额投资如何能产生足够收入来偿还债务并支付经营成本。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Her business proposal + explains + how 宾从；a modest investment + could generate + enough revenue；to repay... and cover...说明用途。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
enough 放名词 revenue 前；could 表可能性。how 从句保留 investment could generate，不倒装。

18—04

A customer may complain about poor delivery, so she creates a clear complaint procedure and offers a timely response.

顾客可能抱怨配送不佳，因此她建立明确的投诉程序并及时回应。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A customer + may complain + about poor delivery；so 后 she + creates... and offers...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
complain 为动词，complaint 为名词；about 介绍抱怨内容。so 是连词连接结果，后半句两个动词跟 she 都加 s。

第2自然段
18—05

A bilateral accord allows two countries to reduce a trade barrier and cooperate on an urgent regional issue.

双边协议允许两国减少贸易壁垒，并在紧迫的地区问题上合作。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A bilateral accord + allows + two countries + to reduce... and cooperate...；on...说明合作议题。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
accord 在此是协议名词；allow 后是对象加 to do。cooperate on 指合作事项，与 cooperate with 指合作方不同。

18—06

The agreement can benefit a manufacturer that wants to import a component, export a finished product, and expand overseas.

协议能使制造商受益，这家制造商希望进口零部件、出口成品并向海外扩展。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The agreement + can benefit + a manufacturer；that wants...定从修饰 manufacturer；to import... export... and expand...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
benefit 在这里为及物动词“使受益”，不额外加 from；overseas 作副词，前不加 to。component 指组成部件，词义由生产场景确定。

18—07

A negotiator must consider the tax burden, the distribution of gains, and the effect on a domestic competitor.

谈判人员必须考虑税负、收益分配及对国内竞争者的影响。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A negotiator + must consider + 三个并列宾语；on a domestic competitor 修饰 effect。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
effect 在此是名词影响；on 引出受影响对象。gains 为所得收益复数；gain 作动词时可直接表示获得；这里用复数名词 gains 表各项收益。

18—08

If a dispute arises, the minister can propose a rational compromise instead of letting political pressure ruin the partnership.

如果争端出现，部长可以提出理性妥协，而非任由政治压力毁掉伙伴关系。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 a dispute + arises；主句 minister + can propose...；instead of letting + political pressure + ruin...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
let sb/sth do 后动词 ruin 不带 to；letting 因介词 of 用 ing。rational 描述有理性依据的妥协，不等于任何妥协必然正确。

第3自然段
18—09

A new fashion shop is currently running a sale, mainly to clear old stock and attract the next generation of buyers.

新时装店正在促销，主要为了清理旧库存并吸引新一代买家。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A new fashion shop + is running + a sale；mainly to clear... and attract...表目的。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
run a sale 是开展促销；running 与 is 组成进行时。fashion 为时尚/时装名词，不是“时髦的”形容词 fashionable。

18—10

The manager says that the shop is doing relatively well, although the quality of service is slightly below its usual peak.

经理说，店里经营相对不错，不过服务质量略低于平常最佳水平。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
manager + says + that 宾从；shop + is doing...；although 从句 quality + is + slightly below...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
relatively 修饰 well，slightly 修饰 below 所示差距；peak 为顶峰名词。中文“经营不错”这里采用 do well 搭配，不逐字翻 business good。

18—11

Customers typically compare prices in the aisle, tap a screen for details, and choose an acceptable price rather than the lowest one.

顾客通常在过道比价、点屏幕看详情，并选可接受价格而非最低价。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Customers + compare... tap... and choose...；typically 为频率；for details 表获取目的；one 代 price。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
aisle 为过道，tap 为轻点；acceptable 为形容词修饰 price。one 避免重复可数名词 price，不用 it 指代一个尚未选定的同价对象。

18—12

Tipping is unusual in this fictional shop, and a sign explains that staff are paid fairly, so customers need not feel obliged to leave extra cash.

虚构小店不常给小费，标牌说明员工薪酬公平，因此顾客不必觉得有义务额外留现金。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Tipping + is + unusual；and 后 sign + explains + that 宾从；so 后 customers + need not feel + obliged...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tipping 按原表为给小费；need not 后直接原形 feel。这里描述虚构店规则，不能外推为某国小费惯例。

本篇用到哪些词表词

accord, benefit, effect, product, customer, reduce, quality, issue, sign, pressure, tax, extra, response, fashion, mainly, generation, staff, attract, cash, expand, manufacturer, entrepreneur, unusual, relatively, currently, delivery, political, typically, affordable, slightly, investment, profit, propose, reserve, complain, generate, burden, loan, debt, secure, stock, bilateral, running, tap, urgent, competitor, domestic, import, overseas, proposal, compromise, modest, procedure, revenue, calculate, complaint, minister, opening, rational, coming, component, fairly, negotiator, outlet, peak, timely, acceptable, aisle, bundle, dispute, distribution, export, net, paid, retail, ruin, barrier, cooperate, tipping

ARTICLE 19 / 20

19 · 公共讨论中的规则、公平与证据

约320个英文词 · 16句 · 含89个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖45个词条

At a public meeting, the governor and the mayor debate whether to fund a new clinic or invest in public transport. A politician may advocate a radical reform, while an opponent may favor a more conventional solution. Before a vote, a poll should reflect diverse public views rather than merely reinforce the belief of a vocal minority. A committee can assign priority to the most urgent need, but it must explain the criterion in an administrative report.

A legal scholar asks the class to argue a case concerning freedom, equality, and the protection of a vulnerable refugee. The court must distinguish a moral judgment from a legal definition and examine the circumstance of each alleged crime. A criminal charge does not remove a person's right to a defense, and an accusation alone does not constitute proof. The lesson encourages a critical approach to justice and asks students to challenge a rule that they perceive as unfair.

A fictional thief enters a royal estate during a ceremony and takes a valuable object from a locked glass frame. A witness notices an odd mark near the doorway, while a detective finds a clue in a pile of discarded paper. The investigator does not suspect the quiet guy simply because of his appearance, nor does she confuse silence with guilt. When the missing object is found in a postal package, a surprising detail helps the team reconstruct the episode.

At a meeting, the spokesperson asks everyone to speak respectfully and not to criticize a person for raising an unpopular question. I can strongly oppose a proposal and still admit that its supporter has a reasonable concern about an existing problem. If the discussion becomes heated, the host can prompt a pause and invite a quieter counterpart to explain their view. Respect does not require agreement on every matter; it requires a willingness to hear an argument without treating disagreement as a deadly threat.

第1自然段
19—01

At a public meeting, the governor and the mayor debate whether to fund a new clinic or invest in public transport.

公开会议上，州长和市长辩论，是资助新诊所还是投资公共交通。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
并列主语 the governor and the mayor；谓语 debate；宾语 whether to fund... or invest...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
whether to do 是疑问词加不定式，可作宾语；fund 是动词资助，invest in 表投资于。两个方案结构平行。

19—02

A politician may advocate a radical reform, while an opponent may favor a more conventional solution.

政治人物可能主张激进改革，而反对者可能支持较传统的解决方案。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A politician + may advocate...；while 连接 an opponent + may favor...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
advocate、favor 都是及物动词，直接接支持的方案。while 表观点对照；conventional 比 traditional 更强调惯常做法，但都按原表义项使用。

19—03

Before a vote, a poll should reflect diverse public views rather than merely reinforce the belief of a vocal minority.

投票之前，民调应反映不同公众观点，而不只是强化声音响亮的少数群体的信念。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a poll + should reflect + diverse public views；rather than reinforce...；of a vocal minority 修饰 belief。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
poll 为民调，vote 为投票；reflect 在这里是反映。views 是 view 的复数，指多种观点；声音响亮的少数不一定代表全体。

19—04

A committee can assign priority to the most urgent need, but it must explain the criterion in an administrative report.

委员会可以优先考虑最紧迫的需求，但必须在行政报告中解释标准。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A committee + can assign + priority + to the most urgent need；but 后 it + must explain + the criterion。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
assign A to B 把某项内容分配给某对象；priority 在此是优先地位。administrative 为形容词修饰 report，不是 administrator 管理者这个人。

第2自然段
19—05

A legal scholar asks the class to argue a case concerning freedom, equality, and the protection of a vulnerable refugee.

法律学者请全班就涉及自由、平等及保护弱势难民的案件展开论证。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A legal scholar + asks + the class + to argue + a case；concerning...后置修饰 case。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
argue 在此为论证案件，不是吵架；concerning 作介词表示关于。中文“涉及……的案件”英文可用 case concerning...后置展开。

19—06

The court must distinguish a moral judgment from a legal definition and examine the circumstance of each alleged crime.

法院必须区分道德判断和法律定义，并审查每起被指控犯罪的具体情形。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The court + must distinguish... and examine...；distinguish A from B；of each alleged crime 限定 circumstance。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
alleged 表被指称的，避免当成定罪事实。moral 修饰判断；circumstance 在此指具体情形，通常也常见复数 circumstances。

19—07

A criminal charge does not remove a person's right to a defense, and an accusation alone does not constitute proof.

刑事指控并不剥夺一个人的辩护权，仅有指责也不构成证据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
两个独立分句：A criminal charge + does not remove...；an accusation alone + does not constitute + proof。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
constitute 为构成，直接接名词；两句否定都用 does not + 原形。alone 修饰 accusation，强调单凭指责不足。

19—08

The lesson encourages a critical approach to justice and asks students to challenge a rule that they perceive as unfair.

课程鼓励批判地看待正义，并请学生质疑他们认为不公平的规则。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The lesson + encourages... and asks...；asks + students + to challenge...；that they perceive as unfair 定从修饰 rule，that 作宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
perceive A as B 表把 A 看作 B；that 已代 rule，不能再加 it。critical 这里为批判审视的，而非危急的。

第3自然段
19—09

A fictional thief enters a royal estate during a ceremony and takes a valuable object from a locked glass frame.

虚构的小偷在典礼期间进入皇家庄园，从锁住的玻璃框内拿走贵重物品。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A fictional thief + enters... and takes...；during...为时间；from a locked glass frame 为来源。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
estate 指庄园；frame 为框。叙事现在时可讲故事，两个谓语跟 thief 单数变化；from 不能省，否则物品从何处拿走不明确。

19—10

A witness notices an odd mark near the doorway, while a detective finds a clue in a pile of discarded paper.

目击者注意到门边奇怪印记，侦探则在一堆废纸中找到线索。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A witness + notices + an odd mark；while 后 a detective + finds + a clue；in a pile...为地点。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
pile of 表一堆，paper 此处为纸张不可数。while 连接两个完整句；地点短语分别归属于注意和找到的动作。

19—11

The investigator does not suspect the quiet guy simply because of his appearance, nor does she confuse silence with guilt.

调查人员不会仅因那个安静男子的外表就怀疑他，也不把沉默与有罪混淆。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
前句 investigator + does not suspect...；nor 引否定倒装 does she confuse...；confuse A with B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
nor 接另一否定陈述时，助动词放主语前，写 nor does she。这是本句难点；because of 后是名词短语，与 because 从句不同。

19—12

When the missing object is found in a postal package, a surprising detail helps the team reconstruct the episode.

失物在邮包里找到时，一项令人意外的细节帮助团队还原这段事件。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 the missing object + is found；主句 a surprising detail + helps + the team + reconstruct + the episode。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
is found 为被动，found 是 find 的过去分词；help 后 reconstruct 不加 to 也成立。episode 在这里是插曲/事件，不一定是电视剧一集。

第4自然段
19—13

At a meeting, the spokesperson asks everyone to speak respectfully and not to criticize a person for raising an unpopular question.

会上，发言人要求大家尊重地发言，不因某人提出不受欢迎的问题就批评他。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The spokesperson + asks + everyone + to speak... and not to criticize...；for raising...为批评原因。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
criticize 是动词批评，不是 critic 评论者；not 放 to 前否定不定式。for 是介词，后接 raising。

19—14

I can strongly oppose a proposal and still admit that its supporter has a reasonable concern about an existing problem.

我可以强烈反对提案，同时仍承认其支持者对现有问题的担忧有道理。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
I + can oppose... and admit...；that 宾从 its supporter + has + a reasonable concern；about...限定关切内容。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
oppose 直接接 proposal，不写 oppose to；strongly 为副词。支持者与提案是不同对象，its 回指 proposal，不是 I。

19—15

If the discussion becomes heated, the host can prompt a pause and invite a quieter counterpart to explain their view.

讨论激烈起来时，主持人可建议暂停，并邀请较安静的另一方阐明观点。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 discussion + becomes + heated；主句 host + can prompt... and invite + a quieter counterpart + to explain...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
counterpart 此处指对应的另一方；view 为观点名词。invite sb to do 与 ask sb to do 类似，需要 to，不写 invite sb explain。

19—16

Respect does not require agreement on every matter; it requires a willingness to hear an argument without treating disagreement as a deadly threat.

尊重不要求事事同意，而要求愿意听取论证，不把分歧视为致命威胁。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
前句 Respect + does not require...；后句 it + requires + a willingness；to hear...修饰 willingness；without treating A as B。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
deadly 为形容词致命的；threat 为威胁名词。分号连接两种要求的对照，willingness to do 是名词加不定式。

本篇用到哪些词表词

simply, case, view, challenge, concern, argue, approach, debate, remove, detail, charge, belief, fund, reflect, solution, protection, critical, argument, threat, valuable, legal, priority, vulnerable, crime, invest, perceive, refugee, vote, admit, advocate, assign, criminal, transport, favor, mayor, appearance, conventional, counterpart, host, circumstance, court, definition, missing, distinguish, moral, diverse, governor, odd, royal, urgent, criticize, defense, estate, freedom, guy, oppose, proposal, scholar, suspect, witness, found, postal, prompt, spokesperson, equality, justice, opponent, radical, reasonable, reform, strongly, ceremony, concerning, deadly, existing, politician, poll, surprising, thief, pile, supporter, administrative, clue, confuse, constitute, episode, frame, merely, minority
