ARTICLE 20 / 20

20 · 从账户安全到太空任务：技术怎样工作

约547个英文词 · 28句 · 含153个表内词条（含复现） · 首次覆盖74个词条

A user should choose a secure password and enable an additional protection feature before opening an online account. If a suspicious email asks you to transfer cash, verify the sender's identity instead of trusting its apparent authority. A fraudster may attempt to capture private information, whereas a genuine service provider will not demand your password. Report the incident promptly so that the administrator can block further attacks and preserve the evidence of fraud.

A technician checks an electronic panel, tests the battery, and reads a warning on the motor before starting the engine. A systematic evaluation should locate the fault, confirm the operating condition, and prevent a simple adjustment from causing further damage. An automated machine may stop if a tiny component fails, so a clear manual is vital for efficient processing. Once the repair is complete, the operator can switch on the device, check its output, and safely resume production.

A communications engineer studies how a radio wave can carry a message over a distance of one kilometer. The lesson explains that signal jamming may interfere with a wireless link and cause a temporary loss of service. An engineer can integrate a new component into an existing network without permanently changing the entire structure. When the channel is busy, a buffer may hold a string of messages until the system is ready to deliver them.

An astronaut boards a spacecraft for a lunar mission that will advance our understanding of the outer environment. The crew must operate complex equipment, monitor an automated experiment, and report any unusual phenomenon during the flight. A scientist hopes to observe how a liquid behaves when gravity changes and whether a tiny particle can float freely. Although flying beyond Earth is an extraordinary adventure, the team must not let excitement weaken its commitment to safety.

A client may receive an enormous amount of information, while a consultant must select what is relevant and discard what is junk. A useful tool can facilitate planning, maximize flexibility, and help a user convert a broad intention into a concrete action. However, convenience is not enough: the interface should be convenient for people who have limited vision or little digital experience. The aim is to reduce friction, not to overwhelm a beginner with a bundle of features that they rarely need.

Worldwide, a billion people may rely on silicon-based technology, while millions more use virtual tools for work and play. A million tiny changes can collectively transform a system, yet a single clever feature will not automatically guarantee success. A management team should measure the scale of an improvement and ask how significantly it can reduce cost over a span of years. The latest headline may call a device incredible, but we should examine its rating, practical value, and real-world performance closely.

During a routine inspection, an engineer may notice that a tiny tear in a protective cloth could expose the interior of a machine. Apparently trivial problems can sometimes induce a serious fault, so the team should inspect the attachment before the next test. The operator must not press a damaged bar or shoot a jet of water at a live electrical panel. A timely repair can prevent the fault from spreading, whereas a poorly planned change may exhaust the budget without solving anything.

第1自然段
20—01

A user should choose a secure password and enable an additional protection feature before opening an online account.

用户在开设网络账户前，应选择安全的密码并启用一项额外保护功能。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A user + should choose... and enable...；before opening...表示时间，opening 的主体仍为 user。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
先写两个建议动作；before 后把同主语动作写成 opening。secure 修饰 password，不能用名词 security 直接替代其形容词位置。

20—02

If a suspicious email asks you to transfer cash, verify the sender's identity instead of trusting its apparent authority.

如果可疑邮件要求你转账，应核实发件人身份，而不是相信它表面上的权威性。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
If 从句 a suspicious email + asks + you + to transfer cash；主句祈使句省略主语 you，谓语 verify；instead of 后 trusting。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
中文“核实一下”也常省主语；英文祈使句同样可省 you，直接从动词原形开始。if 的条件句与主句要用逗号分开。

20—03

A fraudster may attempt to capture private information, whereas a genuine service provider will not demand your password.

诈骗者可能试图获取私人信息，而真正的服务提供者不会索要你的密码。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a fraudster + may attempt + to capture...；whereas 连接另一分句：a genuine service provider + will not demand + your password。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
attempt to do 表试图；demand 在这里直接接索要的东西。whereas 用于对照两类主体，不要只用逗号拼接两个独立句。

20—04

Report the incident promptly so that the administrator can block further attacks and preserve the evidence of fraud.

及时报告这件事，以便管理员能阻止进一步攻击并保存诈骗证据。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
主句祈使句 Report + the incident；so that 目的从句 the administrator + can block... and preserve...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
“以便”用 so that，引出的从句有自己的主语。promptly 修饰报告，放在动词宾语后；管理员不是 Report 的主语。

第2自然段
20—05

A technician checks an electronic panel, tests the battery, and reads a warning on the motor before starting the engine.

技术员检查电子面板、测试电池，并在启动发动机前阅读电动机上的警告。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A technician + checks... tests... and reads...；before starting the engine 为时间状语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
panel 是控制面板，motor 指电动机，engine 指发动机；同一场景中按具体名词区分。starting 的主体与 technician 一致。

20—06

A systematic evaluation should locate the fault, confirm the operating condition, and prevent a simple adjustment from causing further damage.

系统评估应找到故障、确认运行状况，并防止简单调整引发进一步损坏。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A systematic evaluation + should locate... confirm... and prevent...；prevent + a simple adjustment + from causing...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
locate 在此是定位故障；prevent A from doing 中 A 也可为事物。causing 不是新的谓语，而是介词 from 后的动名词。

20—07

An automated machine may stop if a tiny component fails, so a clear manual is vital for efficient processing.

自动化机器可能因小部件故障而停止，因此清晰手册对高效加工至关重要。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An automated machine + may stop；if 从句 a tiny component + fails；so 后 a clear manual + is + vital。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
if 表条件，so 表结果；manual 这里是名词手册，与前文 manual labor 的形容词不同。processing 指加工过程。

20—08

Once the repair is complete, the operator can switch on the device, check its output, and safely resume production.

维修完成后，操作员可开启设备、检查输出，并安全恢复生产。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Once 从句 the repair + is + complete；主句 the operator + can switch on... check... and resume...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
once 在此为一旦/当……之后的连词；complete 是形容词完成的，不是完成动作。safely 修饰 resume，而 safe 通常修饰名词或作表语。

第3自然段
20—09

A communications engineer studies how a radio wave can carry a message over a distance of one kilometer.

通信工程师研究无线电波如何在一千米距离上传递信息。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A communications engineer + studies + how 宾从；a radio wave + can carry + a message；over a distance...说明范围。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
wave 为无线电波；how 后不倒装。one kilometer 的单数由 one 决定，中文数量单位没有同样的词尾变化。

20—10

The lesson explains that signal jamming may interfere with a wireless link and cause a temporary loss of service.

课程说明，信号干扰可能影响无线连接，造成临时服务中断。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The lesson + explains + that 宾从；signal jamming + may interfere with... and cause...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
interfere with 表干扰，需要 with；link 此处为连接名词。loss 是名词丧失，不是动词 lose；a loss of service 为一次服务损失。

20—11

An engineer can integrate a new component into an existing network without permanently changing the entire structure.

工程师能把新部件集成到现有网络中，而不永久改变整个结构。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An engineer + can integrate + a new component + into an existing network；without changing...为方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
integrate A into B 表融入；permanently 修饰 changing。existing 在这里是定语现有的，不是独立谓语 exist。

20—12

When the channel is busy, a buffer may hold a string of messages until the system is ready to deliver them.

通道忙碌时，缓冲区可保存一串消息，直到系统准备好投递它们。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
When 从句 the channel + is + busy；主句 a buffer + may hold + a string of messages；until 从句 system + is ready + to deliver them。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
string 在这里是一串；them 指复数 messages。ready 是形容词，需 is 连接；to deliver 说明准备做什么，而不是新的主句。

第4自然段
20—13

An astronaut boards a spacecraft for a lunar mission that will advance our understanding of the outer environment.

宇航员登上航天器，执行将推进我们对外部环境理解的月球任务。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
An astronaut + boards + a spacecraft；for a lunar mission 表目的；that will advance...定从修饰 mission。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
advance 在此为动词推进，understanding 是宾语；lunar 为月球的。that 指任务，不能误认宇航员为 will advance 的从句主语。

20—14

The crew must operate complex equipment, monitor an automated experiment, and report any unusual phenomenon during the flight.

机组必须操作复杂设备、监测自动实验，并报告飞行中的任何异常现象。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The crew + must operate... monitor... and report...；during the flight 表时间；any unusual phenomenon 为宾语。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
phenomenon 是单数，复数为 phenomena；equipment 不可数。must 后三个动词均不变形，所以此句不用决定 crew 后普通现在时的数。

20—15

A scientist hopes to observe how a liquid behaves when gravity changes and whether a tiny particle can float freely.

科学家希望观察重力变化时液体怎样运动，以及微小颗粒能否自由漂浮。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A scientist + hopes + to observe；后接 how 与 whether 两个宾从；when gravity changes 为 how 从句中的时间背景。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
一个从句中还可嵌入 when 从句，先读液体怎样表现，再补重力何时变化。freely 修饰 float，表示不受限制地漂浮。

20—16

Although flying beyond Earth is an extraordinary adventure, the team must not let excitement weaken its commitment to safety.

尽管飞离地球是非凡冒险，团队也不能让兴奋削弱安全承诺。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Although 从句 flying beyond Earth + is...；主句 the team + must not let + excitement + weaken + its commitment...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
flying 为动名词主语；let 后 weaken 不加 to。must not 表禁止，不同于 need not“不必”；to safety 是 commitment 的对象。

第5自然段
20—17

A client may receive an enormous amount of information, while a consultant must select what is relevant and discard what is junk.

客户可能收到海量信息，而顾问必须选出相关内容，丢弃无用信息。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A client + may receive...；while 后 consultant + must select + what is relevant；and discard + what is junk。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
两个 what 从句都作宾语，what 在各从句又作主语；junk 为无价值杂物/内容，不是形容词。information 不可数，用 amount。

20—18

A useful tool can facilitate planning, maximize flexibility, and help a user convert a broad intention into a concrete action.

实用工具能便利规划、最大化灵活性，并帮助用户把广泛意图转成具体行动。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A useful tool + can facilitate... maximize... and help...；help + a user + convert + intention + into action。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
facilitate 直接接 planning，无需再加 make；maximize 为使最大化。convert A into B 与 convert to 在具体用法中不同，这里写清转换双方。

20—19

However, convenience is not enough: the interface should be convenient for people who have limited vision or little digital experience.

不过，仅有便利还不够：界面应便于视力有限或缺乏数字经验的人使用。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
convenience + is not + enough；冒号后 the interface + should be + convenient；who have...修饰 people。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
vision 为视力名词，convenient 为形容词，convenience 为名词；词性决定其句中位置。冒号引出对前句的具体说明。

20—20

The aim is to reduce friction, not to overwhelm a beginner with a bundle of features that they rarely need.

目标是减少阻碍，而不以大量新手很少需要的功能让其不知所措。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The aim + is + to reduce...，not to overwhelm...；overwhelm + a beginner + with...；that they rarely need 修饰 features。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
overwhelm sb with sth 表用某物使某人应接不暇；that 为 need 的宾语，不能再写 need them。两个不定式对应目标与排除目标。

第6自然段
20—21

Worldwide, a billion people may rely on silicon-based technology, while millions more use virtual tools for work and play.

在全球，十亿人可能依赖硅基技术，另有数百万人用虚拟工具工作和娱乐。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
a billion people + may rely on...；while 后 millions more + use + virtual tools；for...表用途。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
billion 前有具体数量 a，不加 s；millions more 为另外数百万。silicon 为硅，不能与 silicone 硅胶混淆。

20—22

A million tiny changes can collectively transform a system, yet a single clever feature will not automatically guarantee success.

一百万个微小变化能共同改变系统，但单个巧妙功能不会自动保证成功。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A million tiny changes + can transform...；yet 后 a single clever feature + will not guarantee...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
million 有具体数值限定，不加 s；主语实际是复数 changes。single 强调只有一个，不能把 a million 的 a 看作整个主语单数。

20—23

A management team should measure the scale of an improvement and ask how significantly it can reduce cost over a span of years.

管理团队应衡量改进规模，并问它在数年间能多大幅度降低成本。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
A management team + should measure... and ask...；how significantly 宾从修饰 reduce 程度；it + can reduce + cost。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
how significantly 是程度提问，不倒装；span 指时间跨度。management 在这里作名词定语，team 是主语中心词。

20—24

The latest headline may call a device incredible, but we should examine its rating, practical value, and real-world performance closely.

最新标题可能称设备不可思议，但我们应仔细检查评分、实用价值及现实表现。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
headline + may call + a device + incredible；but 后 we + should examine + 三个对象；closely 为方式。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
call A incredible 为宾语加形容词宾补；rating 为评分。closely 修饰检查的细致程度，不是空间上靠得近。

第7自然段
20—25

During a routine inspection, an engineer may notice that a tiny tear in a protective cloth could expose the interior of a machine.

例行检查时，工程师可能注意到保护布的小裂口会使机器内部暴露。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
an engineer + may notice + that 宾从；a tiny tear... + could expose + the interior...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
tear 在这里为名词裂口，发音不同于眼泪；interior 为内部名词。notice 后完整从句的主语是 tear，不是 cloth。

20—26

Apparently trivial problems can sometimes induce a serious fault, so the team should inspect the attachment before the next test.

表面微不足道的问题有时会引发严重故障，因此团队应在下次测试前检查附件。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
Apparently trivial problems + can induce + a serious fault；so 后 team + should inspect + the attachment。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
apparently 修饰 trivial，表看起来；attachment 此处是附加装置/附件，不是情感依恋。induce 直接接导致的结果。

20—27

The operator must not press a damaged bar or shoot a jet of water at a live electrical panel.

操作员不得按压受损杆件，也不得向通电面板喷射水流。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
The operator + must not press... or shoot...；shoot + a jet of water + at a live electrical panel。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
bar 此处是杆件；shoot 为喷射，非必须指枪击；at 表喷向对象。must not 是否定两个动作，不能理解成按压或喷射任选其一。

20—28

A timely repair can prevent the fault from spreading, whereas a poorly planned change may exhaust the budget without solving anything.

及时修理能阻止故障扩大，而计划不周的改动可能耗尽预算，却什么也没解决。

这句怎么写：主干、从句与中英差别

① 抓主干 / 分层
repair + can prevent + fault + from spreading；whereas 后 change + may exhaust + budget；without solving...。

② 从中文到英文 / 为什么这样写
exhaust 在这里为耗尽，不是使人疲惫；poorly 修饰 planned。prevent 后 spreading 由 from 决定；without 后 solving 同理。

本篇用到哪些词表词
